[SYSTEM PROMPT]
================================================================================
Du bist der offizielle KI-Kurations-Assistent für das autodocs Dokumentations- und Spezifikationssystem (AUTOSAR & S-Core).
Deine Aufgabe ist es, präzise, fachlich fundierte Erklärungen, User Guides und Diagramme zu verfassen.

FOLGENDE RICHTLINIEN SIND STRIKT BINDEND:
# Richtlinien für KI-generierte Erklärungen

Diese Datei wird von den Prompt-Rezepten (`_src/tools/prompt_recipes.py`)
wörtlich in jeden Prompt eingebettet. Jede Änderung ändert daher alle
Prompt-Hashes; bestehende KI-Texte gelten dann als veraltet und werden neu
erzeugt. Herkunft und Ablage der Ausgaben regelt `_src/lib_ai_store.py`.

## Sprache

- Kanonische Sprache ist Deutsch. Die Übersetzung ist ein nachgelagerter Schritt
  und nie Teil der Generierung.
- API-Bezeichner, Typnamen, Enum-Werte, Code und Kennungen wie `[SWS_…]` bleiben
  unverändert.

## Struktur

- Jedes Fragment ist genau ein `<div class="ai …">` (Varianten: `ai usage` für
  Verwendungshinweise an einem Spezifikationselement, `ai module-guide` für
  Modul-Leitfäden) und endet mit genau einem `<p class="ai-note">` (KI-Hinweis).
- Erlaubte Elemente im Fragment: `div`, `p`, `h4`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `code`,
  `strong`, `em`, `a`, `span`, `table`, `thead`, `tbody`, `tr`, `th`, `td`.
  Keine Skripte, keine Stile, keine Bilder, kein `<svg>` (Diagramme siehe unten).
- Alle Tags korrekt geschlossen und verschachtelt.

## Belegpflicht

- Jede fachliche Aussage ist zu belegen. Belege stammen ausschließlich aus dem
  Payload des Prompts; nichts darf aus anderem Wissen als Beleg ausgegeben werden.
- Verweis auf ein Spezifikationselement oder Requirement (nur IDs, die im
  Payload vorkommen):
  `<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_…">[SWS_…]</a>` — ohne `href`; den
  Link setzt der Generator.
- Verweis auf eine Dokumentstelle (nur Dokument/Seite aus dem Payload):
  `<span class="docref" data-doc="<Dokument-ID>" data-page="<Seite>">Kurzname §x.y „Titel“</span>`.
- Niemals URLs ausgeben, insbesondere keine PDF-URLs.

## Annahmen (Wissenslücken)

- Wo die Quellen schweigen, sind höchstens 3 Annahmen je Text und 2 je
  Diagramm erlaubt.
- Jede Annahme ist im Text als Interpretation erkennbar („dürfte“, „vermutlich“,
  „Interpretation:“) und wird am Ende des Fragments in einem Kommentar
  `<!-- annahmen: 1) … – Begründung: … -->` aufgezählt.
- Reicht das Budget nicht, wird der Aspekt weggelassen — niemals unmarkiert
  spekulieren.

## Diagramme

Ein Diagramm nur, wenn es gegenüber dem Text Mehrwert bietet:

- Sequenzdiagramm: Abläufe ab 3 Schritten oder mit nicht offensichtlicher
  Reihenfolge/Asynchronität.
- Kontext-/Kollaborationsdiagramm: ab 3 beteiligten Komponenten.
- Zustandsdiagramm: Lebenszyklen und Zustandsmaschinen.
- Aktivitätsdiagramm: Entscheidungs- oder Verarbeitungsabläufe mit Verzweigung.
- Keine Trivialdiagramme (einzelne Aufrufe, Getter/Setter, Zweierbeziehungen).

Beschriftungen deutsch, Bezeichner unverändert. Jedes Diagramm steht im
Fragment als Platzhalter `<div class="diagram" id="diag-<kurzname>"></div>`,
direkt gefolgt von `<p class="diagram-note"><Diagrammart>: <Kernaussage>.
Quellen: <Belege></p>`. Die Diagrammquelle wird separat ausgegeben (Format
legt der Prompt fest).

## Implementer's Guides

Dieser Abschnitt gilt nur für Implementer's Guides (Rezepte `element-impl@1`,
`module-impl-guide@1`, `cluster-impl-guide@1`). Die Rezepte der User Guides
betten die Richtlinien ohne diesen Abschnitt ein; seine Änderung lässt deren
Prompt-Hashes unberührt.

- Frage: Was muss eine korrekte Implementierung leisten? Nicht: Wie benutze ich das?
- Das Fragment ist genau ein `<div class="ai impl-guide">` und endet mit genau
  einem `<p class="ai-note">`. Erlaubte Elemente wie oben.
- Pflichtgliederung als `<h4>` in dieser Reihenfolge, jede Überschrift genau
  einmal: „Verpflichtungen“, „Vorbedingungen und Zustände“, „Fehlerbehandlung“,
  „Aufrufkontext und Nebenläufigkeit“, „Wechselwirkungen“, „Prüfkriterien“,
  „Annahmen“. Ein Abschnitt ohne Beleg im Payload enthält nur den Satz
  „Die Quellen enthalten dazu keine Aussage.“
- Verpflichtungen: jede einschlägige Requirement-ID aus dem Payload als Liste
  mit `<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_…">`.
- Prüfkriterien: eine nummerierte Liste `<ol class="impl-checks">`; jeder
  Eintrag ist eine testbare Aussage und trägt die belegende Requirement-ID als
  `<li data-sws="SWS_…">`. Nur IDs aus dem Payload.
- Annahmen (Annahmenpflicht): jede Annahme steht im Abschnitt „Annahmen“ als
  Listeneintrag mit Begründung und zusätzlich im Kommentar
  `<!-- annahmen: … -->`. Ohne Annahmen steht dort „Keine Annahmen.“.
  Angaben, die nicht aus dem Payload stammen (z. B. eine Dateistruktur nach
  AUTOSAR-Konvention), sind immer Annahmen und zählen zum Annahmenbudget.

KONTEXT-SYNTHESE- & EVIDENZ-REGELN (CONCEPT-0056):
1. KONTINUIERLICHE SYNTHESE: Alle übergebenen Inbound-Snippets fließen ohne Kurationspause ein.
2. ZWEISTUFIGE EVIDENZ-KENNZEICHNUNG:
   - VERIFIED (Score >= 0.95): Normativ verbindliche Belege, faktischer Text, Badge <span class="badge-pill bp-curated">🔒 Verifizierter Kontext</span>.
   - UNVERIFIED (0.70 <= Score < 0.95): Zwingend mit folgender Warnbox formatieren:
     <div class="ai-unverified-evidence" data-snippet-id="{ID}" data-confidence="{SCORE}">
       <div class="ai-unverified-header">
         <span class="badge-pill bp-ai">⚠️ UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS &bull; Konfidenz: {SCORE}</span>
         <span class="ai-unverified-actions">
           <a href="spec/record.html?id={REC_ID}#curate-{ID}" class="btn-curate-inline dossier-open-link" data-dossier-target="dossier-modal-{REC_ID}" data-snippet-id="{ID}">🔍 Im Curation-Editor prüfen &rarr;</a>
         </span>
       </div>
       <p class="ai-unverified-body">
         <strong>UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS (Nicht ohne formale Kuration für Serienentwicklung verwenden):</strong><br>
         <em>Interpretation / Vorläufiger Kontext:</em> [Interpretation der Anforderung]
       </p>
     </div>
3. DUKTUS FÜR UNVERIFIED HYPOTHESEN: Als abgeleitete Vermutung formulieren ('dürfte', 'lässt sich ableiten', 'Interpretation:'), niemals als verbindlicher Normentext.
4. TOKEN-BUDGET: Bis zu 90% des Kontextfensters können genutzt werden. Output ist limitiert auf max 8192 Tokens.
5. TRIVIALITÄTS-FILTER (INV-TRIVIALITY-WHITELIST-04): Enums, Typen und Methoden mit State-Machine-, Lifecycle-, E2E- oder Concurrency-Bezug sind niemals trivial.

  "fragment":  "<wie im Auftrag>",

    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FR_SECTION_7_3_Indexing_Scheme",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayDriver",
      "source_page": 21,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.3 Indexing Scheme\nUsers of the Fr identify Fr resources by using an indexing scheme as depicted in\nFigure 7.1.\nFigure 7.1: FlexRay Driver indexing scheme\nThe following Fr resources are available:\n[SWS_Fr_00075]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00413\n⌈CCs are identified via controller indices (Fr_CtrlIdx).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00467]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05065\n⌈Each driver’s CCs are identified by controller indices 0 to (n-1) where n is the number\nof CCs controlled by the particular Fr.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00344] ⌈For each FlexRay CC the connected channels are identified by\nchannel indices (Fr_ChnlIdx).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00468] ⌈A dedicated type that holds the enumerations FR_CHANNEL_A,\nFR_CHANNEL_B or FR_CHANNEL_AB represents the channel index.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00469] ⌈Channel indices are only valid within a tuple <Fr_CtrlIdx,\nFr_ChnlIdx>.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00005]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05003, SRS_Fr_05024\n⌈Each FlexRay frame processed by Fr API functions is identified by an LPdu index (\nFr_LPduIdx).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00470] ⌈Each LPdu carries the LSdu. Each controller’s LPdus are identified\nby LPdu indices from 0 to (n-1) where n is the number of LPdus processed by the\ncorresponding CC.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00471] ⌈LPdu indices are only valid within a tuple <Fr_CtrlIdx,\nFr_LPduIdx>.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00472] ⌈An Fr_LPduIdx uniquely identifies the following parameters of a\nFlexRay frame as a key: {Slot ID, Channel, cycle repetition, base cycle, transmit/re-\nceive}.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00345] ⌈Each FlexRay CC contains absolute timers.\nAbsolute FlexRay\ntimers are identified via absolute timer indices (Fr_AbsTimerIdx).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00473] ⌈Each CC’s absolute timers are identified by absolute timer indices\nfrom 0 to (n-1), where n is the number of absolute timers controlled by the particular\nCC.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00474] ⌈Absolute timer indices are only valid within a tuple <Fr_CtrlIdx,\nFr_AbsTimerIdx>.⌋\nThe FlexRay Driver numbering scheme (Figure 7.1) assigns indices to these items on\na per-driver basis. Note that only the FlexRay CCs handled by one specific Fr module\n(i.e., the FlexRay CCs of type A in the example given) are being assigned indices within\nthe context of this Fr module. All other CCs (e.g., the FlexRay CC of type B) are not\nhandled by this Fr module and thus no indices have been assigned to these FlexRay\nCCs within the context of this Fr module."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FR_SECTION_7_4_2_2_8_3_FrameIDFlexRay",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_BusMirroring",
      "source_page": 53,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.4.2.2.8.3 FrameIDFlexRay\nThe layout of the FrameID for a FlexRay bus is shown in Table 7.8.\nFrameID\nByte 0\nBit 7\nBit 6\nBit 5 .. 4\nBit 3\nBits 2 .. 0\nByte 1\nByte 2\nChan-\nnel\nB\nChan-\nnel\nA\nreserved\nSlot\nValid\nSlot ID\n(Bits 10 .. 8)\nSlot ID\n(Bits 7 .. 0)\nCycle\nTable 7.8: Layout of FlexRay FrameID\n[SWS_Mirror_00104]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Mirror_00008\n⌈The width of the FrameIDFlexRay field shall be 3 bytes.⌋\n[SWS_Mirror_00105]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Mirror_00008\n⌈Bits 7 – 6 of Byte 0 of the FrameIDFlexRay shall contain the channel assignment\nof the reported FlexRay frame. Bit 7 shall be set to 1 if the reported FlexRay frame is\navailable on channel B of the FlexRay controller, otherwise it shall be set to 0. Bit 6\nshall be set to 1 if the reported FlexRay frame is available on channel A of the FlexRay\ncontroller, otherwise it shall be set to 0. A reported FlexRay frame is either assigned\nexclusively to channel A or B or to both channels.⌋\nThis layout of the channel assignment corresponds to the Fr_ChannelType reported\nby Mirror_ReportFlexRayFrame.\n[SWS_Mirror_00106]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Mirror_00008\n⌈Bits 5 – 4 of Byte 0 of the FrameIDFlexRay are currently reserved. They shall\nalways be set 0.⌋\n[SWS_Mirror_00159]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Mirror_00008\n⌈Bit 3 of Byte 0 of the FrameIDFlexRay shall contain a flag indicating whether the\nreported slot ID and cycle are valid (flag is 1) or unused (flag is 0). It shall only be set\nto 0 when an aggregated error of the FlexRay channels is reported independently of a\nsource frame or transmission conflict. Otherwise it shall always be set to 1.⌋\n[SWS_Mirror_00107]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Mirror_00008\n⌈Bits 2 – 0 of Byte 0 and Byte 1 of the FrameIDFlexRay shall contain the slot ID of\nthe reported FlexRay frame in network byte order (MSB first).⌋\n[SWS_Mirror_00108]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Mirror_00008\n⌈Byte 2 of the FrameIDFlexRay shall contain the cycle in which the reported FlexRay\nframe was sent or received.⌋\nPlease note: For received frames and for frames sent in the static segment, the cycle\nis always reliable. For frames sent in the dynamic segment, the actual cycle cannot be\nknown in advance, because the frame might not be transmitted in the planned cycle."
    },

It\nmay be omitted when reporting a source bus state change, the presence shall be\nindicated by PayloadAvailable.⌋\n[SWS_Mirror_00110]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Mirror_00008\n⌈The width of the PayloadLength field shall be 8 bits.⌋"

    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FR_SECTION_7_4_POC_state_machine_control",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayDriver",
      "source_page": 23,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.4 POC state machine control\n[SWS_Fr_00477] ⌈Since a FlexRay CC is condition-based, it internally maintains a\nstate machine, the Protocol Operation Control (POC) state machine. The state transi-\ntions are driven both by hardware related events as well as by commands passed by\nthe host at the CHI (see [1] for details).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00478] ⌈The CHI commands driving the POC state machine are incorpo-\nrated into several Fr module API functions. API functions affecting the POC state of a\nFlexRay CC are:\n• Fr_StartCommunication()\n• Fr_HaltCommunication()\n• Fr_AbortCommunication()\n• Fr_SendWUP()\n• Fr_ControllerInit()\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00438] ⌈All API functions other than those listed above shall not change the\nPOC state of the FlexRay CC. Figure 3 shows the POC states of the FlexRay CC and\nthe transitions applicable to the Fr module API functions. Note that\n• certain transitions (marked with *)) are performed by the invocation of a single\nAPI function call (Fr_ControllerInit()).\n• certain transitions might be implicitly performed by the FlexRay CC without exter-\nnal command invocation (dotted arrow)\n• certain transitions specified cannot be performed by the current Fr module API\n(not drawn in Figure 3 - compare to [5]).\n⌋\nFigure 7.2: FlexRay Driver POC State Machine Control"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FR_SECTION_7_5_FIFO_support_and_message_ID_filtering",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayDriver",
      "source_page": 22,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.5 FIFO support and message ID filtering\nTo efficiently support reception in certain use-cases, FlexRay controllers might support\nreceive-FIFOs. The receive-FIFOs accept FlexRay frames based on a set of configured\nfilter criterias which match FlexRay specific properties such as frameID, cycle, channel,\nas well as protocol add-ons like the message ID, in hardware.\n[SWS_Fr_00593] ⌈The hardware receive-FIFO shall be used if the FIFO filter-criterias\nas configured can be applied to the hardware FIFO.⌋(SRS_Fr_05005, SRS_Fr_05006)\n[SWS_Fr_00594] ⌈All LPdus (as configured within FrIf) matching a receive-FIFO’s\nfilter-criteria shall be assigned to the respective receive-FIFO.⌋(SRS_Fr_05005)\n[SWS_Fr_00595] ⌈No specific buffers shall be assigned to LPdus that are assigned to\na receive-FIFO.⌋(SRS_Fr_05005)\n[SWS_Fr_00596] ⌈If Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() is called for an LPdu assigned to the re-\nceive FIFO, the service Fr_ReceiveRxPdu() consumes the first valid frame out of the\nrespective FIFO and returns it as received frame. There is no receive-FIFO specific\nAPI, thus keeping the upper layers unaffected.⌋(SRS_Fr_05005)\nHint: This restricted implementation of the receive-FIFO covers a very typical use-case\n(FrTp):\n• All received (L)Pdus assigned to the FIFO shall be processed by a single upper\nlayer module.\n• The upper layer does not care about the specific assignment of (L)Pdus to\nFlexRay FrameTriggerings.\n[SWS_Fr_00597] ⌈LPdus received via the FIFO shall be returned in the same order\nas they were received on the FlexRay network.⌋(SRS_Fr_05005)"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FR_SECTION_7_6_5_2_ProvideTxConfirmation",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayInterface",
      "source_page": 38,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.6.5.2 ProvideTxConfirmation\nThis Communication Operation provides a Tx confirmation and optionally checks the\noccurrence of a Tx conflict.\n[SWS_FrIf_05064] ⌈If the related CC is in FrIf_State FRIF_STATE_ONLINE for a Com-\nmunication Operation TX_CONFIRMATION, then the Job List Execution Function shall\nexecute this Communication Operation. Otherwise, the Job List Execution Function\nshall ignore this Communication Operation.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05288] ⌈\"For a Communication Operation TX_CONFIRMATION the Job\nList Execution Function shall perform the following steps:\n1. Call the FlexRay Driver’s API function Fr_CheckTxLPduStatus():\n• Fr_CtrlIdx is derived according to the indexing scheme described in chapter\nof indexing\n• Fr_LPduIdx is set to the configured L-PDU buffer index [Configuration Pa-\nrameter FrIfLPduIdx, see FrIf06058] associated with the Communication Op-\neration.\n• Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr is set to a temporary slot assignment buffer if Bus\nMirroring is enabled globally (see FrIfBusMirroringSupport), otherwise to the\nNULL_PTR.\n2. If the transmission was performed (output parameter *Fr_TxLPduStatusPtr is set\nto FR_TRANSMITTED) then iterate over all PDUs contained in the FrIfFrame\nStructure (see FrIf05370) of the associated frame triggering. If TxConfCounter\nfor a PDU is 0 proceed with the next PDU, otherwise\n• If FrIfConfirm == true, call the upper layer’s function LSduR_FrIfTxConfirma-\ntion(E_OK) with the asociated PDUId (defined by the upper layer).\n• If FrIfConfirm == true , decrement TxConfCounter.\n3. If the transmission was performed but a TxConflict occurred (output parameter\n*Fr_TxLPduStatusPtr is set to FR_TRANSMITTED_CONFLICT) then iterate over\nall PDUs contained in the FrIfFrameStructure (see FrIf05370) of the associated\nframe triggering. If TxConfCounter for a PDU is 0 proceed with the next PDU,\notherwise\n• If FrIfConfirm == true, call the upper layer’s function <UL_TxConfirmation(E_\nNOT_OK)> with the asociated PDUId (defined by the upper layer).\n• If FrIfConfirm == true , decrement TxConfCounter.\n4. If Bus Mirroring is enabled globally (see FrIfBusMirroringSupport) and has been\nactivated with a call to FrIf_EnableBusMirroring() for the Fr_CtrlIdx and the API\nFr_CheckTxLpduStatus() returns \"FR_TRANSMITTED_CONFLICT\", call Mirror_\nReportFlexRayFrame() with \"controllerId\" set to Fr_CtrlIdx, \"slotId\", \"cycle\", and\n\"channel\" taken from Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr, \"frame\" set to the NULL_PTR, and\n\"txConflict\" set to true.\nIf the API Fr_CheckTxLpduStatus() returns \"FR_TRANSMITTED_CONFLICT\" and the\n<UL_TxConflictNotification> is configured via FrIfTxConflictNotificationName (ECUC_\nFrIf_06122), call this function for the same LPduIdx.⌋"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FR_SECTION_7_6_5_6_PREP_ARE_LPDU",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayInterface",
      "source_page": 42,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.6.5.6 PREPARE_LPDU\nThe Communication Operation PREPARE_LPDU enables hardware optimization\npurposes (hardware buffer re-configuration)\n[SWS_FrIf_05294] ⌈The Communication Operation PREPARE_LPDU performs the\nfollowing steps:\n1. Call the FlexRay Driver’s API function Fr_PrepareLPdu():\n• Fr_CtrlIdx is derived according to the indexing scheme described in chapter\nof indexing.\n• Fr_LPduIdx is set to the configured L-PDU index [Configuration Parameter\nFrIfLPduIdx, see FrIf06058] associated with the Communication Operation.\n⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05061]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05042\n⌈The Communication Operation PREPARE_LPDU enables hardware optimization pur-\nposes. Its purpose is to enable certain FlexRay CC hardware resources (e.g. a CC’s\nmessage buffer) to be prepared (configured) for the transmission/reception of a certain\nL-PDU.\nThis Communication Operation enables the FlexRay Driver to optimize the usage of\nhardware resources if available at appropriate point of times. However, it is the respon-\nsibility of the FlexRay Driver to decide and validate ressource allocation optimizations\nbased on the PREPARE_LPDU Communication Operations. Practically the usage of\nthis Communication Operation will introduce some runtime-overhead even if the Flex\nRay Driver does not use the opportunity for reconfiguration.⌋"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FR_SECTION_7_6_Configuration_description",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayDriver",
      "source_page": 25,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.6 Configuration description\n[SWS_Fr_00080]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00003, SRS_BSW_00334, SRS_BSW_00374, SRS_BSW_\n00379\n⌈The Fr module shall provide an XML file that contains the data, which is required\nfor the SW identification and configuration parameters. This file shall describe vendor\nspecific configuration parameters if applicable.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00480]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05058\n⌈A driver MCG reads the ECU configuration parameters of the Fr and the FrIf mod-\nules. While cluster related configuration parameters are contained in the FrIf module’s\nconfiguration, CC related configuration parameters are contained in the Fr module’s\nconfiguration. The Fr module’s specific configuration tool shall read both ECU module\nconfigurations to derive the configuration parameters for all FlexRay CCs mapped to\nthe Fr module.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00481] ⌈All frame transmission/reception related configuration parameters\nare located only in the FrIf module description (within configuration containers ’FrI-\nfLPdu’ and ’FrIfFrameTriggering’). The Fr must be able to handle all transmis-\nsion/reception requests of all related LPdus. The LPdus within the FrIf configuration\ncontain both an LPduIdx which is passed to the Fr API as well as a link to a frame\ntriggering that holds the link of the LPdu to the FlexRay network (assignment to Slot,\nchannel, cycle).\nThe CC configuration parameters related to frame transmission and reception shall be\nderived from the communication matrix the CC is mapped to within the FrIf.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00482] ⌈For optimization purposes the Fr MCG shall read the FrIf job list for\ndetecting the points in time certain actions on the Fr will be synchronously invoked by\nthe FrIf (see [6] for the FrIf configuration parameters).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00483] ⌈Based on those invocation times the Fr MCG might decide certain\nresource alignment optimizations for transmission and reception (share buffers among\ndifferent LPdus).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00003] ⌈If the FrIf job list contains dedicated buffer reconfiguration entries\nthat allow for optimization, then the Fr module’s MCG may decide to share one buffer\nfor several LPdus within the static segment.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00624] ⌈If an LPdu is dynamically reconfigurable (’FrIfReconfigurable’\nset to true) the MCG shall decide to assign a single exclusive hardware message buffer\nto those LPdus.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00484] ⌈The Fr MCG shall have knowledge about the capabilities of the CC\nand the corresponding driver, therefore this tool is called driver dependent.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00485] ⌈If an Fr MCG is unable to map all required communication opera-\ntions to the available resources, then it has to report that conflict1.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00486] ⌈The number of supported FlexRay CCs is defined at configuration\ntime.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00487] ⌈The MCG shall ensure the consistency of the generated configura-\ntion.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00027]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00345, SRS_BSW_00404\n⌈The Fr module shall support the pre-compile-time and post-build-time configuration\nclasses.⌋\nAn assignment of those configuration classes to configuration parameters can be found\nin Chapter 10.\nHint: The description of the software configuration itself is not part of this specification\nbut very implementation specific.\n1This can result from either from running out of resources (e.g. buffers) or the mapping of the con-\nfiguration to the particular device is not supported (e.g. configuration features supported in [1], but the\ndevice is compliant to [2]).\nA detailed description of all Fr related configuration parameters is specified in\nChapter 10 of this document. Additionally the configuration parameters of the FrIf (see\nchapter 10 of [6]) shall be evaluated for Fr module configuration."
    },

      "verbatim_text": "7.7.5 Extended Production Errors\n[SWS_Fr_00498] ⌈\nError Name:\nFR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT [_<Fr_CtrlIdx>]\nShort Description:\nFlexRay Controller hardware error\nLong Description:\nThis extended production error indicates hardware errors of the FlexRay\ncommunication controller. Please note that this extended production error does\nnot address Flexray protocol errors detected on the network.\nFail\nEvery API function accessing hardware\nregisters of the FlexRay controller\nmight detect a missbehavior of the\ndevice compared to the device\nspecification.\nFor details see requirements:\n[SWS_Fr_00147], [SWS_Fr_00176],\n[SWS_Fr_00181], [SWS_Fr_00520],\n[SWS_Fr_00186], [SWS_Fr_00190],\n[SWS_Fr_00195], [SWS_Fr_00201],\n[SWS_Fr_00216], [SWS_Fr_00223],\n[SWS_Fr_00613], [SWS_Fr_00232],\n[SWS_Fr_00243], [SWS_Fr_00248],\n[SWS_Fr_00529], [SWS_Fr_00543],\n[SWS_Fr_00255], [SWS_Fr_00261],\n[SWS_Fr_00552], [SWS_Fr_00560],\n[SWS_Fr_00568], [SWS_Fr_00580],\n[SWS_Fr_00589], [SWS_Fr_00272],\n[SWS_Fr_00286], [SWS_Fr_00297],\n[SWS_Fr_00308], [SWS_Fr_00319],\n[SWS_Fr_00331], [SWS_Fr_00652]\nDetection Criteria:\nPass\nDuring FlexRay communication\ncontroller initialization (function\nFr_ControllerInit()) the proper operation\nof the hardware registers is\nsuccessfully verified.\nFor details see requirements:\n[SWS_Fr_00598]\nSecondary Parameters:\nIn case of successful device operation verification (function Fr_ControllerInit())\nreport PASS.\nIn case of an error always report FAIL.\nTime Required:\nIf a FlexRay Controller hardware error occurs it shall be immediately reported as\nerror.\nMonitor Frequency:\ncontinuous\n⌋()\n[SWS_Fr_00600] ⌈\nError Name:\nFR_E_LPDU_SLOTSTATUS [_<LPduIdx>]\nShort Description:\nFlexRay Protocol communication error\nLong Description:\nThis production error indicates Flexray protocol communication errors on the\nnetwork for a particular LPdu.\n▽\n△\nFail\nEach time FlexRay slot status with at\nleast one of the following FlexRay\nprotocol errors active:\n• vSS!SyntaxError\n• vSS!ContentError\n• vSS!Bviolation\nFor details see requirements:\n[SWS_Fr_00605], [SWS_Fr_00606]\nDetection Criteria:\nPass\nEach time FlexRay slot status with\nnone one of the following FlexRay\nprotocol errors active:\n• vSS!SyntaxError\n• vSS!ContentError\n• vSS!Bviolation\nFor details see requirements:\n[SWS_Fr_00627], [SWS_Fr_00629]\nSecondary Parameters:\nDetection of production error events is active only during ongoing FlexRay\ncommunication.\nTime Required:\nThe time for detecting an evident FlexRay protocol error in a particular slot\nstrongly depends on the period of the actual FlexRay slot and thus on the FlexRay\nprotocol configuration parameters.\nMonitor Frequency:\ncontinuous\n⌋()"

      "verbatim_text": "8.3 Type definitions\n[SWS_Fr_00499] ⌈The content of Fr_GeneralTypes.h shall be protected by a\nFR_GENERAL_TYPES define.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00500] ⌈If different FlexRay drivers are used, only one instance of this file\nhas to be included in the source tree. For implementation all Fr_GeneralTypes.h\nrelated types in the documents mentioned before shall be considered.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00077]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00305\n⌈All types whether they are specified or implementation dependant shall follow the\nnaming scheme Fr_<name>Type, where the first letter of each word in <name> is\nwritten uppercase and the remainder of the word is written lowercase.⌋"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FR_SECTION_8_4_10_Fr_GetPOCStatus",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayDriver",
      "source_page": 51,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "8.4.10 Fr_GetPOCStatus\n[SWS_Fr_00012] Definition of API function Fr_GetPOCStatus\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05120\n⌈\nService Name\nFr_GetPOCStatus\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType Fr_GetPOCStatus (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nFr_POCStatusType* Fr_POCStatusPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x0a\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\nParameters (in)\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nFr_POCStatusPtr\nAddress the output value is stored to.\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nGets the POC status.\n▽\n△\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋\nCC precondition for the function Fr_GetPOCStatus(): None.\n[SWS_Fr_00217] ⌈The function Fr_GetPOCStatus() shall perform the following\ntasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:\n1. Query the CC’s actual POC status by reading the CHI variable ’vPOC’ and write\nthe result to parameter Fr_POCStatusPtr.\n2. Return E_OK.\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00216]\n⌈If\nthe\nfunction\nFr_GetPOCStatus()\nis\nable\nto\nand\ndetects\na\nhardware\nerror\nwhile\nperforming\nthe\nrequested\nfunctionality,\nthen\nit\nshall\ncall\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED) and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00213] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled,\nand if the function Fr_GetPOCStatus() is called before the successful initializa-\ntion of Fr, then the function Fr_GetPOCStatus() shall raise the development error\nFR_E_INIT_FAILED.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00214] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_GetPOCStatus() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_CtrlIdx.\nIf Fr_CtrlIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_GetPOCStatus() shall raise the devel-\nopment error FR_E_INV_CTRL_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00215] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_GetPOCStatus() shall check whether the parameter Fr_POCStatusPtr\nis a NULL pointer (NULL_PTR). If Fr_POCStatusPtr is a NULL pointer, then the func-\ntion Fr_GetPOCStatus() shall raise the development error FR_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FR_SECTION_8_4_11_Fr_TransmitTxLPdu",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayDriver",
      "source_page": 53,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "8.4.11 Fr_TransmitTxLPdu\n[SWS_Fr_00092] Definition of API function Fr_TransmitTxLPdu\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05003, SRS_Fr_05024\n⌈\nService Name\nFr_TransmitTxLPdu\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType Fr_TransmitTxLPdu (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nuint16 Fr_LPduIdx,\nconst uint8* Fr_LSduPtr,\nuint8 Fr_LSduLength,\nFr_SlotAssignmentType* Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x0b\nSync/Async\nAsynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nFr_LPduIdx\nThis index is used to uniquely identify a FlexRay frame.\nFr_LSduPtr\nThis reference points to a buffer where the assembled LSdu to be\ntransmitted within this LPdu is stored at.\nParameters (in)\nFr_LSduLength\nDetermines the length of the data (in Bytes) to be transmitted.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nFr_SlotAssignmentPtr\nThis reference points to the memory location where the actual\ncycle, slot ID, and channel of the frame identified by Fr_LPduIdx\nshall be stored. A NULL_PTR indicates that the information is not\nrequired by the caller.\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nTransmits data on the FlexRay network.\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋\nCC precondition for the function Fr_TransmitTxLPdu(): None.\n[SWS_Fr_00224] ⌈The function Fr_TransmitTxLPdu() shall perform the following\ntasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:\n1. Figure out the physical resource (e.g., a buffer) mapped to the transmission of\nthe FlexRay frame identified by Fr_LPduIdx.\n2. If FrExtendedLPduReporting is enabled and Fr_SlotAssignment is not\na NULL pointer, copy expected cycle and slot ID of the transmitted frame to\nFr_SlotAssignment.\n3. If the transmit Lpdu supports dynamic payload length (configuration parame-\nter FrIfAllowDynamicLSduLength is set to true), then the transmission\nresource shall be reconfigured to match the payload length Fr_LsduLength\npassed to the API. Note that the dynamic payload length is only applicable to\nframes within the dynamic FlexRay segment.\n4. Copy Fr_LsduLength bytes from address Fr_LsduPtr into the FlexRay CC’s\ntransmission resource and then activate it for transmission.\n5. Return E_OK.\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00440]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05024\n⌈If a transmit resource is shared between more than 1 Lpdu (using the reconfigu-\nration mechanism of Fr_PrepareLPdu), then the function Fr_TransmitTxLPdu()\nmust ensure that the transmit resource is correctly configured to match the properties\nof Fr_LpduIdx.       "verbatim_text": "8.4.12 Fr_CancelTxLPdu\n[SWS_Fr_00610] Definition of API function Fr_CancelTxLPdu\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05024\n⌈\nService Name\nFr_CancelTxLPdu\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType Fr_CancelTxLPdu (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nuint16 Fr_LPduIdx\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x2d\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nParameters (in)\nFr_LPduIdx\nThis index is used to uniquely identify a FlexRay frame\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nCancels the already pending transmission of a LPdu contained in a controllers physical transmit\nresource (e.g. message buffer).\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋\nCC precondition for the function Fr_CancelTxLPdu(): None.\n[SWS_Fr_00611] ⌈The function Fr_CancelTxLPdu() shall perform the following\ntasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:\n• Figure out the physical resource (e.g., a buffer) mapped to the transmission of\nthe FlexRay frame identified by Fr_LpduIdx.\n• If the physical resource figured out is actively pending for transmission, then the\ntransmit request of this particular resource shall be terminated and E_OK re-\nturned. If no transmission is pending E_NOT_OK shall be returned, indicating\nthat no such cancelation took place.\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00612] ⌈If a transmit resource is shared between more than 1 Lpdu (us-\ning reconfiguration mechanism of Fr_PrepareLPdu()), then the function Fr_Can-\ncelTxLPdu() must ensure that the transmit resource is correctly configured to match\nthe properties of Fr_LpduIdx. This means that if a cancel transmit operation (Fr_\nCancelTxLPdu()) is called for a particular Fr_LpduIdx and the Lpdu shares a single\nbuffer with another Lpdu, then it shall check at the time of service invocation that the\nbuffer is configured according to the Lpdu to be processed.\nThe function Fr_CancelTxLPdu() shall return E_NOT_OK and abort the function exe-\ncution if a wrong configuration is detected.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00613]\n⌈If\nthe\nfunction\nFr_CancelTxLPdu()\nis\nable\nto\nand\ndetects\na\nhardware\nerror\nwhile\nperforming\nthe\nrequested\nfunctionality,\nthen\nit\nshall\ncall\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED) and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00614] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled,\nand if the function Fr_CancelTxLPdu() is called before the successful initializa-\ntion of Fr, then the function Fr_CancelTxLPdu() shall raise the development error\nFR_E_INIT_FAILED.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00615] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_CancelTxLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_CtrlIdx.\nIf Fr_CtrlIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_CancelTxLPdu() shall raise the devel-\nopment error FR_E_INV_CTRL_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00616] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_CancelTxLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_LpduIdx.\nIf Fr_LpduIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_CancelTxLPdu() shall raise the devel-\nopment error FR_E_INV_LPDU_IDX.⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.4.13 Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu\n[SWS_Fr_00093] Definition of API function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05003, SRS_Fr_05024\n⌈\nService Name\nFr_ReceiveRxLPdu\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nuint16 Fr_LPduIdx,\nuint8* Fr_LSduPtr,\nFr_RxLPduStatusType* Fr_LPduStatusPtr,\nuint8* Fr_LSduLengthPtr,\nFr_SlotAssignmentType* Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x0c\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\n▽\n△\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nParameters (in)\nFr_LPduIdx\nThis index is used to uniquely identify a FlexRay frame.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nFr_LSduPtr\nThis reference points to the buffer where the LSdu to be received\nshall be stored.\nFr_LPduStatusPtr\nThis reference points to the memory location where the status of\nthe LPdu shall be stored\nFr_LSduLengthPtr\nThis reference points to the memory location where the length of\nthe LSdu (in bytes) shall be stored. This length represents the\nnumber of bytes copied to Fr_LSduPtr.\nParameters (out)\nFr_SlotAssignmentPtr\nThis reference points to the memory location where the actual\ncycle, slot ID, and channel of the frame identified by Fr_LPduIdx\nshall be stored. A NULL_PTR indicates that the information is not\nrequired by the caller.\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nReceives data from the FlexRay network.\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋\nCC precondition for the function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu(): None.\n[SWS_Fr_00233] ⌈The function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() shall perform the following\ntasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:\n1. Figure out the physical resource (e.g., a buffer, a receive-FIFO) mapped to the\nreception of the FlexRay frame as identified by Fr_LpduIdx.\n2. Figure out whether a new FlexRay frame instance has been received within the\nreceive resource as figured in bullet 1. If the receive resource is a FIFO, then\nconsume the first element out of the FIFO.\n3. If FrExtendedLPduReporting is enabled and Fr_SlotAssignment is not a\nNULL pointer and a new FlexRay frame has been accepted, copy cycle and slot\nID of the frame to Fr_SlotAssignment.\n4. If\na\nnew\nFlexRay\nframe\nhas\nbeen\naccepted,\nthen\ncopy\nthe\nreceived\npayload\ndata\nto\naddress\nFr_LsduPtr,\nstore\nthe\nnumber\nof\nbytes\ncopied\nto\nFr_LsduLengthPtr\nand\nstore\nthe\nstatus\nFR_RECEIVED\nto\nFr_RxLPduStatusPtr. If a FIFO is used as received resource and the FIFO\nis not empty, then store the status FR_RECEIVED_MORE_DATA_AVAILABLE to\nFr_RxLPduStatusPtr.\n5. If no new frame has been accepted, then do not copy any payload data to\nFr_LsduPtr, write 0 to the parameter Fr_LsduLengthPtr and store the sta-\ntus FR_NOT_RECEIVED to Fr_RxLPduStatusPtr.\n6. Return E_OK.\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00441]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05024\n⌈If a receive resource is shared between more than 1 LPdus (using reconfiguration\nmechanism of Fr_PrepareLPdu()), then the function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() must\nensure that the receive resource is correctly configured to match the properties of\nFr_LpduIdx. This means that if a receive operation (Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu()) is called\nfor a particular Fr_LPduIdx and the LPdu shares a single buffer with another LPdu,\nthen it shall check that at the time of service invocation the buffer is configured accord-\ning to the Lpdu to be processed.\nThe function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() shall return E_NOT_OK and abort the function ex-\necution if a wrong buffer configuration is detected.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00234] ⌈The function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() shall ensure that the payload\ndata is copied to Fr_LSduPtr in the same byte order as it was received on the FlexRay\nbus. (first byte = lowest address, last byte = highest address).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00604] ⌈If stringent check is disabled by configuration parameter (Fr-\nRxStringentCheck is false), then received data is accepted if the SlotStatus\nshows a valid frame (vSS!ValidFrame). Otherwise FR_NOT_RECEIVED is written to\nFr_RxLPduStatusPtr and 0 is written to Fr_LSduLengthPtr.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00603] ⌈If stringent check is enabled by configuration parameter (Fr-\nRxStringentCheck is true), then received data is accepted only if the SlotStatus\nshows a valid frame (vSS!ValidFrame) and there was no single SlotStatus error bit set\n(vSS!SyntaxError, vSS!ContentError, vSS!Bviolation). Otherwise FR_NOT_RECEIVED\nis written to Fr_RxLPduStatusPtr and 0 is written to Fr_LsduLengthPtr.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00236]\n⌈The\nfunction\nFr_ReceiveRxLPdu()\nshall\nensure\nthat\nFR_RECEIVED is returned only for non-Nullframes.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00237] ⌈The function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() shall ensure that the function\nreturns FR_RECEIVED only once per received frame.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00645] ⌈If stringent length check is enabled by configuration parameter (\nFrRxStringentLengthCheck is true), then received data is accepted only if the\nreceived payload length exactly matches the expected payload length as provided by\nconfiguration parameter FrIfLSduLength. Otherwise FR_NOT_RECEIVED is written\nto Fr_RxLPduStatusPtr and 0 is written to Fr_LSduLengthPtr .⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00239] ⌈The function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() shall ensure that the number\nof payload bytes copied to Fr_LsduPtr, and therefore the payload length stored to\nFr_LSduLengthPtr are limited both by the received payload length as well as by the\nconfiguration parameter FrIfLSduLength configured in the FrIf.\nThis enables\n• the partly reception of large FlexRay frames (e.g., enables local resource opti-\nmizations, support for transparent frame extensions).\n• the reception of short FlexRay frames.\n(e.g., frames with dynamic payload\nlength).\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00232]\n⌈If\nthe\nfunction\nFr_ReceiveRxLPdu()\nis\nable\nto\nand\ndetects\na\nhardware\nerror\nwhile\nperforming\nthe\nrequested\nfunctionality,\nthen\nit\nshall\ncall\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED) and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00605]\n⌈If\nthe\noptional\nconfiguration\nparameter\nFrIfDemFT-\nSlotStatusRef\nexists\nand\na\nsingle\nslot\nstatus\nerror\nbit\n(vSS!SyntaxError,\nvSS!ContentError, vSS!Bviolation) is set, then the slot status information shall\nbe\nreported\nto\nDEM\nas\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_LPDU_SLOTSTATUS,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00627]\n⌈If\nthe\noptional\nconfiguration\nparameter\nFrIfDemFTSlot-\nStatusRef\nexists\nand\nno\nsingle\nslot\nstatus\nerror\nbit\n(vSS!SyntaxError,\nvSS!ContentError, vSS!Bviolation) is set, then the slot status information shall\nbe\nreported\nto\nDEM\nas\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_LPDU_SLOTSTATUS,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_PASSED).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00628] ⌈Dem_SetEventStatus() shall only be called if the optional con-\nfiguration parameter FrIfDemFTSlotStatusRef exists.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00226] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, and\nif the function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() is called before the successful initialization\nof Fr, then the function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() shall raise the development error\nFR_E_INIT_FAILED.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00227] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_CtrlIdx.\nIf Fr_CtrlIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() shall raise the de-\nvelopment error FR_E_INV_CTRL_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00228] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_LpduIdx.\nIf Fr_LpduIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() shall raise the de-\nvelopment error FR_E_INV_LPDU_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00229] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then\nthe function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu() shall check whether the parameter Fr_LsduPtr\nis a NULL pointer (NULL_PTR).       "verbatim_text": "8.4.14 Fr_CheckTxLPduStatus\n[SWS_Fr_00094] Definition of API function Fr_CheckTxLPduStatus\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05003, SRS_Fr_05024\n⌈\nService Name\nFr_CheckTxLPduStatus\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType* Fr_CheckTxLPduStatus (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nuint16 Fr_LPduIdx,\nFr_TxLPduStatusType* Fr_TxLPduStatusPtr,\nFr_SlotAssignmentType* Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x0d\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nParameters (in)\nFr_LPduIdx\nThis index is used to uniquely identify a FlexRay frame\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nFr_TxLPduStatusPtr\nThis reference is used to store the transmit status of the LPdu\nParameters (out)\nFr_SlotAssignmentPtr\nThis reference points to the memory location where the actual\ncycle, slot ID, and channel of the frame identified by Fr_LPduIdx\nshall be stored. A NULL_PTR indicates that the information is not\nrequired by the caller.\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType*\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nChecks the transmit status of the LSdu.\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋\nCC precondition for the function Fr_CheckTxLPduStatus(): None.\n[SWS_Fr_00244] ⌈The function Fr_CheckTxLPduStatus() shall perform the follow-\ning tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:\n1. Figure out the physical resource (e.g., a buffer) mapped to the transmission of\nthe FlexRay frame identified by Fr_LpduIdx.\n2. Check whether the transmission resource as figured in bullet 1 is pending for\ntransmission3 and if a TX conflict (vss!TxConflict) occurred for this resource.\n3. If FrExtendedLPduReporting is enabled and Fr_SlotAssignment is\nnot a NULL pointer,\ncopy cycle and slot ID of the checked frame to\nFr_SlotAssignment.\n4. If\na\ntransmission\nrequest\nis\npending,\nthen\nstore\nthe\nstatus\nFR_NOT_TRANSMITTED to Fr_TxLPduStatusPtr.\n5. If no transmission request is pending and no TX conflict occurred, then store the\nstatus FR_TRANSMITTED to Fr_TxLPduStatusPtr.\n6. If no transmission request is pending and a TX conflict occurred, then store the\nstatus FR_TRANSMITTED_CONFLICT to Fr_TxLPduStatusPtr.\n7. Return E_OK.\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00243]\n⌈If\nthe\nfunction\nFr_CheckTxLPduStatus()\nis\nable\nto\nand\ndetects\na\nhardware\nerror\nwhile\nperforming\nthe\nrequested\nfunctional-\nity,\nthen\nit\nshall\ncall\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED) and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00606]\n⌈If\nthe\noptional\nconfiguration\nparameter\nFrIfDemFT-\nSlotStatusRef\nexists\nand\na\nsingle\nslot\nstatus\nerror\nbit\n(vSS!SyntaxError,\nvSS!ContentError, vSS!Bviolation) is set, then the slot status information shall\nbe\nreported\nto\nDEM\nas\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_LPDU_SLOTSTATUS,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00629]\n⌈If\nthe\noptional\nconfiguration\nparameter\nFrIfDemFTSlot-\nStatusRef\nexists\nand\nno\nsingle\nslot\nstatus\nerror\nbit\n(vSS!SyntaxError,\nvSS!ContentError, vSS!Bviolation) is set, then the slot status information shall\nbe\nreported\nto\nDEM\nas\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_LPDU_SLOTSTATUS,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_PASSED).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00630] ⌈Dem_SetEventStatus() shall be called only if the optional con-\nfiguration parameter FrIfDemFTSlotStatusRef exists.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00240] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, and if\nthe function Fr_CheckTxLPduStatus() is called before the successful initialization\nof Fr, then the function Fr_CheckTxLPduStatus() shall raise the development error\nFR_E_INIT_FAILED.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00241] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then\nthe function Fr_CheckTxLPduStatus() shall check the validity of the parameter\n3The returned status does not check whether a transmission has been really performed, but returns\nwhether a transmission resource is empty or not.\nFr_CtrlIdx.       "verbatim_text": "8.4.15 Fr_PrepareLPdu\n[SWS_Fr_00107] Definition of API function Fr_PrepareLPdu\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05106\n⌈\nService Name\nFr_PrepareLPdu\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType Fr_PrepareLPdu (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nuint16 Fr_LPduIdx\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x1f\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nParameters (in)\nFr_LPduIdx\nThis index is used to uniquely identify a FlexRay frame\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nPrepares a LPdu.\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋\nCC precondition for the function Fr_PrepareLPdu(): None.\n[SWS_Fr_00249] ⌈The function Fr_PrepareLPdu() shall perform the following tasks\non FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:\n1. Figure out the physical resource (e.g., a buffer) mapped to the processing of the\nFlexRay frame identified by Fr_LpduIdx.\n2. Configure the physical resource (a buffer) appropriate for Fr_LpduIdx opera-\ntion (SlotId, Cycle filter, payload length, header CRC, etc.) if the MCG uses the\nreconfiguration feature4.\n3. Return E_OK.\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00250] ⌈The function Fr_PrepareLPdu() shall be pre compile time config-\nurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: FrPrepareLPduSupport.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00248]\n⌈If\nthe\nfunction\nFr_PrepareLPdu()\nis\nable\nto\nand\ndetects\na\nhardware\nerror\nwhile\nperforming\nthe\nrequested\nfunctionality,\nthen\nit\nshall\ncall\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED) and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00245] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled,\nand if the function Fr_PrepareLPdu() is called before the successful initializa-\ntion of Fr, then the function Fr_PrepareLPdu() shall raise the development error\nFR_E_INIT_FAILED.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00246] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_PrepareLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_CtrlIdx. If\nFr_CtrlIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_PrepareLPdu() shall raise the develop-\nment error FR_E_INV_CTRL_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00247] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_PrepareLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_LpduIdx. If\nFr_LpduIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_PrepareLPdu() shall raise the develop-\nment error FR_E_INV_LPDU_IDX.⌋\n4If the MCG decides to save message buffers using message buffer reconfiguration it assigns two\ndifferent LPdus ( A and B) a single message buffer X. Each LPdu is linked to a (different) FrameTriggering\nconfiguration which contains the slot/cycle/channel assignment. Depending whether LPdu A or B is\npassed to Fr_PrepareLPdu(), the message buffer X is configured according to the slot/cycle/channel\nassignment of the related LPdu."

      "verbatim_text": "8.4.16 Fr_ReconfigLPdu\n[SWS_Fr_00524] Definition of API function Fr_ReconfigLPdu\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05059\n⌈\nService Name\nFr_ReconfigLPdu\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType Fr_ReconfigLPdu (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nuint16 Fr_LPduIdx,\nuint16 Fr_FrameId,\nFr_ChannelType Fr_ChnlIdx,\nuint8 Fr_CycleRepetition,\nuint8 Fr_CycleOffset,\nuint8 Fr_PayloadLength,\nuint16 Fr_HeaderCRC\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x25\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nFr_LPduIdx\nThis index is used to uniquely identify a FlexRay frame\nFr_FrameId\nFlexRay Frame ID the FrIf_LPdu shall be configured to.\nFr_ChnlIdx\nFlexRay Channel the FrIf_LPdu shall be configured to.\nFr_CycleRepetition\nCycle Repetition part of the cycle filter mechanism FrIf_LPdu\nshall be configured to.\nFr_CycleOffset\nCycle Offset part of the cycle filter mechanism FrIf_LPdu shall be\nconfigured to.\nFr_PayloadLength\nPayloadlength in units of bytes the FrIf_LPduIdx shall be\nconfigured to.\nParameters (in)\nFr_HeaderCRC\nHeader CRC the FrIf_LPdu shall be configured to.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nReconfigures a given LPdu according to the parameters (FrameId, Channel, CycleRepetition,\nCycleOffset, PayloadLength, HeaderCRC) at runtime.\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋\nCC precondition for the function Fr_ReconfigLPdu(): None.\n[SWS_Fr_00525] ⌈The function Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall perform the following\ntasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:\n• Figure out the physical resource (e.g., a buffer) mapped to the processing of the\nFlexRay frame as identified by Fr_LpduIdx.\n• Configure the physical resource (a buffer) according to the parameters given at\nthe API. The Lpdu direction is statically associated with the Lpdu and cannot be\nchanged by this service.\n• Return E_OK.\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00526] ⌈Whether an Lpdu is dynamically reconfigurable is determined via\nthe configuration parameter FrIfReconfigurable which is a property of the FrI-\nfLPdu configuration parameter container.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00527] ⌈Since FlexRay supports only even number of bytes as payload\nlength, the parameter Fr_PayloadLength must be internally rounded to the next\nhigher even number if it is odd.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00528] ⌈The function Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall be pre compile time con-\nfigurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: FrReconfigLPduSupport.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00529]\n⌈If\nthe\nfunction\nFr_ReconfigLPdu()\nis\nable\nto\nand\ndetects\na\nhardware\nerror\nwhile\nperforming\nthe\nrequested\nfunctionality,\nthen\nit\nshall\ncall\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED) and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00530] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled,\nand if the function Fr_ReconfigLPdu() is called before the successful initializa-\ntion of Fr, then the function Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall raise the development error\nFR_E_INIT_FAILED.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00531] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_CtrlIdx.\nIf Fr_CtrlIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall raise the devel-\nopment error FR_E_INV_CTRL_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00532] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_LpduIdx.\nIf Fr_LpduIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall raise the devel-\nopment error FR_E_INV_LPDU_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00533] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_ChnlIdx.\nIf Fr_ChnlIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall raise the devel-\nopment error FR_E_INV_CHNL_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00534] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled,\nthen the function Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter\nFr_CycleRepetition. If Fr_CycleRepetition is invalid, then the function Fr_Re-\nconfigLPdu() shall raise the development error FR_E_INV_CYCLE.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00535] ⌈Valid values5 for parameter Fr_CycleRepetition are 1, 2, 4, 5,\n8, 10, 16, 20, 32, 40, 50 and 64.⌋\n5For FlexRay Controllers compliant to [2] only cycle repetition values 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64 shall\nbe supported.\n[SWS_Fr_00536] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then\nthe function Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall check the parameter Fr_CycleOffset for\nbeing valid. If Fr_CycleOffset is invalid, then the function Fr_ReconfigLPdu()\nshall raise the development error FR_E_INV_CYCLE.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00537]\n⌈Valid\nvalues\nfor\nparameter\nFr_CycleOffset\nare\n0\nto\n(\nFr_CycleRepetition - 1).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00538] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled,\nthen the function Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter\nFr_PayloadLength. If Fr_PayloadLength is invalid, then the function Fr_Re-\nconfigLPdu() shall raise the development error FR_E_INV_LENGTH.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00634] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then\nthe function Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall check the parameter Fr_HeaderCRC for being\nvalid6. If Fr_HeaderCRC is invalid, then the function Fr_ReconfigLPdu() shall raise\nthe development error FR_E_INV_HEADERCRC.⌋"

Figure out the physical resource (e.g., a buffer) mapped to the processing of the\nFlexRay frame identified by Fr_LpduIdx.\n2. Return E_OK.\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00541] ⌈Only Lpdus that can be dynamically reconfigured can be disabled\nby this service (see Fr_ReconfigLPdu()).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00542] ⌈The function Fr_DisableLPdu() shall be pre compile time config-\nurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: FrDisableLPduSupport.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00543]\n⌈If\nthe\nfunction\nFr_DisableLPdu()\nis\nable\nto\nand\ndetects\na\nhardware\nerror\nwhile\nperforming\nthe\nrequested\nfunctionality,\nthen\nit\nshall\ncall\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED) and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00544] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled,\nand if the function Fr_DisableLPdu() is called before the successful initializa-\ntion of Fr, then the function Fr_DisableLPdu() shall raise the development error\nFR_E_INIT_FAILED and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00545] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_DisableLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_CtrlIdx. If\nFr_CtrlIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_DisableLPdu() shall raise the develop-\nment error FR_E_INV_CTRL_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00546] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_DisableLPdu() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_LpduIdx.     },

      "verbatim_text": "8.4.18 Fr_GetGlobalTime\n[SWS_Fr_00042] Definition of API function Fr_GetGlobalTime\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05019\n⌈\nService Name\nFr_GetGlobalTime\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType Fr_GetGlobalTime (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nuint8* Fr_CyclePtr,\nuint16* Fr_MacroTickPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x10\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\nParameters (in)\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nFr_CyclePtr\nAddress where the current FlexRay communication cycle value\nshall be stored.\nParameters (out)\nFr_MacroTickPtr\nAddress where the current macrotick value shall be stored.\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nGets the current global FlexRay time.\nImportant Note: Fr_GetGlobalTime may be called within an exclusive area.\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋\nNote: The Fr module’s environment shall only call Fr_GetGlobalTime() if the CC\nFr_CtrlIdx is synchronous to FlexRay global time.\n[SWS_Fr_00256] ⌈The function Fr_GetGlobalTime() shall perform the following\ntasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:\n1. Read the current global FlexRay time and write it to the output parameters\nFr_CyclePtr and Fr_MacrotickPtr.\n2. Return E_OK.\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00257] ⌈The function Fr_GetGlobalTime() shall ensure that the time in-\nformation is consistent and valid. This means that the values returned of both param-\neters (Fr_CyclePtr and Fr_MacrotickPtr) must be taken from a single point in\ntime. The resulting global time shall always strictly increase over time (until it wraps\naround at the time-boundary).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00044]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05072\n⌈The function Fr_GetGlobalTime() shall ensure that the time information is valid and\nup to date (synchronized CC), - otherwise the output parameters shall not be written\nand E_NOT_OK returned.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00255]\n⌈If\nthe\nfunction\nFr_GetGlobalTime()\nis\nable\nto\nand\ndetects\na\nhardware\nerror\nwhile\nperforming\nthe\nrequested\nfunctionality,\nthen\nit\nshall\ncall\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED) and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00251] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, and\nif the function Fr_GetGlobalTime() is called before the successful initialization\nof Fr, then the function Fr_GetGlobalTime() shall raise the development error\nFR_E_INIT_FAILED.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00252] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_GetGlobalTime() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_CtrlIdx.\nIf Fr_CtrlIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_GetGlobalTime() shall raise the de-\nvelopment error FR_E_INV_CTRL_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00253] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then\nthe function Fr_GetGlobalTime() shall check whether the parameter Fr_CyclePtr\nis a NULL pointer (NULL_PTR). If Fr_CyclePtr is a NULL pointer, the function Fr_\nGetGlobalTime() shall raise the development error FR_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00254]\n⌈If\ndevelopment\nerror\ndetection\nfor\nthe\nFr\nmodule\nis\nen-\nabled, then the function Fr_GetGlobalTime() shall check whether the parame-\nter Fr_MacroTickPtr is a NULL pointer (NULL_PTR). If Fr_MacroTickPtr is a\nNULL pointer, the function Fr_GetGlobalTime() shall raise the development error\nFR_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.4.19 Fr_GetNmVector\n[SWS_Fr_00113] Definition of API function Fr_GetNmVector ⌈\nService Name\nFr_GetNmVector\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType Fr_GetNmVector (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nuint8* Fr_NmVectorPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x22\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\nParameters (in)\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nFr_NmVectorPtr\nAddress where the NmVector of the last communication cycle\nshall be stored.\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nGets the network management vector of the last communication cycle.\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋\nNote: The Fr module’s environment shall only call the function Fr_GetNmVector()\nwhen the CC Fr_CtrlIdx is synchronous to FlexRay global time.\nNote: The NM-Vector will be updated at a defined point in time (see [1]). At this point of\ntime the service Fr_GetNmVector() shall not be called, in order to ensure a consistent\nNM-Vector value.\n[SWS_Fr_00262] ⌈The function Fr_GetNmVector() shall perform the following tasks\non FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:\n1. Read the current accrued network management vector out of the FlexRay CC and\nthen write it to the output parameter Fr_NmVectorPtr. The number of bytes\nwritten to the output parameter is constant and is known at configuration time\n(FrIf configuration parameter FrIfGNetworkManagementVectorLength).\n2. Return E_OK.\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00263] ⌈The function Fr_GetNmVector() shall ensure that the FlexRay CC\nis synchronous to global time when the data is read - otherwise the output parameters\nshall not be written and E_NOT_OK returned.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00264] ⌈The function Fr_GetNmVector() shall ensure that the payload\ndata is copied to Fr_NmVectorPtr in the same byte order as they were received\non the FlexRay bus. (first byte = lowest address, last byte = highest address).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00261]\n⌈If\nthe\nfunction\nFr_GetNmVector()\nis\nable\nto\nand\ndetects\na\nhardware\nerror\nwhile\nperforming\nthe\nrequested\nfunctionality,\nthen\nit\nshall\ncall\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED) and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00258] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled,\nand if the function Fr_GetNmVector() is called before the successful initializa-\ntion of Fr, then the function Fr_GetNmVector() shall raise the development error\nFR_E_INIT_FAILED.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00259] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_GetNmVector() shall check the validity of the parameter Fr_CtrlIdx. If\nFr_CtrlIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_GetNmVector() shall raise the develop-\nment error FR_E_INV_CTRL_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00260] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the\nfunction Fr_GetNmVector() shall check whether the parameter Fr_NmVectorPtr is\na NULL pointer (NULL_PTR). If Fr_NmVectorPtr is a NULL pointer, then the function\nFr_GetNmVector() shall raise the development error FR_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.4.20 Fr_GetNumOfStartupFrames\n[SWS_Fr_00547] Definition of API function Fr_GetNumOfStartupFrames ⌈\nService Name\nFr_GetNumOfStartupFrames\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType Fr_GetNumOfStartupFrames (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nuint8* Fr_NumOfStartupFramesPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x27\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\nParameters (in)\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nFr_NumOfStartupFrames\nPtr\nAddress where the number of startup frames seen within the last\neven/odd cycle pair shall be stored.\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nGets the current number of startup frames seen on the cluster. See variable vStartupPairs of\n[12] for details.\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋"

    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FR_SECTION_8_4_21_Fr_GetChannelStatus",

      "verbatim_text": "8.4.21 Fr_GetChannelStatus\n[SWS_Fr_00556] Definition of API function Fr_GetChannelStatus ⌈\nService Name\nFr_GetChannelStatus\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType Fr_GetChannelStatus (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nuint16* Fr_ChannelAStatusPtr,\nuint16* Fr_ChannelBStatusPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x28\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\nParameters (in)\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nFr_ChannelAStatusPtr\nAddress where the bitcoded channel A status information shall be\nstored.\nParameters (out)\nFr_ChannelBStatusPtr\nAddress where the bitcoded channel B status information shall be\nstored.\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nGets the channel status information.\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋\nNote: The Fr module’s environment shall only call Fr_GetChannelStatus() if the CC\nFr_CtrlIdx is synchronous to FlexRay global time.\n[SWS_Fr_00558] ⌈The function Fr_GetChannelStatus() shall perform the following\ntasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:\n1. Read\nthe\naggregated\nchannel\nstatus,\nNIT\nstatus,\nsymbol\nwindow\nsta-\ntus\nand\nwrite\nit\nto\nthe\noutput\nparameter\nFr_ChannelAStatusPtr/\nFr_ChannelBStatusPtr.\nThe\nvalue\nof\n*Fr_ChannelAStatusPtr/\n*Fr_ChannelBStatusPtr is bitcoded with the following meaning (Bit 0 =\nLSB, Bit 15 = MSB)8:\nBit 0 Channel A/B aggregated channel status vSS!ValidFrame\nBit 1 Channel A/B aggregated channel status vSS!SyntaxError\nBit 2 Channel A/B aggregated channel status vSS!ContentError\nBit 3 Channel A/B aggregated channel status additional communication\nBit 4 Channel A/B aggregated channel status vSS!Bviolation\nBit 5 Channel A/B aggregated channel status vSS!TxConflict\nBit 6 Not used (0)\nBit 7 Not used (0)\nBit 8 Channel A/B symbol window status data vSS!ValidMTS\nBit 9 Channel A/B symbol window status data vSS!SyntaxError\nBit 10 Channel A/B symbol window status data vSS!Bviolation\nBit 11 Channel A/B symbol window status data vSS!TxConflict\nBit 12 Channel A/B NIT status data vSS!SyntaxError\nBit 13 Channel A/B NIT status data vSS!Bviolation\nBit 14 Not used (0)\nBit 15 Not used (0)\n2. Reset the aggregated channel status information within the FlexRay controller.\n3. Return E_OK.\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00559] ⌈The function Fr_GetChannelStatus() shall ensure that the in-\nformation is valid and up to date (synchronized CC) - otherwise the output parameters\nshall not be written and E_NOT_OK returned.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00560]\n⌈If\nthe\nfunction\nFr_GetChannelStatus()\nis\nable\nto\nand\ndetects\na\nhardware\nerror\nwhile\nperforming\nthe\nrequested\nfunctional-\nity,\nthen\nit\nshall\ncall\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED) and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n8Bit 5 and Bit 11 shall be set to 0 for FlexRay 2.1 compliant controllers, since vSS!TxConflict is not\nsupported on this hardware.\n[SWS_Fr_00561] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, and\nif the function Fr_GetChannelStatus() is called before the successful initialization\nof Fr, then the function Fr_GetChannelStatus() shall raise the development error\nFR_E_INIT_FAILED.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00562] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then\nthe function Fr_GetChannelStatus() shall check the validity of the parameter\nFr_CtrlIdx. If Fr_CtrlIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_GetChannelStatus()\nshall raise the development error FR_E_INV_CTRL_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00563]\n⌈If\ndevelopment\nerror\ndetection\nfor\nthe\nFr\nmodule\nis\nen-\nabled,\nthen\nthe\nfunction\nFr_GetChannelStatus()\nshall\ncheck\nwhether\nthe\nparameter\nFr_ChannelAStatusPtr\nis\na\nNULL\npointer\n(NULL_PTR).\nIf\nFr_ChannelAStatusPtr is a NULL pointer, then the function Fr_GetChan-\nnelStatus() shall raise the development error FR_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00607]\n⌈If\ndevelopment\nerror\ndetection\nfor\nthe\nFr\nmodule\nis\nen-\nabled,\nthen\nthe\nfunction\nFr_GetChannelStatus()\nshall\ncheck\nwhether\nthe\nparameter\nFr_ChannelBStatusPtr\nis\na\nNULL\npointer\n(NULL_PTR).\nIf\nFr_ChannelBStatusPtr is a NULL pointer, then the function Fr_GetChan-\nnelStatus() shall raise the development error FR_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.4.22 Fr_GetClockCorrection\n[SWS_Fr_00564] Definition of API function Fr_GetClockCorrection ⌈\nService Name\nFr_GetClockCorrection\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType Fr_GetClockCorrection (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nsint16* Fr_RateCorrectionPtr,\nsint32* Fr_OffsetCorrectionPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x29\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\nParameters (in)\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nFr_RateCorrectionPtr\nAddress where the current rate correction value shall be stored.\nParameters (out)\nFr_OffsetCorrectionPtr\nAddress where the current offset correction value shall be stored.\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nGets the current clock correction values. See variables vInterimRateCorrection and vInterim\nOffsetCorrection of [12] for details.\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋\n9,10\n9vInterimRate Correction maps to vRateCorrection for FlexRay 2.1 compliant controllers, see [2]\n10vInterimOffsetCorrection maps to vOffsetCorrection for FlexRay 2.1 compliant controllers, see [2]\n[SWS_Fr_00566] ⌈The function Fr_GetClockCorrection() shall perform the fol-\nlowing tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:\n1.       "verbatim_text": "8.4.23 Fr_GetSyncFrameList\n[SWS_Fr_00573] Definition of API function Fr_GetSyncFrameList ⌈\nService Name\nFr_GetSyncFrameList\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType Fr_GetSyncFrameList (\nuint8 Fr_CtrlIdx,\nuint8 Fr_ListSize,\nuint16* Fr_ChannelAEvenListPtr,\nuint16* Fr_ChannelBEvenListPtr,\nuint16* Fr_ChannelAOddListPtr,\nuint16* Fr_ChannelBOddListPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x2a\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant for the same device\nFr_CtrlIdx\nIndex of FlexRay CC within the context of the FlexRay Driver.\nParameters (in)\nFr_ListSize\nSize of the arrays passed via parameters: Fr_ChannelAEvenList\nPtr Fr_ChannelBEvenListPtr Fr_ChannelAOddListPtr Fr_Channel\nBOddListPtr. The service must ensure to not write more entries\ninto those arrays than granted by this parameter.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nFr_ChannelAEvenListPtr\nAddress the list of syncframes on channel A within the even\ncommunication cycle is written to. The exact number of elements\nwritten to the list is limited by parameter Fr_ListSize. Unused list\nelements are filled with the value ’0’ to indicate that no more\nsyncframe has been seen.\nFr_ChannelBEvenListPtr\nAddress the list of syncframes on channel B within the even\ncommunication cycle is written to. The exact number of elements\nwritten to the list is limited by parameter Fr_ListSize. Unused list\nelements are filled with the value ’0’ to indicate that no more\nsyncframe has been seen.\nFr_ChannelAOddListPtr\nAddress the list of syncframes on channel A within the odd\ncommunication cycle is written to. The exact number of elements\nwritten to the list is limited by parameter Fr_ListSize. Unused list\nelements are filled with the value ’0’ to indicate that no more\nsyncframe has been seen.\nParameters (out)\nFr_ChannelBOddListPtr\nAddress the list of syncframes on channel B within the odd\ncommunication cycle is written to. The exact number of elements\nwritten to the list is limited by parameter Fr_ListSize. Unused list\nelements are filled with the value ’0’ to indicate that no more\nsyncframe has been seen.\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: API call finished successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: API call aborted due to errors.\nDescription\nGets a list of syncframes received or transmitted on channel A and channel B via the even and\nodd communication cycle. See variables vsSyncIdListA and vsSyncIdListB of [12] for details.\nAvailable via\nFr.h\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00575] ⌈The function Fr_GetSyncFrameList() shall perform the following\ntasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:\n1. Read\nthe\nlist\nof\nsyncframes\nreceived\nin\nthe\nlast\neven\ncommunication\ncycle\non\nchannel\nA\nand\nwrite\nit\nas\narray\nto\nthe\nmemory\nlocation\nFr_ChannelAEvenListPtr.\n2. Read\nthe\nlist\nof\nsyncframes\nreceived\nin\nthe\nlast\neven\ncommunication\ncycle\non\nchannel\nB\nand\nwrite\nit\nas\narray\nto\nthe\nmemory\nlocation\nFr_ChannelBEvenListPtr.\n3. Read the list of syncframes received in the last odd communication cycle on chan-\nnel A and write it as array to the memory location Fr_ChannelAOddListPtr.\n4. Read the list of syncframes received in the last odd communication cycle on chan-\nnel B and write it as array to the memory location Fr_ChannelBOddListPtr.\n5. Return E_OK.\n⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00576] ⌈The size of the array written to Fr_ChannelAEvenListPtr,\nFr_ChannelBEvenListPtr,\nFr_ChannelAOddListPtr\nand\nFr_ChannelBOddListPtr shall be limited to Fr_ListSize (array elements 0\nto (Fr_ListSize - 1)).⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00577] ⌈Unused array elements shall be set to 0, indicating no valid sync\nframe.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00578] ⌈A maximum number of 15 syncframes shall be supported.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00580]\n⌈If\nthe\nfunction\nFr_GetSyncFrameList()\nis\nable\nto\nand\ndetects\na\nhardware\nerror\nwhile\nperforming\nthe\nrequested\nfunctional-\nity,\nthen\nit\nshall\ncall\nDem_SetEventStatus()\n(FR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT,\nDEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED) and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00581] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, and\nif the function Fr_GetSyncFrameList() is called before the successful initialization\nof Fr, then the function Fr_GetSyncFrameList() shall raise the development error\nFR_E_INIT_FAILED.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00582] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then\nthe function Fr_GetSyncFrameList() shall check the validity of the parameter\nFr_CtrlIdx. If Fr_CtrlIdx is invalid, then the function Fr_GetSyncFrameList()\nshall raise the development error FR_E_INV_CTRL_IDX.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00667] ⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled,\nthen the function Fr_GetSyncFrameList() shall check the validity of the parame-\nter Fr_ListSize. If Fr_ListSize is larger than 15, then the function Fr_Get-\nSyncFrameList() shall raise the development error FR_E_INV_FRAMELIST_SIZE.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00583]\n⌈If\ndevelopment\nerror\ndetection\nfor\nthe\nFr\nmodule\nis\nen-\nabled,\nthen\nthe\nfunction\nFr_GetSyncFrameList()\nshall\ncheck\nwhether\nthe\nparameter\nFr_ChannelAEvenListPtr\nis\na\nNULL\npointer\n(NULL_PTR).\nIf\nFr_ChannelAEvenListPtr\nis\na\nNULL\npointer,\nthen\nthe\nfunction\nFr_Get-\nSyncFrameList() shall raise the development error FR_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00584]\n⌈If\ndevelopment\nerror\ndetection\nfor\nthe\nFr\nmodule\nis\nen-\nabled,\nthen\nthe\nfunction\nFr_GetSyncFrameList()\nshall\ncheck\nwhether\nthe\nparameter\nFr_ChannelBEvenListPtr\nis\na\nNULL\npointer\n(NULL_PTR).\nIf\nFr_ChannelBEvenListPtr\nis\na\nNULL\npointer,\nthen\nthe\nfunction\nFr_Get-\nSyncFrameList() shall raise the development error FR_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00585]\n⌈If\ndevelopment\nerror\ndetection\nfor\nthe\nFr\nmodule\nis\nen-\nabled,\nthen\nthe\nfunction\nFr_GetSyncFrameList()\nshall\ncheck\nwhether\nthe\nparameter\nFr_ChannelAOddListPtr\nis\na\nNULL\npointer\n(NULL_PTR).\nIf\nFr_ChannelAOddListPtr\nis\na\nNULL\npointer,\nthen\nthe\nfunction\nFr_Get-\nSyncFrameList() shall raise the development error FR_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋\n[SWS_Fr_00586]\n⌈If\ndevelopment\nerror\ndetection\nfor\nthe\nFr\nmodule\nis\nen-\nabled,\nthen\nthe\nfunction\nFr_GetSyncFrameList()\nshall\ncheck\nwhether\nthe\nparameter\nFr_ChannelBOddListPtr\nis\na\nNULL\npointer\n(NULL_PTR).\nIf\nFr_ChannelBOddListPtr\nis\na\nNULL\npointer,\nthen\nthe\nfunction\nFr_Get-\nSyncFrameList() shall raise the development error FR_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋"
