      "verbatim_text": "7.4.3 Transmission mode\n[SWS_FrTSyn_00026]\n⌈If\nFrTSyn_SetTransmissionMode(Controller,\nMode)is called and parameter Mode equals FRTSYN_TX_OFF, all transmit requests\nfrom FrTSyn shall be omitted on this FlexRay channel.⌋(RS_TS_20039, RS_TS_-\n20043, RS_TS_20044)\n[SWS_FrTSyn_00027]\n⌈If\nFrTSyn_SetTransmissionMode(Controller,\nMode) is called and parameter Mode equals FRTSYN_TX_ON, all transmit requests\nfrom FrTSyn on this FlexRay channel shall be able to be transmitted.⌋(RS_TS_20039,\nRS_TS_20043, RS_TS_20044)"

      "verbatim_text": "7.4.6 Sending and Receiving within the same connection\n[SWS_FrArTp_00094] ⌈The FrArTp shall be implemented to support both sending\nand receiving within one connection. So the same connection can be utilized for\nsending and receiving.⌋()\nTo explain it more in detail, imagine a connection being in idle state. If now the call\nFrArTp_Transmit() occurs, the local peer becomes the sender in this connection\n(Source Address of TP frame = FrArTpLa, Target Address of TP frame = FrArTpRa).\nOtherwise, if an FrArTp_RxIndication() occurred for an N-PDU which is mapped on\nthe N-SDU of this connection, it would become the receiver (Source Address of TP\nframe = FrArTpRa, Target Address of TP frame = FrArTpLa).\nThis feature is intended for connections in which sometimes one peer has to send\ndata and sometimes the other in order not to need two connections in this case."
    },

      "verbatim_text": "7.4 Implementation Requirements\n[SWS_FrIf_05096] ⌈The FlexRay Interface executable code (however, not the config-\nuration used during runtime) shall be completely independent of the FlexRay Commu-\nnication Controller(s) and the FlexRay Transceiver(s).⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05069]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00404, SRS_BSW_00345\n⌈The FrIf module shall support pre-compile time, link-time and post-build-time configu-\nration.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05284] ⌈The FrIf module shall implement link-time and post-build-time con-\nfiguration data as read-only data structures.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05285] ⌈The FrIf module shall immediately reference link-time configura-\ntion data by the implementation,⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05078]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00342\n⌈The FrIf module shall implement the API functions specified by the FrIf SWS as real\nC code functions and shall not implement the API functions as macros.⌋\nNote:The rationale of SWS_FrIf_05078 is to allow object code module integration.\n[SWS_FrIf_05244] ⌈The FrIf module shall pad transmitted PDUs that are located on a\nFrIf L-Sdu where FrIfAllowDynamicLSduLength is set to false, if the size is smaller than\nthe configured size of the PDU. Padding shall be done with the configured FrIfUnused\nBitValue.⌋"

      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.4 Mirroring to FlexRay, IP, and CDD\nWhen mirroring to a FlexRay destination bus, a CAN XL destination bus, an IP destina-\ntion bus like Ethernet, or a proprietary network connected as CDD, the Bus Mirroring\nmodule applies a protocol to pack several smaller frames into one large frame of the\ndestination bus.\nThe first section of this chapter (section 7.4.1) defines how the Bus Mirroring module\nplaces the source frames onto a destination frame using the mirroring protocol, and\nhow the queueing is applied before transmitting a destination frames.\nThe second section (section 7.4.2) shows the exact layout of the protocol and the\nmeaning and usage of the fields in the protocol."
    },

      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.4 Serialized Mirroring\nWhen mirroring to a serialized CAN FD destination bus, a FlexRay destina-\ntion bus, a CAN XL destination bus, an IP destination bus like Ethernet,\nor a proprietary network connected as CDD, the Bus Mirroring module applies\na protocol to pack several smaller frames into one large frame of the destination\nbus.\nThe first sub section of this section (Chapter 7.4.1) defines how the Bus Mirroring\nmodule places the source frames onto a destination frame using the mirroring protocol,\nand how the queueing is applied before transmitting a destination frames.\nThe second section (Chapter 7.4.2) shows the exact layout of the protocol and the\nmeaning and usage of the fields in the protocol."
    },

      "verbatim_text": "7.5.1.4 RX_ERROR\nThe RX_ERROR8 flag is required in case transmission with acknowledgement and\nretry is configured. During a segmented data reception an error could occur but send-\ning FlowControl is currently not possible. In that case the information about an error\nhas to be stored until sending a FlowControl is allowed.\n[SWS_FrTp_00428] A RX error flag per every FrTp channel ⌈The RX_ERROR flag\nshall exist for every FrTpChannel.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_00429] RX error flag use case ⌈The RX_ERROR flag shall indicate that\nan error occurred during a segmented reception.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_00430] RX error flag clearing ⌈The RX_ERROR flag shall be cleared\nafter the reaction (Retry, Negative Acknowledgement, abortion).⌋"
    },

Continue at Step 8\nt\nt\nt\nt\nFigure 7.6: in ’Immediate Buffer Access’ mode\nFigure 7.6 depicts the internal processing for data transmission in principle9 if \"Imme-\ndiate Buffer Access\" mode is configured10. Below there is a description of the different\nsteps which are necessary to transmit data via FrTp.\nStep 1 - 4\n[SWS_FrTp_00136]FrTp transmit initiation by upper layer ⌈Sending Fr N-SDU data\nshall always be initiated by the service primitive call of FrTp_Transmit.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01043] Detection for transmission with unknown or known message\nlength ⌈The FrTp module shall evaluate the value of PduInfoType.SduLength:\n9Figure 7.6 depicts only the overview of data transmission for a single channel without further func-\ntionality (e.g. transmit cancellation) or internal behaviour (e.g. internal control data handling, return\nvalues, etc.). Also a schedule for data transfer in concurrent channels is not described here.\n10Buffer access mode is configured for each N-PDU and is referenced via the PDU-Pool.\n• SduLength = 0: Transmission with unknown message length is requested\n• SduLength̸ = 0: Transmission with known message length is requested.\n⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01044] Handling of TX SDU unknown message length flag ⌈If sup-\nport unknown message length is configured the FrTp module shall set the flag\nTX_SDU_UNKNOWN_MSG_LENGTH according to the result of [SWS_FrTp_01043].⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01134] Handling of development error for unknown message length\n⌈The FRTP module shall raise an development error FRTP_E_UMSG_LENGTH_ERROR\nwhen\n1. a transmission with unknown message length is detected and\n2. support of unknown message legth is not configured and\n3. development error detection is enabled for the FrTp module.\n⌋\nThe service primitive parameter TxPduId shall be used to select the correct connection.\nThis shall be done by searching for the correct entry within the FrTpConnection\ncontainer (FrTpConnection.FrTpTxSduId). If a valid parameter TxPduId is given,\nthe FrTp module shall search for a free channel resource (FrTpTxChannelState = Idle)\nand allocate them to control the requested Tx data transfer.\n[SWS_FrTp_01038] TX SDU available flag ⌈An ongoing data transfer shall be sig-\nnalled by the flag TX_SDU_AVAILABLE.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01039] Handling of TX SDU available flag ⌈The service primitive shall\nset the flag TX_SDU_AVAILABLE only, if\n• the requested TxPduId is valid\n• a free channel resource is available (FrTpTxChannelState = Idle)\n⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01040] Reject transmission request when TX PDU ID is not valid ⌈If\nthe current parameter TxPduId is not supported the service primitive FrTp_Transmit\n• shall be terminated and the return value shall be set to E_NOT_OK and\n• the FrTp module shall raise an development error FRTP_E_INVALID_PDU_-\nSDU_ID when development error detection for the FrTp module is enabled.\n⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01041] Reject transmission request when no free channel is avail-\nable ⌈If no free channel is available (FrTpTxChannelState != Idle) the service primi-\ntive FrTp_Transmit shall be terminated and the return value shall be set to E_NOT_\nOK11.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01185] Runtime error FRTP_E_NO_CHANNEL ⌈The FrTp module shall\nraise a runtime error FRTP_E_NO_CHANNEL.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01200] Reject transmission request when another transmission for\nthe specified address information is active ⌈If the request for a message trans-\nmission has not been accepted due to another transmission for the specified address\ninformation is active; then FrTp_Transmit shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋\nStep 5 - 10\nIf the TX_SDU_AVAILABLE flag is set, the FrTp module has to evaluate the\nlength of the currently available FrTp N-SDU data by calling the service primitive\nPduR_FrTpCopyTxData()12 a first time. With knowledge of the available data size FrTp\nmodule scans the FrTpTxPduPool and allocates the first free FrTpPdu for that data\ntransfer. Depending on the available FrTp-N-SDU length and the FrTpTxPduPool’s\nfree FrTpPdu length the FrTp module decides whether segmentation is necessary or\nnot for that N-SDU transfer. By calling the service primitive PduR_FrTpCopyTxData\nthe data shall be copied to the corresponding buffer. In a next step the corresponding\nAddress Information and PCI are prepared and the service primitive LSduR_FrTp-\nTransmit is called with the corresponding TxPduId.\n[SWS_FrTp_01042] Start copy TX data when SDU available flag is set ⌈If the\nTX_SDU_AVAILABLE flag is set, the FrTp module shall call the service primitive\nPduR_FrTpCopyTxData to get the currently available FrTp N-SDU Length informa-\ntion.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01045] Allocate first free TX PDU in a pool ⌈The FrTp module shall\nalways allocate the first free FrTpTxPdu while scanning the corresponding FrTpTx-\nPduPool.⌋\n11This scenario could occur on gateways, if communication via more connections is requested than\nchannels resources are configured.\n12The available data length evaluation depends on different scenarios the FrTp is used in.\n– In case of a normal ECU which transfers data with unknown message lengths it is necessary to\nevalueate the length of the currently stored FrTp-N-SDU.\n– In case an ECU transmits data with known message length the Tx data length is given by the parameter\nof the FrTp_Transmit service primitive. optimizations (implementation dependency).\n– In case of a Gateway which routes N-SDUs of different bus systems it is necessary to get the currently\navailable (received) data length in the gateway buffer.\n[SWS_FrTp_01046] Usage of free TX PDU to continue transmission ⌈If a free\nFrTpTxPdu is identified, the FrTp module shall use this FrTpTxPdu to continue cur-\nrent transmission process.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01047] Postpone processing of transmission in case no free TX PDU\nis available ⌈If no free FrTpTxPdu is identified, the FrTp module shall postpone pro-\ncessing for the corresponding connection till the next main function call.⌋\nNote: FrTp module shall postpone the processing for the corresponding connection\nuntil either free FrTpTxPdu is identified according to transfer is required or\nnot depending on the length information of the first allocated FrTpTxPdu from an\nFrTpTxPduPool for the currently processed FrTpConnection.⌋\nNote: Decision of segmentation as 1:n).\n[SWS_FrTp_01123] Call copy TX data with according length ⌈The FrTp module\nshall call the service primitive PduR_FrTpCopyTxData to copy the currently available\nFrTp N-SDU data with a length of FrTpTxPdu length to the corresponding transmit\nbuffer.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01049] Address Information and PCI preparation ⌈The FrTp mod-\nule shall prepare the Address Information and PCI according to the result of\n[SWS_FrTp_01048] as defined in specification [1].⌋"

      "verbatim_text": "7.5.3 Receive Data\nThis chapter defines a data reception on FrTp module requested by the lower layer\nFlexRay Interface (FrIf).\n[SWS_FrTp_01206] ⌈During reception, the FrTp shall forward addressing\ninformation received as local address and remote address in the N-PDU to the upper\nlayer\nvia\nthe\nmeta\ndata\nitems\nSOURCE_ADDRESS_16\nand\nTARGET_ADDRESS_16, and shall use the same address information when\ntransmitting flow control N-PDUs.⌋()\n[SWS_FrTp_01207]  ⌈If FrTpLa and/or FrTpRa are not configured for a received N-\nSDU, any received addressing information can be assigned to this N-SDU. N-SDUs\nwith configured FrTpLa and/or FrTpRa shall be preferred during reception over those\nwithout these configuration parameters.⌋()\nNote: The service routine PduR_FrTpStartOfReception() shall be called in either\nFrTp_MainFunction() or FrTp_RxIndication().\nFigure 16 depicts the internal processing for data reception in principle19.       "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.5.5 Dynamic Bandwidth Assignment\nFrom FrTp’s point of view physical FlexRay bandwidth is represented by N-PDUs. As\ndepict in Figure 17 there is a direct mapping between N-PDUs and L-PDUs (done\nwithin FrIf module’s frame construction plan).\nL-PDU 0\nL-PDU 1\nL-PDU 2\nN-PDU 0\nN-PDU 1\nN-PDU 2\nN-PDU 3\nChannel n\nFlexRay static or dynamic segment\nFrTpTxPduPool 0\nFrTpTxPduPool 1\nReference\nt\nFrTp\nFrIf\nN-PDU-ID\nFrTpConnection 2\nFrTpConnection 1\nFrTpConnection 0\nL-PDU 3\nN-PDU 4\nEnd of segment\nN-PDU-ID\nReference\nFigure 17:  Mapping of N-PDUs to N-PDU-Pools\nAn FrTpTxPduPool could be referenced by different FrTpConnections (see also\nchapter 7.3.2.2). Depending on the number of currently active FrTpConnections\nthe bandwidth (N-PDUs) is shared between them 24 . By supporting dynamic\nbandwidth assignment, a support of different communication scenarios is possible.\nFigure 18 depicts two different scenarios which could be supported with only one\nFrTp configuration. From gateway’s point of view different communication scenarios\nare possible:\na)  single connection communication\nComplete bandwidth (slots) is assigned to one communication link (e.g. to\nECU 2)\nb)  multiple connection communication\nBandwidth (slots) is shared between different communication links to different\nECUs (e.g. ECU 1-3)."
    },

      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_7_6_2_FlexRay_NM_PDU_format",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayNetworkManagement",

      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.6.2 FlexRay NM-PDU format\nAs specified in [SWS_FrNm_00147] the FlexRay NM is capable of sending NM-Vote\nand NM-Data independently. Therefore several corresponding PDU formats exist for\nthe NM-Vote and for the NM-Data. To also support an associated transmission of NM-\nVote and NM-Data in the static segment the NM-Data PDU contains an optional Voting\nBit."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_7_6_5_1_TransmitWithDecoupledBufferAccess",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayInterface",
      "source_page": 38,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.6.5.1 TransmitWithDecoupledBufferAccess\n[SWS_FrIf_05058]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05130\n⌈The FrIf module shall be capable of Transmit Request queuing by using the TrigTx\nCounter.⌋\nNote: Only the amount of transmit requests are stored, not the data itself.\n[SWS_FrIf_05063]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05027\n⌈If the related CC is in FrIf_State FRIF_STATE_ONLINE for a Communication Opera-\ntion DECOUPLED_TRANSMISSION, then the Job List Execution Function shall exe-\ncute this Communication Operation. Otherwise, the Job List Execution Function shall\nignore this Communication Operation.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05287] ⌈For a Communication Operation DECOUPLED_TRANSMISSION\nthe Job List Execution Function shall perform the following steps\n1. Iterate over all PDUs contained in the FrIfFrameStructure (see FrIf05370) of the\nassociated frame triggering of this Communication Operation and\n(a) Check whether TrigTxCounter is > 0 or FrIfNoneMode == true for the PDU.\nIf not, clear the update-bit for this PDU [Configuration Parameter FrIfPdu\nUpdateBitOffset, see FrIf06071] and proceed with the next PDU, otherwise\ncontinue with the following steps:\ni. Decrement TrigTxCounter only if TrigTxCounter > 0. If the value of Trig\nTxCounter = 0, do not decrement.\nii. Call the upper layer’s function LSduR_FrIfTriggerTransmit() with the as-\nsociated PDUId (defined by the upper layer) and pass a pointer to a\ntemporary buffer within the FrIf that assembles the L-SDU. The pointer\nshall consider the byte offset [Configuration Parameter FrIfPduOffset,\nsee FrIf06070]] of the PDU within the frame. If LSduR_FrIfTriggerTrans-\nmit() returns E_NOT_OK, the TrigTxCounter value has to be rolled back\nto the previous value.\niii. Remember that a transmission for this PDU is pending if a transmis-\nsion confirmation is needed for this PDU [Configuration Parameter Fr\nIfConfirm, see FrIf06075] increment TxConfCounter, where the maxi-\nmum value is limited by static configuration [Configuration Parameter FrIf\nCounterLimit, see FrIf06076]. If the FrIfCounterLimit has been reached,\nthe FrIfCounterLimit value is kept and not incremented any more.\niv. Set the update-bit if configured for this PDU [Configuration Parameter Fr\nIfPduUpdateBitOffset, see FrIf06071]. In case the API LSduR_FrIfTrig-\ngerTransmit() does not return E_OK, or the API FrIf_CancelTransmit\n()for the corresponding PDU has been called, reset the update-bit to\n\"not updated\".\n2. If at least one PDU was requested for transmission or for at least one PDU FrIf\nNoneMode == true and LSduR_FrIfTriggerTransmit() returned E_OK or the frame\nis configured to be always transmitted [Configuration Parameter FrIfAlwaysTrans-\nmit == true] then the FlexRay Driver’s API service Fr_TransmitTxLPdu() is called:\n(a) Fr_CtrlIdx is derived according to the indexing scheme described in chapter\nof indexing.\n(b) Fr_LPduIdx is set to the configured L-PDU index [Configuration Parameter\n(c) FrIfLPduIdx, see FrIf06058] associated with the Communication Operation\n(d) Fr_LSduPtr is set to the temporary FrIf L-SDU assembling buffer.\n(e) d. Fr_LSduLength is set to the L-SDU length [Configuration Parameter FrIf\nLSduLength, see FrIf06054]\n(f) Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr is set to a temporary slot assignment buffer if Bus\nMirroring is enabled globally (see FrIfBusMirroringSupport), otherwise to the\nNULL_PTR.\n3. If Bus Mirroring is enabled globally (see FrIfBusMirroringSupport) and has\nbeen activated with a call to FrIf_EnableBusMirroring() for the Fr_CtrlIdx and Fr_\nTransmitTxLPdu() returned E_OK (indicating that the transmission succeeded),\ncall Mirror_ReportFlexRayFrame() with \"controllerId\" set to Fr_CtrlIdx, , \"slotId\",\n\"cycle\", and \"channel\" taken from Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr, \"frame\" constructed\nfrom Fr_LSduPtr and Fr_LSduLength, and \"txConflict\" set to false.\n4. In case the Driver’s API Fr_TransmitTxLPdu() returned E_NOT_OK (indicating\nthat the transmission failed) changes on TrigTxCounter and TxConfCounter must\nbe rolled back (see 4. and 5.) for each PDU contained in the FlexRay L-SDU.\n⌋\nNote: All described actions in SWS_FrIf_05287 are depicted in detail in the sequence\nchart in Section 9.1.2.\n[SWS_FrIf_05435] ⌈If FrIfAllowDynamicLSduLength exists and is set to TRUE for the\nassociated frame triggering, the actual L-SDU length, that is passed to the driver by\ncalling Fr_TransmitTxLPdu(), shall be determined (i.e. shortened as much as possi-\nble) by taking only those PDUs into account, which have been indicated via LSduR_\nFrIfTriggerTransmit() and consider the following points:\n• the position of the respective PDU within the L-SDU\n• the actual length of the respective PDU as passed via LSduR_FrIfTriggerTrans-\nmit()\n⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05436] ⌈A shortened L-Sdu (see [SWS_FrIf_05435]) shall always contain\nall configured update bits.⌋\nNote:\n[SWS_FrIf_05435] and [SWS_FrIf_05436] ensure that on one hand all the\nneeded information for disassembling the L-SDU is available on receiver side (PDU(s)\nitself and the corresponding update-bit(s) if configured), and on the other hand that the\npayload can be reduced as much as possible by taking the position of all the required\ndata for disassembling contained in the frame construction plan into account when\nshortening the L-SDU to be passed to the driver."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_7_6_5_2_ProvideTxConfirmation",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayInterface",
      "source_page": 37,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.6.5.2 ProvideTxConfirmation\nThis Communication Operation provides a Tx confirmation and optionally checks the\noccurrence of a Tx conflict.\n[SWS_FrIf_05064] ⌈If the related CC is in FrIf_State FRIF_STATE_ONLINE for a Com-\nmunication Operation TX_CONFIRMATION, then the Job List Execution Function shall\nexecute this Communication Operation. Otherwise, the Job List Execution Function\nshall ignore this Communication Operation.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05288] ⌈\"For a Communication Operation TX_CONFIRMATION the Job\nList Execution Function shall perform the following steps:\n1. Call the FlexRay Driver’s API function Fr_CheckTxLPduStatus():\n• Fr_CtrlIdx is derived according to the indexing scheme described in chapter\nof indexing\n• Fr_LPduIdx is set to the configured L-PDU buffer index [Configuration Pa-\nrameter FrIfLPduIdx, see FrIf06058] associated with the Communication Op-\neration.\n• Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr is set to a temporary slot assignment buffer if Bus\nMirroring is enabled globally (see FrIfBusMirroringSupport), otherwise to the\nNULL_PTR.\n2. If the transmission was performed (output parameter *Fr_TxLPduStatusPtr is set\nto FR_TRANSMITTED) then iterate over all PDUs contained in the FrIfFrame\nStructure (see FrIf05370) of the associated frame triggering. If TxConfCounter\nfor a PDU is 0 proceed with the next PDU, otherwise\n• If FrIfConfirm == true, call the upper layer’s function <UL_TxConfirmation(E_\nOK)> with the asociated PDUId (defined by the upper layer).\n• If FrIfConfirm == true , decrement TxConfCounter.\n3. If the transmission was performed but a TxConflict occurred (output parameter\n*Fr_TxLPduStatusPtr is set to FR_TRANSMITTED_CONFLICT) then iterate over\nall PDUs contained in the FrIfFrameStructure (see FrIf05370) of the associated\nframe triggering. If TxConfCounter for a PDU is 0 proceed with the next PDU,\notherwise\n• If FrIfConfirm == true, call the upper layer’s function <UL_TxConfirmation(E_\nNOT_OK)> with the asociated PDUId (defined by the upper layer).\n• If FrIfConfirm == true , decrement TxConfCounter.\n4. If Bus Mirroring is enabled globally (see FrIfBusMirroringSupport) and has been\nactivated with a call to FrIf_EnableBusMirroring() for the Fr_CtrlIdx and the API\nFr_CheckTxLpduStatus() returns \"FR_TRANSMITTED_CONFLICT\", call Mirror_\nReportFlexRayFrame() with \"controllerId\" set to Fr_CtrlIdx, \"slotId\", \"cycle\", and\n\"channel\" taken from Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr, \"frame\" set to the NULL_PTR, and\n\"txConflict\" set to true.\nIf the API Fr_CheckTxLpduStatus() returns \"FR_TRANSMITTED_CONFLICT\" and the\n<UL_TxConflictNotification> is configured via FrIfTxConflictNotificationName (ECUC_\nFrIf_06122), call this function for the same LPduIdx.⌋()"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_7_6_5_3_ReceiveAndStore",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayInterface",
      "source_page": 39,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.6.5.3 ReceiveAndStore\n[SWS_FrIf_05289] ⌈If the related CC is in FrIf_State FRIF_STATE_ONLINE for a Com-\nmunication Operation RECEIVE_AND_STORE, then the Job List Execution Function\nshall execute this Communication Operation. Otherwise, the Job List Execution Func-\ntion shall ignore this Communication Operation.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05290] ⌈For a Communication Operation RECEIVE_AND_STORE the Job\nList Execution Function shall perform the following steps:\n1. Call the FlexRay Driver’s API function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu():\n(a) Fr_CtrlIdx is derived according to the indexing scheme described in chapter\nof indexing.\n(b) Fr_LPduIdx is set to the configured L-PDU index [Configuration Parameter\nFrIfLPduIdx, see FrIf06058] associated with the Communication Operation.\n(c) Fr_LSduPtr is set to a temporary buffer.\n(d) Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr is set to a temporary slot assignment buffer if Bus\nMirroring is enabled globally (see FrIfBusMirroringSupport), otherwise to the\nNULL_PTR.\n2. If Bus Mirroring is enabled globally (see FrIfBusMirroringSupport) and has been\nactivated with a call to FrIf_EnableBusMirroring() for the Fr_CtrlIdx and an L-PDU\nwas received (Output parameter *Fr_LPduStatusPtr != FR_NOT_RECEIVED),\ncall Mirror_ReportFlexRayFrame() with \"controllerId\" set to Fr_CtrlIdx, \"slotId\",\n\"cycle\", and \"channel\" taken from Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr, \"frame\" constructed\nfrom Fr_LSduPtr and Fr_LSduLengthPtr, and \"txConflict\" set to false.\n3. If a L-PDU was received (Output parameter *Fr_LPduStatusPtr != FR_NOT_\nRECEIVED) iterate over all PDUs contained in the FrIfFrameStructure (see Fr\nIf05370) of the associated frame triggering and:\n(a) If an update bit was configured for the PDU [Configuration Parameter FrIf\nPduUpdateBitOffset, see FrIf06071] and the update bit for the PDU is not\nset, continue with the next PDU. Otherwise,\n(b) Copy the PDU Payload from the temporary buffer considering the PDU off-\nset within the L-SDU [Configuration Parameter FrIfPduOffset, see FrIf06070]\ninto a FrIf PDU-related static buffer.\n(c) Store the actual received PDU length\n(d) Mark the PDU-related static buffer as up-to-date.\n4. if *Fr_LPduStatusPtr == FR_RECEIVED_MORE_DATA_AVAILABLE restart at\nnumber 1 again. Otherwise the communication operation has finished.\n⌋"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_7_6_5_4_ProvideRxIndication",
      "source_element": null,

      "verbatim_text": "7.6.5.4 ProvideRxIndication\n[SWS_FrIf_05062]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05170\n⌈If the related CC is in FrIf_State FRIF_STATE_ONLINE for a Communication Oper-\nation RX_INDICATION, then the Job List Execution Function shall execute this Com-\nmunication Operation. Otherwise, the Job List Execution Function shall ignore this\nCommunication Operation.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05291] ⌈For a Communication Operation RX_INDICATION the Job List\nExecution Function shall perform the following steps:\n1. Iterate over all PDU-related static buffers of PDUs contained in the FrIfFrame\nStructure (see FrIf05370) of the associated frame triggering\n2. If the PDU-related static buffer is marked as outdated, continue with the next\nPDU. Otherwise if the buffer is marked up-to-date,\n(a) Call the upper layer’s function LSduR_FrIfRxIndication() with the PDU Id the\nreceiving module expects and PduInfoPtr which contains the received data\naddress and received data length.\n(b) Mark the PDU-related static buffer as outdated.\n⌋"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_7_6_5_5_ReceiveAndIndicate",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayInterface",
      "source_page": 41,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.6.5.5 ReceiveAndIndicate\n[SWS_FrIf_05292] ⌈If the related CC is in FrIf_State FRIF_STATE_ONLINE for a Com-\nmunication Operation RECEIVE_AND_INDICATE, then the Job List Execution Func-\ntion shall execute this Communication Operation. Otherwise, the Job List Execution\nFunction shall ignore this Communication Operation.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05293] ⌈For a Communication Operation RECEIVE_AND_INDICATE the\nJob List Execution Function shall perform the following steps:\n1. Calculate values for input parameters:\n(a) Fr_CtrlIdx is derived according to the indexing scheme described in chapter\nof indexing.\n(b) Fr_LPduIdx is set to the configured L-PDU index [Configuration Parameter\nFrIfLPduIdx, see FrIf06058] associated with the Communication Operation.\n(c) Fr_LSduPtr is set to a temporary buffer.\n(d) Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr is set to a temporary slot assignment buffer if Bus\nMirroring is enabled globally (see FrIfBusMirroringSupport), otherwise to the\nNULL_PTR.\n2. Initialize ComOpLoopCounter to 0.\n3. As long as ComOpLoopCounter < FrIfRxComOpMaxLoop do\n(a) Call Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu with the parameters calculated in 1)\n(b) If *Fr_LPduStatusPtr != FR_NOT_RECEIVED then continue at 3)c), other-\nwise the communication operation has finished.\n(c) If Bus Mirroring is enabled globally (see FrIfBusMirroringSupport) and has\nbeen activated with a call to FrIf_EnableBusMirroring() for the Fr_CtrlIdx, call\nMirror_ReportFlexRayFrame() with \"controllerId\" set to Fr_CtrlIdx, \"slotId\",\n\"cycle\", and \"channel\" taken from Fr_SlotAssignmentPtr, \"frame\" con-\nstructed\nfrom Fr_LSduPtr and Fr_LSduLengthPtr, and \"txConflict\" set to false.\nOtherwise, continue at 3)d).\n(d) For each Pdu contained in the FrIfFrameStructure (see FrIf05370) of the\nassociated frame triggering do\n-If an update bit was configured for the PDU [Configuration Parameter FrIf\nPduUpdateBitOffset, see FrIf06071] and the update bit for the PDU is not\nset, continue with the next PDU. Otherwise\n-Call the upper layer’s function LSduR_FrIfRxIndication() with the PDU Id\nthe receiving module expects and a pointer to the Pdu-Info structure con-\ntaining the Pdu length and a reference to the temporary buffer considering\nthe PDU offset within the L-SDU [Configuration Parameter FrIfPduOffset,\nsee FrIf06070]] as parameters.\n(e) if *Fr_LPduStatusPtr == FR_RECEIVED_MORE_DATA_AVAILABLE then\nincrement ComOpLoopCounter and restart at 3)a), otherwise the commu-\nnication operation has finished.\n⌋"
    },

      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.6.5.6 PREPARE_LPDU\nThe Communication Operation PREPARE_LPDU enables hardware optimization\npurposes (hardware buffer re-configuration)\n[SWS_FrIf_05294] ⌈The Communication Operation PREPARE_LPDU performs the\nfollowing steps:\n1. Call the FlexRay Driver’s API function Fr_PrepareLPdu():\n• Fr_CtrlIdx is derived according to the indexing scheme described in chapter\nof indexing.\n• Fr_LPduIdx is set to the configured L-PDU index [Configuration Parameter\nFrIfLPduIdx, see FrIf06058] associated with the Communication Operation.\n⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05061] ⌈The Communication Operation PREPARE_LPDU enables hard-\nware optimization purposes. Its purpose is to enable certain FlexRay CC hardware\nresources (e.g. a CC’s message buffer) to be prepared (configured) for the transmis-\nsion/reception of a certain L-PDU.\nThis Communication Operation enables the FlexRay Driver to optimize the usage of\nhardware resources if available at appropriate point of times. However, it is the respon-\nsibility of the FlexRay Driver to decide and validate ressource allocation optimizations\nbased on the PREPARE_LPDU Communication Operations. Practically the usage of\nthis Communication Operation will introduce some runtime-overhead even if the Flex\nRay Driver does not use the opportunity for reconfiguration.⌋(SRS_Fr_05042)"
    },

    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_7_7_1_FlexRay_NM_Main_Function_structure",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayNetworkManagement",
      "source_page": 38,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.7.1 FlexRay NM-Main Function structure\nThe FlexRay NM MainFunction will hold the \"automated\" functionality of the FlexRay\nNM - as there is the periodic transmission of NM-Messages, the processing of received\nNM-Messages and the periodic processing of the FlexRay NM state machine (at the\nboundary between two NM-Repetition Cycles).\n[SWS_FrNm_00010] ⌈The FrNm module shall call the FlexRay Interface function\nFrIf_Transmit to transmit NM-Vote and NM-Data if the transmission of cyclic NM-\nmessages is started.⌋()\nNote: The FlexRay Interface module shall call the FrNm module function FrNm_Tx-\nConfirmation with E_OK when a NM-message is successfully transmitted and a\ntransmit confirmation is supported and configured within the FlexRay Interface.\nNote: The FlexRay Interface module shall call the FrNm module function FrNm_-\nRxIndication when a NM-message is received. It is up to the implementation as\nto how the FrNm module is to handle the data from the NM-message. It can be im-\nmediately processed (to reduce the memory consumption), or it can be stored to be\navailable to be processed (to reduce computing time).\n[SWS_FrNm_00375] ⌈The FrNm module shall retrieve the current FlexRay communi-\ncation cycle via the API FrIf_GetGlobalTime().⌋()"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_7_7_2_FlexRay_NM_MainFunction_execution",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayNetworkManagement",
      "source_page": 38,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.7.2 FlexRay NM-MainFunction execution\nNote: The FlexRay NM module integrator shall define a schedule to activate the\nFlexRay NM MainFunction synchronously to the FlexRay communication cycle.\nNote:\nThe FrNm module’s environment (SchM2) should execute the FlexRay NM\nMainFunction (FrNm_MainFunction_<FrNmChannel.ShortName>) at least once\na FlexRay communication cycle, synchronous to the FlexRay global time when FlexRay\nglobal time is available within the time window depicted in Figure 7.3. The execution\nof the FlexRay NM MainFunction should not cross a FlexRay cycle boundary. The\nFlexRay NM MainFunction should be executed periodically even when FlexRay global\ntime is no longer available. The periodicity of FlexRay NM MainFunction is configurable\nin the SchM configuration which has to correspond to the value of the FrNmMainFunc-\ntionPeriod configuration parameter.\nRationale:\nThis is necessary because FlexRay NM state changes may influence\nwhether the NM-Vote PDU should be transmitted in the subsequent cycle. Since state\nchanges are influenced by the aggregated NM vote in a given cycle and the state\nchange subsequently influences the NM-Vote, the FlexRay NM MainFunction must ex-\necute in a time window bounded by the cycle end and the transmission slot for the\nNM-Vote PDU ([SWS_FrNm_00168]).\nNote: The AUTOSAR OS [11] provides the method of Schedule Tables which can be\nsynchronized with a Global Time. These could be used to fulfill the FlexRay NM exe-\ncution requirements. The AUTOSAR FlexRay NM shall try to use the second absolute\ntimer whenever possible as race conditions might occur between the FlexRay NM ac-\ncess to the first absolute timer and the FlexRay Interface Job List execution function\naccess to the first absolute timer.\n[SWS_FrNm_00356] ⌈The state machine guards, transitions, conditions, and actions\nshould be evaluated at most once in each execution of the FrNm_MainFunction_-\n<FrNmChannel.ShortName>.⌋\n2part of the RTE module\n[SWS_FrNm_00311] ⌈FlexRay NM module shall provide a configuration parameter\nnamed FrNmMainAcrossFrCycle to select adapt the behavior of the FlexRay NM\nMainFunction to the point in time the FlexRay NM MainFunction is executed.⌋\nFigure 7.4: Example NM PDU containing PNC bit vector\nNote: If the FlexRay NM Vector is only available at the end of a FlexRay cycle then eval-\nuation takes place in the following FlexRay cycle. - This depends on the configuration\nand implementation of the FlexRay communication controller hardware.\n[SWS_FrNm_00467] ⌈The evaluation of the condition RepetitionCycleCompleted and\nthus the generation of the RepetitionCycleCompleted event shall be subject to the fol-\nlowing rules:\n1. If FrNmMainAcrossFrCycle is set to FALSE, then a RepetitionCycleCompleted\nevent shall be generated in the last FlexRay communication cycle of the repetition\ncycle after we receive all the votes.\n2. If FrNmMainAcrossFrCycle is set to TRUE, then a RepetitionCycleCompleted\nevent shall be generated if a repetition cycle boundary has been crossed since\nthe previous call of the FlexRay NM MainFunction execution before any vote is\ntransmitted.\n⌋\nExample for case 1: If the votes are scheduled in cycles 1 and 2, and the repetition\ncycle period is 4 FlexRay communication cycles, then the RepetitionCycleCompleted\nevent can be generated (once only) any time during cycle 3, 7, 11, 15, etc..\nExample for case 2: If the votes are scheduled in cycles 1 and 2, and the repetition\ncycle period is 4 FlexRay communication cycles, then the RepetitionCycleCompleted\ncan be generated (once only) any time during cycle 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, etc.\nNote: CycleNumber stands for the FlexRay communication cycle number whose value\nis anywhere between 0 and 63 as integers. RepetitionCycleLength is the number of\ncommunication cycles within one NM Repetition Cycle.\nFlexRay \"CycleEnd\" Event\nis the event generated at the boundary of two consecutive FlexRay communication\ncycles."
    },

      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "8.1.6.2 Optional Interfaces\nThis section defines all interfaces that are required to fulfill an optional functionality of\nthe module.\n[SWS_FrTSyn_00075] Definition of optional interfaces requested by module Fr\nTSyn\nUpstream requirements: RS_TS_20043\n⌈\nAPI Function\nHeader File\nDescription\nCrc_CalculateCRC8H2F\nCrc.h\nThis service makes a CRC8 calculation with the\nPolynomial 0x2F on Crc_Length\nCsm_MacGenerate\nCsm.h\nUses the given data to perform a MAC generation\nand stores the MAC in the memory location pointed\nto by the MAC pointer.\nCsm_MacVerify\nCsm.h\nVerifies the given MAC by comparing if the MAC is\ngenerated with the given data.\nCsm_SignatureGenerate\nCsm.h\nUses the given data to perform the signature\ncalculation and stores the signature in the memory\nlocation pointed by the result pointer.\nCsm_SignatureVerify\nCsm.h\nVerifies the given signature by checking if it was\ngenerated with the given data.\nDet_ReportError\nDet.h\nService to report development errors.\nDet_ReportRuntimeError\nDet.h\nService to report runtime errors. If a callout has\nbeen configured then this callout shall be called.\nIdsM_SetSecurityEventWithContext\nData (obsolete)\nIdsM.h\nThis API is the application interface to report\nsecurity events with context data to the IdsM.\nTags: atp.Status=obsolete\nLSduR_FrTSynTransmit (draft)\nLSduR_FrTSyn.h\nRequests transmission of a PDU.\nStbM_BusSetGlobalTime\nStbM.h\nAllows the Time Base Provider Modules to forward\nthe Rx Time Tuple to the StbM.\n▽\nFlexRay\n△\nAPI Function\nHeader File\nDescription\nStbM_FrSetMasterTimingData (draft)\nStbM_FrTSyn.h\nProvides Flexray Timesyn module specific data for a\nTime Master to the StbM.\nTags: atp.Status=draft\nStbM_FrSetSlaveTimingData (draft)\nStbM_FrTSyn.h\nAllows the FrTSyn Module to forward Flexray\nspecific details to the StbM.\nTags: atp.Status=draft\nStbM_GetCurrentTime\nStbM.h\nReturns a time tuple (Local time, Global time and\nTimebase status) and user data details Note: This\nAPI shall be called with locked interrupts / within an\nExclusive Area to prevent interruption (i.e., the risk\nthat the time stamp is outdated on return of the\nfunction call).\nStbM_GetRxFreshness\nStbM.h\nThis interface is used by the StbM to query the\ncurrent freshness value.\nStbM_GetTimeBaseStatus\nStbM.h\nReturns detailed status information for a\nSynchronized (or Pure Local) Time Base.\nStbM_GetTimeBaseUpdateCounter\nStbM.h\nAllows the Timesync Modules to detect, whether a\nTime Base should be transmitted immediately in the\nsubsequent <Bus>TSyn_MainFunction() cycle.\nStbM_GetTxFreshness\nStbM.h\nThis API returns the freshness value from the Most\nSignificant Bits in the first byte, of the Freshness\narray, in big endian format.\nStbM_GetTxFreshnessTruncData\nStbM.h\nThis interface is used by the StbM to obtain the\ncurrent freshness value. The interface function\nprovides also the truncated freshness transmitted in\nthe secured time sync message.\nStbM_SPduTxConfirmation\nStbM.h\nThis interface is used by the StbM to indicate that\nthe Secured Time Synchronization Message has\nbeen initiated for transmission.\n⌋\nFlexRay"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_8_3_18_FrIf_Transmit",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayInterface",
      "source_page": 68,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "8.3.18 FrIf_Transmit\n[SWS_FrIf_05033] Definition of API function FrIf_Transmit ⌈\nService Name\nFrIf_Transmit\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrIf_Transmit (\nPduIdType TxPduId,\nconst PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x49\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.\nTxPduId\nIdentifier of the PDU to be transmitted\nParameters (in)\nPduInfoPtr\nLength of and pointer to the PDU data and pointer to MetaData.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: Transmit request has been accepted.\nE_NOT_OK: Transmit request has not been accepted.\nDescription\nRequests transmission of a PDU.\nAvailable via\nFrIf.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05318] ⌈\nFrIf_Transmit() shall return E_NOT_OK in case the FrIf’s state is FRIF_STATE_OF-\nFLINE.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05205] ⌈If parameter TxPduId of FrIf_Transmit has an invalid value and if\ndevelopment error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect equals ON), the func-\ntion FrIf_Transmit shall report development error code FRIF_E_INV_TXPDUID to the\nDet_ReportError service of the DET module.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05207] ⌈If the parameter FrIfAllowedDynamicSduLength is set to false\nand/or if the parameter FrIfImmediate is set to true for the passed TxPduId, the passed\nSduDataPtr in parameter PduInfoPtr of FrIf_Transmit shall be checked for NULL_PTR\nin case development error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect equals ON). If\nin this case the passed SduDataPtr equals NULL_PTR, the function FrIf_Transmit shall\nreport the development error code FRIF_E_PARAM_POINTER to the Det_ReportError\nservice of the DET module.\nIn case of decoupled transmission the PDU with index TxPduId is not yet passed\nto the underlying FlexRay Driver module for transmission. FrIf only remembers the\nPDU’s transmission request (increment TrigTxCounter 5) This decoupling mechanism\nbetween the call of FrIf_Transmit() and the execution of the FrIfCommunicationAction\n(see [ECUC_FrIf_06067]) has some implications:\n• The upper layer BSW module may operate asynchronously to the FlexRay Com-\nmunication System and thus may call FrIf_Transmit() at any point in time.\n• The upper layer BSW module must permanently buffer the PDU’s payload date\nand must be able to handle a call of its LSduR_FrIfTriggerTransmit() API service\nat (from the BSW’s point of view) any arbitrary point in time.\n⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05208] ⌈In case of immediate transmission the function FrIf_Transmit shall\npass the PDU (single PDU, no Update bit) to the underlying FlexRay Driver module\nimmediately for transmission.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05757] ⌈\"If parameter TxPduId is configured for an immediate PDU, and\nif configuration parameter FrIfAllowDynamicLSduLength is set to FALSE, the pro-\nvided length in PduInfoPtr shall be compared with the static configured length (see\n[ECUC_FrIf_06054]).\nIf the length information does not match, FrIf_Transmit() shall return E_NOT_OK and\nshall not perform the immediate PDU transmission. If development error detection is\nenabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect equals ON), the function FrIf_Transmit() shall report\ndevelopment error code FRIF_E_INV_PDULENGTH to the Det_ReportError service of\nthe DET module.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05209] ⌈Caveats of FrIf_Transmit:\nThe FlexRay Interface module has\nto be initialized with a call of FrIf_Init() before this API service may be called, see\n[SWS_FrIf_05003]⌋\n5Limited by static configuration see FrIfCounterLimit"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.3.5 FrSM_AllSlots\n[SWS_FrSM_00172] Definition of API function FrSM_AllSlots\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_BSW_00460, SRS_BSW_00484\n⌈\nService Name\nFrSM_AllSlots\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrSM_AllSlots (\nNetworkHandleType NetworkHandle\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x05\nSync/Async\nAsynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different FlexRay clusters\nParameters (in)\nNetworkHandle\nThis parameter identifies the FlexRay cluster for which a\ncommunication mode is requested.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: Request accepted\nE_NOT_OK: Request not accepted\nDescription\nThis API function can be used to leave the KeySlotOnlyMode.\nAvailable via\nFrSM.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00197] ⌈The FrSM_AllSlots function shall be pre compile time con-\nfigurable ON/OFF by the configuration parameter FrSMAllSlotsSupport⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00171] ⌈The FrSM_AllSlots function shall call FrIf_AllSlots for each\ncontroller of the FlexRay cluster. It shall return E_OK if each of these calls returned E_\nOK, otherwise FrSM_AllSlots shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00168]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00369, SRS_BSW_00323, SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If development error detection is enabled and the parameter NetworkHandle has an\ninvalid value, the FrSM_AllSlots function shall raise the development error code\nFRSM_E_INV_HANDLE and the FrSM_AllSlots function shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00169]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00406, SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If development error detection is enabled and the FrSM module has not been ini-\ntialized using FrSM_Init, the FrSM_AllSlots function shall raise the development\nerror code FRSM_E_UNINIT and the FrSM_AllSlots function shall return E_NOT_\nOK.⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.3.6 FrSM_SetEcuPassive\n[SWS_FrSM_00174] Definition of API function FrSM_SetEcuPassive\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_BSW_00460, SRS_BSW_00484\n⌈\nService Name\nFrSM_SetEcuPassive\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrSM_SetEcuPassive (\nboolean FrSM_Passive\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x06\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant\nParameters (in)\nFrSM_Passive\nThis parameter determines whether all FlexRay clusters are set\nto passive, i.e. receive only.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\n▽\n△\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: Request accepted\nE_NOT_OK: Request not accepted\nDescription\nThis API function can be used to set all FlexRay clusters of the ECU to a receive only mode.\nAvailable via\nFrSM.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00177] ⌈The FrSM_SetEcuPassive function shall set the state of all\nFrSM state machines to FRSM_ECU_PASSIVE if the parameter FrSM_Passive evalu-\nates to true, otherwise it shall set the state of all FrSM state machines to FRSM_ECU_\nACTIVE.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00178] ⌈If the state machine of a FlexRay cluster is not in state FRSM_\nREADY (i.e.\nthe transceivers of the FlexRay cluster are not in standby mode), the\nfunction shall execute FE_TRCV_NORMAL for this cluster.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00179]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00406, SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If development error detection is enabled and the FrSM module has not been ini-\ntialized using FrSM_Init, the FrSM_SetEcuPassive function shall raise the devel-\nopment error code FRSM_E_UNINIT and the FrSM_SetEcuPassive function shall\nreturn E_NOT_OK.⌋"
    },

Unused list\nelements are filled with the value ’0’ to indicate that no more\nsyncframe has been seen.\nFrIf_ChannelBEvenListPtr\nAddress the list of syncframes on channel B within the even\ncommunication cycle is written to. The exact number of elements\nwritten to the list is limited by parameter FrIf_ListSize. Unused list\nelements are filled with the value ’0’ to indicate that no more\nsyncframe has been seen.\nFrIf_ChannelAOddListPtr\nAddress the list of syncframes on channel A within the odd\ncommunication cycle is written to.       "verbatim_text": "8.4.7 FrIf_CancelTransmit\n[SWS_FrIf_05070] Definition of API function FrIf_CancelTransmit ⌈\nService Name\nFrIf_CancelTransmit\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrIf_CancelTransmit (\nPduIdType TxPduId\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x4a\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.\nParameters (in)\nTxPduId\nIdentification of the PDU to be cancelled.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: Cancellation was executed successfully by the destination\nmodule.\nE_NOT_OK: Cancellation was rejected by the destination module.\nDescription\nRequests cancellation of an ongoing transmission of a PDU in a lower layer communication\nmodule.\nAvailable via\nFrIf.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05713] ⌈The function FrIf_CancelTransmit shall be pre compile time con-\nfigurable ON/OFF by the configuration parameter FrIfCancelTransmitSupport (derived\nfrom configuration parameter FrIfCancelTransmitSupport, see ECUC_FrIf_00002)⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05703] ⌈If development error detection for the FrIf module is enabled: if\nthe function FrIf_CancelTransmit is called before the FrIf was initialized successfully,\nthe function FrIf_CancelTransmit shall raise the development error FRIF_E_UNINIT\nand return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05704] ⌈If development error detection for the FrIf module is enabled: the\nfunction FrIf_CancelTransmit shall check the parameter TxPduId for being valid. If Tx\nPduId is invalid, the function FrIf_CancelTransmit shall raise the development error\nFRIF_E_INV_TXPDUID and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrIf_05705] ⌈For Transmit Cancellation, the following steps are performed:\n1. Decrement TrigTxCounter for the IPDU that shall be canceled.\n2. If TxConfCounter > 0 for this PDU, contine with step 3). Else, stop here.\n3. Call FlexRay Driver’s API function Fr_CancelTxLPdu():\n(a) Fr_CtrlIdx is derived according to the indexing scheme described in chapter\nof indexing.\n(b) Fr_LPduIdx is set to the configured L-PDU buffer index [Configuration Pa-\nrameter FrIfLPduIdx, see [ECUC_FrIf_06058]] associated with the Commu-\nnication Operation.\n4. Increment TrigTxCounter (limited by FrIfCounterLimit) for all other I-PDUs within\nthat L-PDU that have a TxConfCounter > 0.\n5. Decrement TxConfCounter for all other I-PDUs within that L-PDU that have a Tx\nConfCounter > 0.\n6. Decrement the TxConfCounter for the IPDU that has been initiated by the Cancel\nTransmit API call.\n⌋"
    },

Setting parameters\n• FrTrcv_BranchIdx to FrIf_BranchIdx\n• FrTrcv_BusErrorState to FrIf_BusErrorState\n3. Calling FrTrcv_GetTransceiverError of the determined FlexRay Transceiver mod-\nule with the parameters determined as described above.\n⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.6.1 FrIf_CheckWakeupByTransceiver\n[SWS_FrIf_05041] Definition of API function FrIf_CheckWakeupByTransceiver ⌈\nService Name\nFrIf_CheckWakeupByTransceiver\nSyntax\nvoid FrIf_CheckWakeupByTransceiver (\nuint8 FrIf_CtrlIdx,\nFr_ChannelType FrIf_ChnlIdx\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x39\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant\nFrIf_CtrlIdx\nIndex of the FlexRay CC to address.\nParameters (in)\nFrIf_ChnlIdx\nIndex of the FlexRay Channel to address in scope of the FlexRay\ncontroller FrIf_CtrlIdx.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nNone\nDescription\nWraps the FlexRay Transceiver Driver API function FrTrcv_CheckWakeupByTransceiver(). The\nenum value \"FR_CHANNEL_AB\" shall not be used.\nAvailable via\nFrIf.h\n⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05274] ⌈If parameter FrIf_CtrlIdx of FrIf_CheckWakeupByTransceiver has\nan invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect\nequals ON), the function FrIf_CheckWakeupByTransceiver shall report development er-\nror code FRIF_E_INV_CTRL_IDX to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.⌋\n()\n[SWS_FrIf_05275] ⌈If parameter FrIf_ChnlIdx of FrIf_CheckWakeupByTransceiver has\nan invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect\nequals ON), the function FrIf_CheckWakeupByTransceiver shall report development er-\nror code FRIF_E_INV_CHNL_IDX to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.⌋\n()\n[SWS_FrIf_05276] ⌈The function FrIf_CheckWakeupByTransceiver shall wrap the Flex\nRay Transceiver Driver API function FrTrcv_CheckWakeupByTransceiver() by:\n1. Translating (based on static FrIf module configuration) the tuple (FlexRay CC\nindex FrIf_CtrlIdx | FlexRay Channel index FrIf_ChnlIdx) into a tuple (FlexRay\nTransceiver Driver | Driver-specific Transceiver index FrTrcv_TrcvIdx).\n2. Calling FrTrcv_CheckWakeupByTransceiver() of the determined FlexRay Driver\nmodule with the parameters determined as described above.\n⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05277] ⌈Caveats of FrIf_CheckWakeupByTransceiver: The FlexRay Inter-\nface module has to be initialized with a call of FrIf_Init() before this API service may be\ncalled, see SWS_FrIf_05003.⌋()"
    },

    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_8_6_2_Optional_interfaces_FLEXRAYNETWORKMANAGEMENT",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayNetworkManagement",
      "source_page": 85,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "8.6.2 Optional interfaces\nThis section defines all interfaces, which are required to fulfill an optional functionality\nof the module.\n[SWS_FrNm_00257] Definition of optional interfaces requested by module FrNm\n⌈\nAPI Function\nHeader File\nDescription\nDet_ReportError\nDet.h\nService to report development errors.\nFrIf_GetNmVector\nFrIf.h\nDerives the FlexRay NM Vector.\nNm_CarWakeUpIndication\nNm.h\nThis function is called by a <Bus>Nm to indicate\nreception of a CWU request.\nNm_CoordReadyToSleepCancellation\nNm.h\nCancels an indication, when the NM Coordinator\nSleep Ready bit in the Control Bit Vector is set back\nto 0.\nNm_CoordReadyToSleepIndication\nNm.h\nSets an indication, when the NM Coordinator Sleep\nReady bit in the Control Bit Vector is set\nNm_ForwardSynchronizedPnc\nShutdown\nNm.h\nNotification that the network management has\nreceived a PN shutdown message on a particular\nNM-channel. This is used to grant a nearly\nsynchronized PNC shutdown across the entire PN\ntopology.\n▽\n△\nAPI Function\nHeader File\nDescription\nNm_NetworkStartIndication\nNm.h\nNotification that a NM-message has been received\nin the Bus-Sleep Mode, what indicates that some\nnodes in the network have already entered the\nNetwork Mode.\nNm_PduRxIndication\nNm.h\nNotification that a NM message has been received.\nNm_PncBitVectorRxIndication\nNm.h\nIndication that a bus specific network management\nhas received a NM message on a particular\nNM-channel that contain a PNC bit vector. This is\nused to aggregate the external PNC requests. The\nfunction evaluate if a relevant PNC request (PNC bit\nset to ’1’) is available in the given PNC bit vector. If a\nrelevant PNC request is available (PNC bit passes\nthe PNC bit vector filter), then the RelevantPnc\nRequestDetectedPtr refers to a boolean with value\nset to TRUE. Otherwise refer to booelan with value\nset to FALSE. RelevantPncRequestDetectedPtr is\nevaluated by the callee <Bus>Nm module to qualify\nthe further processing of the received NM-PDU.\nNm_PncBitVectorTxConfirmation\nNm.h\nFunction called by <Bus>Nms to confirm the state of\nthe transmission for the given PNC bit vector on the\ngiven NM-Channel.\nNm_PncBitVectorTxIndication\nNm.h\nFunction called by <Bus>Nms to request the\naggregated internal PNC requests for transmission\nwithin the Nm message.\nNm_RemoteSleepCancellation\nNm.h\nNotification that the network management has\ndetected that not all other nodes on the network are\nlonger ready to enter Bus-Sleep Mode.\nNm_RemoteSleepIndication\nNm.h\nNotification that the network management has\ndetected that all other nodes on the network are\nready to enter Bus-Sleep Mode.\nNm_RepeatMessageIndication\nNm.h\nService to indicate that an NM message with set\nRepeat Message Re- quest Bit has been received.\nThis is needed for node detection and the Dynamic\nPNC-to-channel-mapping feature.\nNm_StateChangeNotification\nNm.h\nNotification that the state of the lower layer\n<Bus>Nm has changed.\nNm_SynchronizationPoint\nNm.h\nNotification to the NM Coordinator functionality that\nthis is a suitable point in time to initiate the\ncoordinated shutdown on.\nPduR_FrNmTriggerTransmit\nPduR_FrNm.h\nWithin this API, the upper layer module (called\nmodule) shall check whether the available data fits\ninto the buffer size reported by PduInfoPtr->Sdu\nLength. If it fits, it shall copy its data into the buffer\nprovided by PduInfoPtr->SduDataPtr and update the\nlength of the actual copied data in PduInfoPtr->Sdu\nLength. If not, it returns E_NOT_OK without\nchanging PduInfoPtr.\nPduR_FrNmTxConfirmation\nPduR_FrNm.h\nThe lower layer communication interface module\nconfirms the transmission of a PDU, or the failure to\ntransmit a PDU.\n⌋\nThe usage of certain external APIs by FlexRay network Manangement is defined by\nconfiguration:\n• FrIf_GetNmVector Configured by configuration parameter FrIfGetNmVec-\ntorSupport\n• Nm_PduRxIndication Configured if FrNmPduRxIndicationEnabled is\nconfigured (see [ECUC_FrNm_00046])\n• Nm_RemoteSleepCancellation Configured by FrNmRemoteSleepIndica-\ntionEnabled (see [ECUC_FrNm_00044])\n• Nm_RemoteSleepIndication Configured by FrNmRemoteSleepIndica-\ntionEnabled (see [ECUC_FrNm_00044])\n• Nm_StateChangeNotification Configured by FrNmStateChangeIndica-\ntionEnabled (see [ECUC_FrNm_00047])\n• Nm_SynchronizationPoint\nConfigured\nby\nFrNmSynchronization-\nPointEnabled (see [ECUC_FrNm_00021])"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.6.2 Optional interfaces\nThis section defines all interfaces, which are required to fulfill an optional functionality\nof the module.\n[SWS_FrSM_00097] Definition of optional interfaces requested by module FrSM\n⌈\nAPI Function\nHeader File\nDescription\nDem_SetEventStatus\nDem.h\nCalled by SW-Cs or BSW modules to report monitor\nstatus information to the Dem. BSW modules calling\nDem_SetEventStatus can safely ignore the return\nvalue. This API will be available only if ({Dem/Dem\nConfigSet/DemEventParameter/DemEvent\nReportingType} == STANDARD_REPORTING)\nDet_ReportError\nDet.h\nService to report development errors.\nFrIf_AllSlots\nFrIf.h\nWraps the FlexRay Driver API function Fr_AllSlots\nFrIf_GetNumOfStartupFrames\nFrIf.h\nWraps the FlexRay Driver API function Fr_GetNum\nOfStartupFrames and gets a list of the current\nnumber of startup frames seen on the cluster. See\nvariable vStartupPairs of [12] for details.\nFrIf_GetWakeupRxStatus\nFrIf.h\nWraps the FlexRay Driver API function Fr_Get\nWakeupRxStatus and gets the wakeup received\ninformation from the FlexRay controller.\nFrIf_SetWakeupChannel\nFrIf.h\nWraps the FlexRay Driver API function Fr_Set\nWakeupChannel(). The enum value \"FR_\nCHANNEL_AB\" shall not be used.\nFrNm_StartupError\nFrNm.h\nThis function is called by the FrSM when\nsynchronization of the FlexRay cluster could not be\nachieved.\n⌋"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_8_6_3_Configurable_interfaces_FLEXRAYSTATEMANAGER",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayStateManager",

      "relevance_score": 0.85,

      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",

      "verbatim_text": "8.6.3 Configurable interfaces\nIn this section, all interfaces are listed where the target function could be configured.\nThe target function is usually a callback function. The names of this kind of interfaces\nare not fixed because they are configurable.\n8.6.3.1\n<Cdd>_SyncLossErrorIndication\n[SWS_FrSM_00190] Definition of configurable interface <Cdd>_SyncLossError\nIndication ⌈\nService Name\n<Cdd>_SyncLossErrorIndication\nSyntax\nvoid <Cdd>_SyncLossErrorIndication (\nNetworkHandleType NetworkHandle,\nboolean SyncLossErrorStatus\n)\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different FlexRay clusters\nNetworkHandle\nHandle of FlexRay cluster\nParameters (in)\nSyncLossErrorStatus\ntrue: ECU lost synchronization to the FlexRay cluster. false: ECU\ncan synchronize to the FlexRay cluster or request for full\ncommunication has been released after the ECU lost its\nsynchronization to the FlexRay cluster.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nNone\n▽\n△\nDescription\nThis function is called with parameter SyncLossErrorStatus = true when the ECU loses its\nsynchronization to the FlexRay cluster. The function is called with parameter SyncLossError\nStatus = false either when the ECU can synchronize to the FlexRay cluster or when the request\nfor full communication has been released after the ECU lost its synchronization to the FlexRay\ncluster.\nAvailable via\nFrSM_Externals.h\n⌋\nThe name of this function can be configured using the configuration parameter FrSM\nSyncLossErrorIndicationName (see Section 10.2.3). The FrSM will call this function\nwhen the ECU looses its synchronization to the FlexRay cluster, after it could synchro-\nnize to the FlexRay cluster or when the FullCom request is released after the ECU lost\nits synchronization to the FlexRay cluster."
    },

      "verbatim_text": "9.1.2 Authentication during triggered transmission\nscheduled main task\n«module»\nFrIf\n«module»\nCom\n«module»\nPduR\n«module»\nSecOC\nScheduled main task:\nChecks first if  messages\nneed to be processed:\nif yes it does the\nprocessing,\nif not it returns.\nPlease note, triggered\ntransmission has to be\nmapped to normal\ntransmission for the upper\nlayer. SecOC buffers and\nauthenticates the data and\nserves the LL when trans data\nrequest are handled by the\nSOC\nSecOC_IfTransmit(Std_ReturnType,\nPduIdType, const PduInfoType*)\nPduR_ComTransmit(Std_ReturnType,\nPduIdType, const PduInfoType*)\nFrIf_Transmit(Std_ReturnType,\nPduIdType, const PduInfoType *)\nPduR_SecOCIfTxConfirmation(PduIdType,\nStd_ReturnType)\nprepare()\nSecOC_TriggerTransmit(Std_ReturnType,\nPduIdType, PduInfoType*)\nPduR_FrIfTriggerTransmit(Std_ReturnType,\nPduIdType, PduInfoType*)\nCom_TxConfirmation(PduIdType, Std_ReturnType)\nSecOC_TxConfirmation(PduIdType, Std_ReturnType)\nauthenticate()\nPduR_SecOCTransmit(Std_ReturnType,\nPduIdType, const PduInfoType*)\ncopyBuffer()\ncopyBuffer()\nPduR_FrIfTxConfirmation(PduIdType, Std_ReturnType)\nFigure 9:  Authentication during Triggered Transmission"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_9_1_2_TransmitWithDecoupledBufferAccess",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayInterface",
      "source_page": 102,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "9.1.2 TransmitWithDecoupledBufferAccess\n«module»\nLSduR\n\u0001\n\u0002\n\u0003\n\u0004\u0005\n\u0007\n\b\n\u0002\n\u0004 \u0005\n\u000e\n\u0002\n\u000f\nInterrupt Service\nRoutine\nFrIf: FrIf\nFr: Fr\nloop\nalt PDU's TrigTxCounter > 0 || (FrIfNodeMode == true)\n[YES]\n[NO]\nalt opt(AlwaysTransmit == TRUE) || (At least one PDU is up-to-date)\n\u0010\n\u0011\n\u0012 \u0013\n\u0002\n\u0004\n\u0014\n\u0015 \u0016\n\u0005\n\b\n\u0016\n\u000e\n\u0005\n\u0017\n\u0010\n\u0018\n\u0017\n\u000e\n\u0010\u0011\n\u0012 \u0013 \u0019\n\u0004\n\u0013 \u0015\n\u000e \f \u0005\n\u0017\n\u001a\n\u0002\n\u0005\n\u0002\n\u0004\n\u0018\n\u0003\n\u001b\n\u0017\n\u000e\n\u0004\n\u0014\n\u0015\n\u0005\n\b\n\u000e\n\u0005\n\u0017\n\u0010\nFrIf_JobListExec_<FrIfCluster.ShortName>()\n[Update-Bit configured for this PDU] :\nMark PDU's Update-Bit as \"outdated\"()\n[Update-Bit configured for this\nPDU] : Mark PDU's Update-Bit as\n\"up-to-date\"()\nDetermine PDU's Byte Offset in Fram and\nPDU-owning Upper Layer, Set FrIf_SduPtr\n= Fr_LSduPtr + ByteOffset()\nLSduR_FrIfTriggerTransmit()\nSet Fr_SduPtr to a temporary\nL-SDU buffer in the FrIf()\nFrIf_JobListExec_<FrIfCluster.ShortName>()\nFrIf_Transmit()\n[PDU's TrigTxCounter < PDU's\nCounterLimit] : Increment PDU's\nTrigTxCounter()\n[Fr_TransmitTxSdu() returned\nE_NOT_OK] : Roll back the changed\nvalues for TxConfCounter for each PDU\nthat is uo-to-date in this Frame and the\nTriggerTxCounter for each PDU that is\nup-to-date in this Frame\nDecrement PDU's TrigTxCounter()\nFr_TransmitTxLPdu()\n[PDU's TxConfCounter < PDU's\nCounterLimit] : Increment PDU's\nTXConfCounter()\nFigure 9.2: Transmit With Decoupled Buffer Access"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRSM_FIGURE_Figure_7_1",

      "source_page": 24,

      "relevance_score": 0.98,
      "disposition": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "verified",
      "guideline": "Normativ verbindlicher Beleg (🔒 Verifizierter Kontext)",
      "verbatim_text": "Figure 7.1: FrSM state machine Note that the states are described in Chapter 7.3.2. The following table defines the events and conditions that trigger the transitions of FrSM state machine and the actions that are executed within the transitions. Each row of the table contains a requirement which should be interpreted as follows. If the FrSM module is in the source state of the transition in column \"T ransition\" as defined in [SWS_FrSM_00093] and when the condition in column \"Event [Condition]\" holds and if the event in column \"Event [Condition]\" occurs, then the actions in column \"Actions\" shall be executed and afterwards the FrSM module shall change its state to the target state of the transition in column \"T ransition\" as defined in [SWS_FrSM_00093]. In case different actions have to be performed in a transition T , there can be multiple rows in the table. The rows are denoted as T (a), T (b) etc. in this case. Note that the conditions ensure that only one of the possibilities matches. [SWS_FrSM_00093] ⌈The FrSM shall execute the actions of the transition in the order that is defined in the table within [SWS_FrSM_00105]. ⌋"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRSM_SECTION_3_4_1_Startup_and_Shutdown",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "EXP_ModeManagementGuide",
      "source_page": 45,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "3.4.1 Startup and Shutdown\nBesides the initialization of the communication stack the BswM can be configured to\ninitialize further modules or execute customs actions depending on the ECU’s needs.\nDue to the flexibility of the BswM it is also possible, that after a wake up event only a\npart of the communication stack is started.\nAnalogue to Startup, it is possible to configure additional actions to be executed on\nshutdown."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRSM_SECTION_3_4_Communication_Management",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "EXP_ModeManagementGuide",
      "source_page": 36,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "3.4 Communication Management\nBesides parts of the ECU state management, the BswM is also responsible for parts\nof the communication management. This section describes the functionality of the\nBswM, which is related to the Communication Stack of AUTOSAR. This covers but is\nnot restricted to the following uses cases.\n• Starting and stopping of IPDU Groups in general\n• Partial Networking\n• Diagnostic use cases which influence the communication of an ECU. e.g.\nit\nmight be necessary to set the FlexRay State manager to passive mode via\nFrSm_SetEcuPassive() when requested by an application.\n• Service Discovery Control for Appplication SWCs\nTo fulfill the requested functionality the BswM has ModeRequestSources to\n• the Communication Manager\n• the bus state managers\n• AUTOSAR COM\n• Service Discovery"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "7.3.2 States\n[SWS_FrSM_00032] ⌈The state machine shall comprise the following states:\n• FRSM_READY\n• FRSM_WAKEUP\n• FRSM_STARTUP\n• FRSM_HALT_REQ\n• FRSM_ONLINE\n• FRSM_ONLINE_PASSIVE\n• FRSM_KEYSLOT_ONLY\n• FRSM_LOW_NUMBER_OF_COLDSTARTERS\n⌋\nTable 7.1 provides additional information about the state machine states.\nFrSM Cluster State\nMapped FlexRay CC state\nDescription\nFRSM_READY\nPOC:ready\nFRSM_WAKEUP\nPOC:wake-up\nFrSM performs wake-up\nFRSM_STARTUP\nPOC:start-up\nFrSM performs startup\nFRSM_HALT_REQ\nPOC:normal active\nor POC:normal passive\nFrSM performs a shutdown\nFRSM_ONLINE\nPOC:normal active\nFull Communication\nFRSM_ONLINE_PASSIVE\nPOC:normal passive\nDue to clock synchronization errors no\ndata is transmitted or received.\nFRSM_KEYSLOT_ONLY\nPOC:normal active\nand vPOCSlotMode̸ = AllSlots\nData can only be transmitted in the key\nslots.\nFRSM_LOW_NUMBER_OF_\nCOLDSTARTERS\nPOC:normal active\nFull communication; FlexRay is\nsynchronized based on sync frames\nonly.\nTable 7.1: FrSM states and their mapping\n[SWS_FrSM_00176] ⌈For controlling the passive mode (receive-only), the state ma-\nchine shall additionally comprise the following states which concurrent to the states\nabove:\n• FRSM_ECU_ACTIVE\n• FRSM_ECU_PASSIVE\n⌋\nTable 7.2 provides more information about the additional states.\nFrSM additional State\nDescription\nFRSM_ECU_ACTIVE\nWhen the FrSM is concurrently in state FRSM_READY, the transceivers are in set\ninto mode FRTRCV_TRCVMODE_STANDBY, otherwise into mode FRTRCV_\nTRCVMODE_NORMAL\nFRSM_ECU_PASSIVE\nWhen the FrSM is concurrently in state FRSM_READY, the transceivers are in set\ninto mode FRTRCV_TRCVMODE_STANDBY, otherwise into mode FRTRCV_\nTRCVMODE_RECEIVEONLY.\nTable 7.2: FrSM Additional States\n[SWS_FrSM_00180] ⌈For reporting these two concurrent states to the BswM, a corre-\nsponding value of FrSM_BswM_StateType shall be determined as follows:\n• FrSM additional state is FRSM_ECU_ACTIVE then the according FrSM state is\nreported, e.g. FRSM_ONLINE\n• FrSM additional state is FRSM_ECU_PASSIVE then the according FrSM state is\nreported with the postfix ’_ECU_PASSIVE’, e.g. FRSM_ONLINE_ECU_PASSIVE\n⌋\nTable 7.3 provides all possible reportings to BswM\nFrSM Cluster State\nFrSM additional State\nFrSM_BswM_StateType value\nFRSM_READY\nFRSM_ECU_ACTIVE\nFRSM_READY\nFRSM_READY\nFRSM_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_READY_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_WAKEUP\nFRSM_ECU_ACTIVE\nFRSM_WAKEUP\nFRSM_WAKEUP\nFRSM_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_WAKEUP_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_STARTUP\nFRSM_ECU_ACTIVE\nFRSM_STARTUP\nFRSM_STARTUP\nFRSM_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_STARTUP_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_ONLINE\nFRSM_ECU_ACTIVE\nFRSM_ONLINE\nFRSM_ONLINE\nFRSM_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_ONLINE_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_ONLINE_PASSIVE\nFRSM_ECU_ACTIVE\nFRSM_ONLINE_PASSIVE\nFRSM_ONLINE_PASSIVE\nFRSM_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_ONLINE_PASSIVE_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_KEYSLOT_ONLY\nFRSM_ECU_ACTIVE\nFRSM_KEYSLOT_ONLY\nFRSM_KEYSLOT_ONLY\nFRSM_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_KEYSLOT_ONLY_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_HALT_REQ\nFRSM_ECU_ACTIVE\nFRSM_HALT_REQ\nFRSM_HALT_REQ\nFRSM_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_HALT_REQ_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_LOW_NUMBER_OF_COLDSTARTERS\nFRSM_ECU_ACTIVE\nFRSM_LOW_NUMBER_OF_\nCOLDSTARTERS\nFRSM_LOW_NUMBER_OF_COLDSTARTERS\nFRSM_ECU_PASSIVE\nFRSM_LOW_NUMBER_OF_\nCOLDSTARTERS_ECU_PASSIVE\nTable       "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRSM_SECTION_7_3_3_Variables",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayStateManager",
      "source_page": 18,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.3.3 Variables\nIn addition to its state, the state machine description uses the following variables. Note\nthat these variables are only auxiliary means for improving the clearness and the read-\nability of the specification.\nFrSM Variable\nType\nDescription\nreqComMode\nComM_ModeType\nThe communication mode that has been requested by the\nComM.\nThe communication modes are abbreviated in this\ndocument as follows:\nNoCom: COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION\nSilentCom: COMM_SILENT_COMMUNICATION\nFullCom: COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION\nAccording to the definition of ComM_ModeType these\nmodes are ordered as follows:\nNoCom < SilentCom < FullCom\nstartupCounter\nInteger\nThe number of startup attempts that have been performed\nwakeupType\nEnum\nThe following values are supported:\n• SingleChannelWakeup\n• DualChannelWakeup\n• DualChannelWakeupForward\n• NoWakeup\nwakeupTransmitted\nBoolean\nTrue if vPOC!WakeupStatus = FR_WAKEUP_\nTRANSMITTED for at least attempt to transmit a wakeup\npattern, false otherwise\nbusTrafficDetected\nBoolean\nTrue if vPOC!WakeupStatus = FR_WAKEUP_RECEIVED_\nHEADER or FR_WAKEUP_RECEIVED_WUP for at least\nattempt to transmit a wakeup pattern, false otherwise\nwakeupCounter\nInteger\nThe number of attempts that have been performed for\ntransmitting a wakeup pattern.\nTable 7.4: FrSM variables\nNote that the silent communication mode (SilentCom) is not supported on FlexRay;\nit may not be requested by the ComM module."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRSM_SECTION_7_3_8_Wakeup_Pattern_Transmission",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayStateManager",
      "source_page": 27,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.3.8 Wakeup Pattern Transmission\n[SWS_FrSM_00208] ⌈The FrSM shall repeat the transmission of wakeup patterns ac-\ncording to the configuration parameter FrSMNumWakeupPatterns. I.e. the FlexRay\nState Manager shall perform the following actions while being in state FRSM_WAKEUP:\n• Set counter wakeupCounter to 1 when the state FRSM_WAKEUP is entered\n• While wakeupCounter < FrSMNumWakeupPatterns and busTrafficDe-\ntected = false:\n– Wait until the FlexRay controllers of the FlexRay cluster are in state FR_\nREADY\n– When the FlexRay controllers are in state FR_READY, check vPOC!Wakeup\nStatus of the FlexRay controllers and act as follows:\n∗if vPOC!WakeupStatus = FR_WAKEUP_RECEIVED_HEADER ∨FR_\nWAKEUP_RECEIVED_WUP: busTrafficDetected := true\n∗else if vPOC!WakeupStatus = FR_WAKEUP_TRANSMITTED: wakeup-\nTransmitted := true\n∗else: wakeupTransmitted := false\n• If busTrafficDetected = false and wakeupCounter < FrSMNumWakeup-\nPatterns, execute FE_WAKEUP\n• Increment the wakeupCounter\nIf any of the FlexRay controllers enters the HALT state due to an error condition, the\nwakeup pattern transmission shall be aborted and the wakeupFinished condition\nshall evaluate to true.⌋"
    },

Each\nrow of the table contains a requirement which should be interpreted as follows. If the\nFrSM module is in the source state of the transition in column \"Transition\" as defined in\n[SWS_FrSM_00093] and when the condition in column \"Event [Condition]\" holds and\nif the event in column \"Event [Condition]\" occurs, then the actions in column \"Actions\"\nshall be executed and afterwards the FrSM module shall change its state to the target\nstate of the transition in column \"Transition\" as defined in [SWS_FrSM_00093].\nIn case different actions have to be performed in a transition T, there can be multiple\nrows in the table. The rows are denoted as T (a), T (b) etc. in this case. [Condition]\nActions\nT00\nFrSM_Init()\nFE_CONFIG\nT01 (a)\n[ reqComMode = FullCom\n∧FrSMIsWakeupEcu\n∧WUReason = NO_WU_BY_BUS\n∧¬ FrSMIsDualChannelNode\n]\nFE_TRCV_NORMAL\nstartupCounter := wakeupFinished\n∧reqComMode = FullCom\n∧FrSMNumWakeupPatterns = 1\n∧wakeupType = SingleChannelWakeup\n]\nFE_START\ncancel t1\nstart t1\nstart t2\n▽\n△\nTransi-\ntion\nEvent [Condition]\nActions\nT03       "verbatim_text": "8.2.2 FrSM_BswM_StateType\n[SWS_FrSM_00199] Definition of datatype FrSM_BswM_StateType ⌈\nName\nFrSM_BswM_StateType\nKind\nEnumeration\nFRSM_BSWM_READY\n0x00\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_READY_\nECU_PASSIVE\n0x01\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_STARTUP\n0x02\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_STARTUP_\nECU_PASSIVE\n0x03\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_WAKEUP\n0x04\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_WAKEUP_\nECU_PASSIVE\n0x05\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_HALT_REQ\n0x06\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_HALT_\nREQ_ECU_PASSIVE\n0x07\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_KEYSLOT_\nONLY\n0x08\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_KEYSLOT_\nONLY_ECU_PASSIVE\n0x09\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_ONLINE\n0x0A\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_ONLINE_\nECU_PASSIVE\n0x0B\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_ONLINE_\nPASSIVE\n0x0C\n–\nFRSM_BSWM_ONLINE_\nPASSIVE_ECU_PASSIVE\n0x0D\n–\nFRSM_LOW_NUMBER_\nOF_COLDSTARTERS\n0x0E\n–\nRange\nFRSM_LOW_NUMBER_\nOF_COLDSTARTERS_\nECU_PASSIVE\n0x0F\n–\nDescription\nThis type defines the states that are reported to the BswM using BswM_FrSM_CurrentState.\nAvailable via\nFrSM.h\n⌋"

    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRSM_SECTION_8_3_1_FrSM_Init",
      "source_element": null,
