      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "8.3.1 FrSM_Init\n[SWS_FrSM_00013] Definition of API function FrSM_Init\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00405, SRS_BSW_00438, SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_BSW_\n00358, SRS_BSW_00460, SRS_BSW_00485\n⌈\nService Name\nFrSM_Init\nSyntax\nvoid FrSM_Init (\nconst FrSM_ConfigType* FrSM_ConfigPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x01\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant\nParameters (in)\nFrSM_ConfigPtr\nPointer to a selected configuration structure\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nNone\nDescription\nInitializes the FlexRay State Manager.\nAvailable via\nFrSM.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00126]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00438, SRS_BSW_00101\n⌈The FrSM_Init function shall initialize the state machines for all FlexRay clusters\nand set them into the state FRSM_READY, i.e. perform transition T00.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00127]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00438, SRS_BSW_00483\n⌈The FrSM_Init function shall internally store the configuration data address to en-\nable subsequent API calls to access the configuration data.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00128]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00438\n⌈If development error detection is enabled (FrSMDevErrorDetect is ON), the FrSM_\nInit function shall remember internally the successful initialization for other API func-\ntions to check for proper module initialization.⌋"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRSM_SECTION_8_3_2_FrSM_RequestComMode",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayStateManager",
      "source_page": 36,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "8.3.2 FrSM_RequestComMode\n[SWS_FrSM_00020] Definition of API function FrSM_RequestComMode\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_BSW_00460, SRS_BSW_00461, SRS_BSW_\n00484\n⌈\nService Name\nFrSM_RequestComMode\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrSM_RequestComMode (\nNetworkHandleType network,\nComM_ModeType mode\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x40\nSync/Async\nAsynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different networks. Non reentrant for the same network.\nnetwork\nHandle of the communication network\nParameters (in)\nmode\nRequested communication mode\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: Request accepted\nE_NOT_OK: Request not accepted\nDescription\nRequest of a new communication mode.\nAvailable via\nFrSM.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00021] ⌈The FrSM_RequestComMode function shall store the re-\nquested communication mode.⌋\nThe next activation of the FrSM_MainFunction will then process this request when\nprocessing the state machine of the corresponding cluster.\nNote, that the state machine definition in Chapter 7.2 refers to this stored request as\nreqComMode.\n[SWS_FrSM_00022] ⌈If NoCom is requested after FullCom has been reached (i.e.\nwhen the FrSM state machine of the corresponding cluster is in state FRSM_ON-\nLINE, FRSM_KEYSLOT_ONLY, FRSM_LOW_NUMBER_OF_COLDSTARTERS or FRSM_-\nONLINE_PASSIVE), the FrSM_RequestComMode function shall immediately process\nthe corresponding transition of the state machine (see [SWS_FrSM_00093]).⌋\nRationale of [SWS_FrSM_00022]: This shall ensure that the NoCom request will stop\nthe participation of the ECU in the FlexRay communication at the end of the current\nFlexRay cycle.\n[SWS_FrSM_00141]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If the parameter mode has the value COMM_SILENT_COMMUNICATION, the FrSM\nshall not store the requested communication mode and return E_NOT_OK. In case de-\nvelopment error detection is enabled, the FrSM shall additionally raise the development\nerror code FRSM_E_INV_MODE.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00018]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00369, SRS_BSW_00323, SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If development error detection is enabled and the parameter network has an in-\nvalid value, the FrSM_RequestComMode function shall raise the development error\ncode FRSM_E_INV_HANDLE and the FrSM_RequestComMode function shall return\nE_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00019]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If development error detection is enabled and the parameter mode has an invalid\nvalue, the FrSM_RequestComMode function shall raise the development error code\nFRSM_E_INV_MODE and the FrSM_RequestComMode function shall return E_NOT_\nOK.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00061]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00406, SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If development error detection is enabled and the FrSM module has not been initial-\nized using FrSM_Init, the FrSM_RequestComMode function shall raise the devel-\nopment error code FRSM_E_UNINIT and the function FrSM_RequestComMode shall\nreturn E_NOT_OK.⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.3.3 FrSM_GetCurrentComMode\n[SWS_FrSM_00024] Definition of API function FrSM_GetCurrentComMode\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_BSW_00460, SRS_BSW_00461, SRS_BSW_\n00484\n⌈\nService Name\nFrSM_GetCurrentComMode\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrSM_GetCurrentComMode (\nNetworkHandleType network,\nComM_ModeType* mode\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x41\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different networks. Non reentrant for the same network.\nParameters (in)\nnetwork\nHandle of the communication channel\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nmode\nPointer to the memory location where the current communication\nmode shall be stored\n▽\n△\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: Request accepted\nE_NOT_OK: Request not accepted\nDescription\nQuery the current communication mode.\nAvailable via\nFrSM.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00025] ⌈The FrSM_GetCurrentComMode function shall write the cur-\nrent communication mode of the corresponding FlexRay cluster into the given memory\nlocation.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00026]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00483\n⌈The FrSM_GetCurrentComMode function shall determine the communication mode\nas follows:\n• If the FrSM state machine for the FlexRay cluster determined by the param-\neter network is in state FRSM_ONLINE or FRSM_LOW_NUMBER_OF_COLD-\nSTARTERS, the communication mode is COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION.\n• In any other case, the communication mode is COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION.\n⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00027]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If development error detection is enabled and the parameter network has an in-\nvalid value, the FrSM_GetCurrentComMode function shall raise the development er-\nror code FRSM_E_INV_HANDLE and the FrSM_GetCurrentComMode function shall\nreturn E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00028]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00369, SRS_BSW_00323, SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If development error detection is enabled and the parameter mode equals NULL_\nPTR, the FrSM_GetCurrentComMode function shall raise the development error code\nFRSM_E_PARAM_POINTER and the FrSM_GetCurrentComMode function shall re-\nturn E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00060]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00406, SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If development error detection is enabled and the FrSM module has not been ini-\ntialized using FrSM_Init, the FrSM_GetCurrentComMode function shall raise the\ndevelopment error code FRSM_E_UNINIT and the FrSM_GetCurrentComMode func-\ntion shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋"
    },

The version information includes:\n• Module Id\n• Vendor Id\n• Vendor specific version numbers (BSW00407).\nThis function shall be pre compile time configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter:\nFRSM_VERSION_INFO_API\nHint: If source code for caller and callee of this function is available this function should be\nrealized as a macro.       "verbatim_text": "8.3.5 FrSM_AllSlots\n[SWS_FrSM_00172] Definition of API function FrSM_AllSlots\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_BSW_00460, SRS_BSW_00484\n⌈\nService Name\nFrSM_AllSlots\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrSM_AllSlots (\nNetworkHandleType NetworkHandle\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x05\nSync/Async\nAsynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different FlexRay clusters\nParameters (in)\nNetworkHandle\nThis parameter identifies the FlexRay cluster for which a\ncommunication mode is requested.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: Request accepted\nE_NOT_OK: Request not accepted\nDescription\nThis API function can be used to leave the KeySlotOnlyMode.\nAvailable via\nFrSM.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00197] ⌈The FrSM_AllSlots function shall be pre compile time con-\nfigurable ON/OFF by the configuration parameter FrSMAllSlotsSupport⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00171] ⌈The FrSM_AllSlots function shall call FrIf_AllSlots for each\ncontroller of the FlexRay cluster. It shall return E_OK if each of these calls returned E_\nOK, otherwise FrSM_AllSlots shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00168]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00369, SRS_BSW_00323, SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If development error detection is enabled and the parameter NetworkHandle has an\ninvalid value, the FrSM_AllSlots function shall raise the development error code\nFRSM_E_INV_HANDLE and the FrSM_AllSlots function shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00169]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00406, SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If development error detection is enabled and the FrSM module has not been ini-\ntialized using FrSM_Init, the FrSM_AllSlots function shall raise the development\nerror code FRSM_E_UNINIT and the FrSM_AllSlots function shall return E_NOT_\nOK.⌋"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRSM_SECTION_8_3_6_FrSM_SetEcuPassive",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayStateManager",
      "source_page": 40,

      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "8.3.6 FrSM_SetEcuPassive\n[SWS_FrSM_00174] Definition of API function FrSM_SetEcuPassive\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_BSW_00460, SRS_BSW_00484\n⌈\nService Name\nFrSM_SetEcuPassive\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrSM_SetEcuPassive (\nboolean FrSM_Passive\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x06\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant\nParameters (in)\nFrSM_Passive\nThis parameter determines whether all FlexRay clusters are set\nto passive, i.e. receive only.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\n▽\n△\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: Request accepted\nE_NOT_OK: Request not accepted\nDescription\nThis API function can be used to set all FlexRay clusters of the ECU to a receive only mode.\nAvailable via\nFrSM.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00177] ⌈The FrSM_SetEcuPassive function shall set the state of all\nFrSM state machines to FRSM_ECU_PASSIVE if the parameter FrSM_Passive evalu-\nates to true, otherwise it shall set the state of all FrSM state machines to FRSM_ECU_\nACTIVE.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00178] ⌈If the state machine of a FlexRay cluster is not in state FRSM_\nREADY (i.e.\nthe transceivers of the FlexRay cluster are not in standby mode), the\nfunction shall execute FE_TRCV_NORMAL for this cluster.⌋\n[SWS_FrSM_00179]\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00406, SRS_BSW_00350\n⌈If development error detection is enabled and the FrSM module has not been ini-\ntialized using FrSM_Init, the FrSM_SetEcuPassive function shall raise the devel-\nopment error code FRSM_E_UNINIT and the FrSM_SetEcuPassive function shall\nreturn E_NOT_OK.⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "Figure 10.8: BandwidthControl by FlowControl Parameters In a network four FlexRay nodes are connected. 4 PDUs are defined for the sender node. T wo of the receivers have bandwidth limitations (ECU1 and ECU2). The configuration restrictions are: [SWS_FrTp_01173] Bandwidth limitation needs to be enabled when flow control parameter BC is used ⌈If bandwidth limitation in a connection to a certain ECU is real- ized by FlowControl parameter BC (without HW-FIFO mechanism), the attribute \"FrTp- BandwidthLimitation\"within the corresponding connection shall be set to \"TRUE\". ⌋ [SWS_FrTp_01174] Start frame handling in case of bandwith limitation ⌈If band- width limitation is realized by FlowControl parameter BC and if the attribute \"FrTpBand- widthLimitation\" is T rue, a Start Frame to initiate a communication link shall always be send in the first PDU of the referenced PDU-Pool. This is valid for both 1:1 and 1:n connections. Note: The reason for using the first frame of the pool in case of bandwidth limitation is historical. Bandwidth limitation is only required for FlexRay controllers with a limited number of buffers, which are then assigned to the first slots of the pool (the ones with the lowest numbers).⌋ [SWS_FrTp_01175] Flow control handling according to bandwith control param- eter ⌈If an ECU responds with a FlowControl-Parameter BandwidthControl. MPPC != 0 (\"zero\") the sender shall use only the number of BC.MPPC PDUs of the PDU-Pool in ascending order to transmit data within that connection. ⌋ ransportLayer"
    },

In some cases it is required to have a maximum communication in parrallel on the other hand it is required to have maximum bandwidth to exactly on ECU (e.g. reprogramming purpose).       "verbatim_text": "Figure 7.13: Transmit Cancellation at unsegmented data transfer If a requested but currently not started data transfer shall be cancelled the service primitive FrTp_CancelTransmit is called. FrTp_CancelTransmit shall cancel the requested data transfer. On receiver side no data transfer is recognized. ransportLayer"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRTP_FIGURE_Figure_7_14",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayISOTransportLayer",
      "source_page": 60,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.98,
      "disposition": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "verified",
      "guideline": "Normativ verbindlicher Beleg (🔒 Verifizierter Kontext)",
      "verbatim_text": "Figure 7.14: Transmit Cancellation at segmented data transfer If an ongoing data transfer shall be cancelled, the service primitive FrTp_Cancel- Transmit is called. FrTp_CancelTransmit shall cancel the current data transfer process. On receiver side an initial data reception is recognized and processed (e.g. call of service primitive PduR_FrTpStartOfReception, send FlowControl N-PDU etc.). If the sender cancels data transfer a timeout occurs on receiver side. If no retry is configured, this timeout is used to cancel the current reception by calling the service primitive PduR_FrTpRxIndication with the corresponding notification result error code. If retry is configured, the receiver sends an additional FlowControl 26. After a configured amount of retries the final timeout is used to cancel the current reception by calling the service primitive PduR_FrTpRxIndication with the corresponding notification result error code."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRTP_FIGURE_Figure_7_15",

      "guideline": "Normativ verbindlicher Beleg (🔒 Verifizierter Kontext)",
      "verbatim_text": "Figure 7.15: Timing parameter definition for one PDU transmission per Main-Function call As described above it is possible to transmit more than one N-PDU per connection within on FlexRay Communication Cycle. Hence the communication handler shall be able to call LSduR_FrTpTransmit API several times (depending on available N- PDUs within the Tx-PDU-Pool) independent whether FrTp_TxConfirmation for the previously transmitted N-PDUs is given. Due to that, timing behaviour (e.g. Start FRTP_Time_AS etc.) is different too. If more than one N-PDU shall be transmitted within one Main-Function call the timing behaviour is depict in Figure 7.16. ransportLayer"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "Figure 7.16: Timing parameter definition for multiple PDU transmission per Main- Function call Note: Bandwidth Control restricts the number of N-PDUs per Flexray-Cycle. This has an impact to FrTp_Time_CS and. Hence that time depends on implementation (task schedule of FrTp_MainFunction and the corresponding FlowControl Parameters) For details please refer to Chapter 7.3.3.3. ransportLayer"
    },
    {

      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRTP_SECTION_10_4_5_Configuration_Requirements_on_the_FlexRay_Interface",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayISOTransportLayer",
      "source_page": 122,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "10.4.5 Configuration Requirements on the FlexRay Interface\nIf more than one Fr N-PDU is used for one Fr N-SDU within a connection, the FrIf\nshall guarantee that the Fr N-PDUs (Fr L-SDUs) are scheduled (sent over the bus)\nin the same order the FlexRay Transport Protocol Layer uses them, i.e. in ascending\norder regarding the Fr N-PDU IDs used in the FlexRay Transport Protocol Layer. Fur-\nthermore these PDUs shall be scheduled with the same frequency and within one Job\n(concerning the Joblist) in the FlexRay Interface module (since the reading of the PDU-\nAvailable Information for all PDUs of a connection has to be atomic.) This is necessary\nto avoid CFs coming out of order in a segmented transfer.\nFor every FrTp L-SDU the PDU-Update/Valid Information of the FrIf shall be activated.\nFor each transmitted N-Pdu a TransmitConfirmations shall be given by the FrIf module\nvia the LSduR.\nFor every FrTp L-SDU no FrIf Trigger Transmit counter shall be utilized, i.e. the limit of\nthe respective counter shall be 1. This is necessary in order to avoid multiple service\nprimitive calls of FrTp_TriggerTransmit for the same Fr N-PDU in case e. g. a\nretry is necessary due to an timeout of the AS / AR timer.\nA\nChange history of AUTOSAR traceable items\nPlease note that the lists in this chapter also include traceable items that have been\nremoved from the specification in a later version. These items do not appear as hyper-\nlinks in the document.\nA.1\nTraceable item history of this document according to AU-\nTOSAR Release R25-11\nA.1.1\nAdded Specification Items in R25-11\nnone\nA.1.2\nChanged Specification Items in R25-11\nnone\nA.1.3\nDeleted Specification Items in R25-11\nnone\nB\nNot applicable requirements\n[SWS_FrTp_NA_09999] Not applicable requirements\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00306, SRS_BSW_00312, SRS_BSW_00314, SRS_BSW_\n00323,\nSRS_BSW_00325,\nSRS_BSW_00328,\nSRS_BSW_00330,\nSRS_BSW_00331, SRS_BSW_00333, SRS_BSW_00335, SRS_BSW_\n00341,\nSRS_BSW_00343,\nSRS_BSW_00345,\nSRS_BSW_00347,\nSRS_BSW_00350, SRS_BSW_00358, SRS_BSW_00373, SRS_BSW_\n00375,\nSRS_BSW_00377,\nSRS_BSW_00386,\nSRS_BSW_00401,\nSRS_BSW_00405, SRS_BSW_00409, SRS_BSW_00410, SRS_BSW_\n00413,\nSRS_BSW_00414,\nSRS_BSW_00415,\nSRS_BSW_00417,\nSRS_BSW_00423, SRS_BSW_00424, SRS_BSW_00425, SRS_BSW_\n00426,\nSRS_BSW_00427,\nSRS_BSW_00428,\nSRS_BSW_00429,\nSRS_BSW_00432, SRS_BSW_00433, SRS_BSW_00005, SRS_BSW_\n00006,\nSRS_BSW_00009,\nSRS_BSW_00010,\nSRS_BSW_00159,\nSRS_BSW_00160, SRS_BSW_00161, SRS_BSW_00162, SRS_BSW_\n00164, SRS_BSW_00167, SRS_BSW_00168, SRS_BSW_00172\n⌈These requirements are not applicable to this specification.⌋"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRTP_SECTION_13_This_scenario_could_occur_on_gateways_if_communication_via_more_connections_is_requested_than",

      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "13  This scenario could occur on gateways, if communication via more connections is requested than\nchannels resources are configured.\n[SWS_FrTp_01200]\n⌈ If the request for a message transmission has not been\naccepted due to another transmission for the specified address\ninformation is active; then FrTp_Transmit shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋()\nStep 5 - 10\nIf the TX_SDU_AVAILABLE flag is set, the FrTp module has to evaluate the length of\nthe currently available FrTp N-SDU data by calling the service primitive\nPduR_FrTpCopyTxData() 14 a first time. With knowledge of the available\ndata size FrTp module scans the FrTpTxPduPool and allocates the first free\nFrTpPdu for that data transfer. Depending on the available FrTp-N-SDU length and\nthe FrTpTxPduPool’s free FrTpPdu length the FrTp module decides whether\nsegmentation is necessary or not for that N-SDU transfer. By calling the service\nprimitive PduR_FrTpCopyTxData() the data shall be copied to the corresponding\nbuffer. In a next step the corresponding Address Information and PCI are prepared\nand the service primitive FrIf_Transmit is called with the corresponding TxPduId.\n[SWS_FrTp_01042]\n⌈If the TX_SDU_AVAILABLE flag is set, the FrTp module\nshall call the service primitive PduR_FrTpCopyTxData() to get the\ncurrently available FrTp N-SDU Length information.⌋()\n[SWS_FrTp_01045]\n⌈The FrTp module shall always allocate the first free\nFrTpTxPdu while scanning the corresponding FrTpTxPduPool (see\nalso chapter 7.3.2.2).⌋()\n[SWS_FrTp_01046]\n⌈If a free FrTpTxPdu is identified, the FrTp module shall\nuse this FrTpTxPdu to continue current transmission process.⌋()\n[SWS_FrTp_01047]\n⌈If no free FrTpTxPdu is identified, the FrTp module shall\npostpone processing for the corresponding connection till the next main\nfunction call.⌋()\nNote:\nFrTp module shall postpone the processing for the corresponding\nconnection until either free FrTpTxPdu is identified according to\nSWS_FrTp_01046 or a timeout occurs (see section 7.5.8)."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRTP_SECTION_14_The_available_data_length_evaluation_depends_on_different_scenarios_the_FrTp_is_used_in",
      "source_element": null,

      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "14  The available data length evaluation depends on different scenarios the FrTp is used in.\n- In case of a normal ECU which transfers data with unknown message lengths it is necessary to\nevaluate the length of the currently stored FrTp-N-SDU.\n- In case an ECU transmits data with known message length the Tx data length is given by the\nparameter of the FrTp_Transmit service primitive. An additional evaluation by calling\nPduR_FrTpCopyTxData(..) is possible to have equal evaluation sequences for known and\nunknown message length transfers but could be skipped by runtime optimisation (implementation\ndependency).\n- In case of a Gateway which routes N-SDUs of different bus systems it is necessary to get the\ncurrently available (received) data length in the gateway buffer.\n[SWS_FrTp_01048]\n⌈The FrTp module shall decide whether segmentation for\nthe requested N-SDU transfer is required or not depending on the\nlength information of the first allocated FrTpTxPdu from an\nFrTpTxPduPool for the currently processed FrTpConnection (see\nalso Diagram 2). ⌋()\nFrTpTxSdu.Length >\n( FrTpTxPdu.Length -\nAI.Length - PCI.Length )\nInitial processing of FrTpTxSdu\nSegmentation is required\nSegmentation is not required\nyes\nno\nDiagram 2:  Segmentation decision\nNote:\nThe decision whether segmentation is possible or not depends also on\nthe connection mode (1:1 or 1:n).\n[SWS_FrTp_01123]\n⌈The FrTp module shall call the service primitive\nPduR_FrTpCopyTxData() to copy the currently available FrTp N-\nSDU data with a length of FrTpTxPdu length to the corresponding\ntransmit buffer.⌋()\n[SWS_FrTp_01049]\n⌈The FrTp module shall prepare the Address Information\nand PCI according to the result of [SWS_FrTp_01048 as defined in\nspecification ISO 10681-2 [16].⌋()\n[SWS_FrTp_01050]\n⌈The FrTp module shall initiate an N-PDU data transfer by\ncalling the service primitive FrIf_Transmit() with the TxPduId of the\nrecently allocated FrTpTxPdu.⌋()\n[SWS_FrTp_01051]\n⌈The FrTp shall set the corresponding data length\nreferenced by the service primitive FrIf_Transmit’s parameter\nPduInfoType to the exact data length of the buffer15.⌋()"
    },

Fill up N-SDUs to a configured frame size is done within lower layers (e.g.\nFrIf or FlexRay Driver). The FrTp only decides whether segmentation is necessary or not and to\nStep 11 - 12\nIf the N-PDU was successfully transmitted by the FrIf module, the FrIf module shall\ncall the service primitive FrTp_TxConfirmation with result E_OK. Hence the sender has to\nwait until the response N-PDU (Flow Control) is received and continue processing\nafter reception.\n[SWS_FrTp_01055]\n⌈The FrTp module shall implement a timing and timeout\nbehaviour as defined in chapter 7.5.8⌋()\nStep 17 - 21\nIf all N-SDU data are transmitted the FrTp module shall free all allocated resources\nand reset all flags which signals an ongoing data E_NOT_OK.\n⌋()\n[SWS_FrTp_01057]\n⌈\nThe\nFrTp\nmodule\nshall\nreset\nthe\nflag\nTX_SDU_AVAILABLE, if:\na) all N-SDU data are transmitted and\nb) FrTp_TxConfirmation was given with result E_OK and\nc) the final acknowledge is received in case acknowledge is configured.\nOr\nd) FrTp_TxConfirmation was given with result E_OK and\nc) the final acknowledge is received in case acknowledge is configured\nor\nd) if transmission was aborted or FrTp_TxConfirmation was given with\nresult E_NOT_OK.⌋()\n[SWS_FrTp_01058]\n⌈The data are transmitted and\nb) FrTp_TxConfirmation was given with result E_OK and\nc) the final acknowledge is received in case acknowledge is configured.\nOtherwise the result shall be E_NOT_OK.\n⌋()\n[SWS_FrTp_01198]\n⌈ If an FC frame is received with an invalid FS or with FS\nset to OVFLW or ABT, the FrTp module shall abort the transmission of\nthis message and notify the upper layer by calling the callback function\nPduR_FrTpTxConfirmation with the result E_NOT_OK.⌋()\n[SWS_FrTp_01199]\n⌈ If an FC frame is received with the FS set to ACK_RET,\nwhere the BP points to a position outside the buffer of the sender, then\nthe FrTp module shall abort the transmission of this message and notify\nthe\nupper\nlayer\nby\ncalling\nthe\ncallback\nfunction\nPduR_FrTpTxConfirmation with the result E_NOT_OK.⌋()"

      "verbatim_text": "22 Only the received StartFrame PDU shall be stored temporarry in a local buffer. This is necessray in\ncase of a gateway has temporarry no free resources to process that frame. The correct protocol and\ntiming behavour is ensured if FrTp sends a FlowControl PDU after a free channel was allocated."
    },

      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRTP_SECTION_5_2_PDU_Router",

      "relevance_score": 0.85,

      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "5.2 PDU Router\nThe FrTp module requests different services primitives provided by the PDU Router\nmodule. The requested services primitives of the PDU-Router module are listed\nbelow. For further details please refer to chapter 8.6 and specification [6]:\n PduR_FrTpStartOfReception\nBy this API service primitive, the FrTp indicates the start of reception of a\nFrTp-I-PDU.\n PduR_FrTpCopyRxData\nBy this API service primitive, the FrTp initiates the copy process of the\nreceived FrTp N-PDU payload data to a provided <Upper Layer> Rx buffer\n PduR_FrTpRxIndication\nBy this API service primitive, the FrTp indicates the completed (un)successful\nreception of an FrTp-I-PDU.\n PduR_FrTpCopyTxData\nBy this API service primitive, the FrTp initiates the copy process of the FrTp N-\nPDU payload data from the provided <Upper Layer> Tx buffer\n PduR_FrTpTxConfirmation\nBy this API service primitive, the FrTp module confirms the (un)successful\nsending of the complete Fr N-SDU to the corresponding sender module (e.g.\nCOM, DCM etc).\nThe following services primitives of the FrTp module are called by the PDU-Router:\n FrTp_Transmit\nBy this API service primitive, a upper layer initiates a I-PDU data transfer via\nPDU-Router\n FrTp_CancelTransmit\nBy this API service primitive, sending of an Fr N-SDU is cancelled on sender\nsite.\n FrTp_ChangeParameter\nBy this API service primitive, some communication parameters of the FrTp\nmodule could be changed.\n FrTp_CancelReceive\nBy this API service primitive, an ongoing reception could be canceled."
    },

      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "5.3 L-SDU Router\nThe following services primitives of the L-SDU Router (LSduR) module are called by\nthe FrTp:\nLSduR_FrTpTransmit By this API service primitive, the transfer of an Fr N-PDU is\ninitiated.\nThe following services primitives of the FrTp module are called by the L-SDU Router\nmodule:\nFrTp_RxIndication By this API service primitive, the L-SDU Router module in-\ndicates the reception of an FrTp frame (Fr N-PDU, not to be confused with a\nFlexRay frame) to the FrTp. The FrTp then processes this frame.\nFrTp_TxConfirmation By this API service primitive, the L-SDU Router module\nconfirms the sending of the frame containing the Fr N-PDU with result (E_OK\nif the transmission was successful, E_NOT_OK if the transmission failed) over the\nFlexRay network.\nFrTp_TriggerTransmit By this API service primitive, the L-SDU Router get access\nto the Fr N-PDU data1."
    },

      "verbatim_text": "6 Requirements Tracing\nThe following tables reference the requirements specified in [6] and [8] and links to the\nfulfillment of these.       "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRTP_SECTION_7_4_Initialization_and_shutdown",
      "source_element": null,

      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.4 Initialization and shutdown\n[SWS_FrTp_01028] FrTp module state definition ⌈The FrTp module shall have two\ninternal states, FRTP_OFF and FRTP_ON.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01029] FrTp state variable for initialization detection ⌈The FrTp mod-\nule shall implement a static status variable FrTpState to denote whether the FrTp mod-\nule is initialized or not6.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01106] FrTp state ⌈The FrTpState shall be checked to detect whether\nFrTp module is initialized or not.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01030] Default state is OFF after power-up ⌈The FrTp module shall be\nin the FRTP_OFF state after power up.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01032] Initialize state to ON after init has been called ⌈The FrTp mod-\nule shall change to the internal state FRTP_ON when the FrTp has been successfully\ninitialized by the service primitive FrTp_Init.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01033] Processing of FrTp operations only after initialization ⌈The\nFrTp module shall perform normal FrTp operation tasks (e.g. segmentation, reassem-\nbly etc.) only when the FrTp module is in the FRTP_ON state7.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01034] Initialization service handling\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05088\n⌈The service primitive FrTp_Init shall initialize all global variables of the module and\nsets all transport protocol connections in a sub-state of FRTP_ON, in which neither\ntransmissions nor receptions are in progress.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01035] Initialization service clears ongoing connections\nUpstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05088\n⌈If the FrTp module is in the global state FRTP_ON, a call of the service primitive\nFrTp_Init shall return the module to an uncritical idle state (idle state = FRTP_ON,\nbut neither transmission nor reception are in progress) and the module shall loose all\ncurrent connections.⌋\n6This variable is used for development error detection\n7This requires that FrTp_Init is called before the normal FrTp functionality is used by the COM-\nStack.\n[SWS_FrTp_01036] OFF state after successful execution of shutdown primitive\n⌈The FrTp module shall change to the internal state FRTP_OFF when the service\nprimitive FrTp_Shutdown has been executed successfully.⌋\nFigure 7.5: FrTp Initialization and shutdown state diagram"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "7.5.1.1 TX_SDU_AVAILABLE\nThe TX_SDU_AVAILABLE flag is set by the service primitive FrTp_Transmit to indi-\ncate the N-SDU transmit request.\n[SWS_FrTp_00415]\nA\nTX\nSDU\navailable\nflag\nper\nchannel\n⌈The\nTX_SDU_AVAILABLE flag shall exist for every channel.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_00416] TX SDU available flag use case ⌈The TX_SDU_AVAILABLE flag\nshall indicate an Fr N-SDU transmit request for a configured connection on an allocated\nchannel.⌋\nNote: For detailed information about set and reset conditions and behaviour please\nrefer to Section 7.5.2 and [SWS_FrTp_01057]."
    },
    {

      "verbatim_text": "7.5.1.3 RX_PDU_AVAILABLE\nThe RX_PDU_AVAILABLE flag is set by the service primitive FrTp_RxIndication\nto indicate the reception of an N-PDU.\n[SWS_FrTp_00418]\nA\nRX\nPDU\navailable\nflag\nper\nRX\nN-PDU\n⌈The\nRX_PDU_AVAILABLE flag shall exist for every Fr N-PDU, which is configured to\nbe received by the FrTp module.⌋\nNote: For detailed information about set and reset conditions and behaviour please\nrefer to Chapter 7.5.3 and [SWS_FrTp_01074]."

    {

      "relevance_score": 0.85,

      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.5.1.4 RX_ERROR\nThe RX_ERROR8 flag is required in case transmission with acknowledgement and\nretry is configured. During a segmented data reception an error could occur but send-\ning FlowControl is currently not possible. In that case the information about an error\nhas to be stored until sending a FlowControl is allowed.\n[SWS_FrTp_00428] A RX error flag per every FrTp channel ⌈The RX_ERROR flag\nshall exist for every FrTpChannel.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_00429] RX error flag use case ⌈The RX_ERROR flag shall indicate that\nan error occurred during a segmented reception.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_00430] RX error flag clearing ⌈The RX_ERROR flag shall be cleared\nafter the reaction (Retry, Negative Acknowledgement, abortion).⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "7.5.1 Flags\nThe FrTp module uses several flags to signal internal states (see also sequence dia-\ngrams in Chapter 9). This chapter describes the flags required for inter-module state\nhandling."

      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRTP_SECTION_7_5_2_1_Transmit_Data_via_Immediate_Buffer_Access_Mode",

      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayISOTransportLayer",

      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.5.2.1 Transmit Data via ’Immediate Buffer Access’ Mode\nThis chapter defines a data transfer requested by an upper layer (e.g. COM, DCM etc.)\nvia ’Immediate Buffer Access’ Mode.\nPduR\nFrTp\nLSduR\nFrIf\n01. FrTp_Transmit (TxSDU-ID, …)\n02. Evaluate TxSDU-ID\n03. Allocate fee channel and set connection\n04. Set Flag TX_SDU_AVAILABLE (TxSDU-ID)\n05. FrTp_Main\n06. Call routine PduR_FrTpCopyTxData (TxSDU-ID, ..)\n07. Allocate fee TxPDU-ID\n08. Call routine PduR_FrTpCopyTxData (TxSDU-ID, ..)\n09. Prepare Address Information and PCI\n10. Call routine LSduR_FrTpTransmit (TxPDU-ID)\n12. LSduR_FrIfTxConfirmation\n11. Call routine FrIf_Transmit (TxPDU-ID)\n13. Call routine FrTp_TxConfirmation and set TxPduState = „Idle“\n14. FrTp_Main\nIF:\n15. FlowControl reception is expected\nTHEN:\n16. Wait until FlowControl is received\nELSE:\n17. Continue at Step 18\nIF:\n18. All SDU data transmitted\nTHEN:\n19. Free Channel\n20. Reset Flag TX_SDU_AVAILABLE\n21. Call Pdu_TxConfirmation (TxSDU-ID, ..)\nELSE:\n22. Continue at Step 8\nt\nt\nt\nt\nFigure 7.6: in ’Immediate Buffer Access’ mode\nFigure 7.6 depicts the internal processing for data transmission in principle9 if \"Imme-\ndiate Buffer Access\" mode is configured10. Below there is a description of the different\nsteps which are necessary to transmit data via FrTp.\nStep 1 - 4\n[SWS_FrTp_00136]FrTp transmit initiation by upper layer ⌈Sending Fr N-SDU data\nshall always be initiated by the service primitive call of FrTp_Transmit.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01043] Detection for transmission with unknown or known message\nlength ⌈The FrTp module shall evaluate the value of PduInfoType.SduLength:\n9Figure 7.6 depicts only the overview of data transmission for a single channel without further func-\ntionality (e.g. transmit cancellation) or internal behaviour (e.g. internal control data handling, return\nvalues, etc.). Also a schedule for data transfer in concurrent channels is not described here.\n10Buffer access mode is configured for each N-PDU and is referenced via the PDU-Pool.\n• SduLength = 0: Transmission with unknown message length is requested\n• SduLength̸ = 0: Transmission with known message length is requested.\n⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01044] Handling of TX SDU unknown message length flag ⌈If sup-\nport unknown message length is configured the FrTp module shall set the flag\nTX_SDU_UNKNOWN_MSG_LENGTH according to the result of [SWS_FrTp_01043].⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01134] Handling of development error for unknown message length\n⌈The FRTP module shall raise an development error FRTP_E_UMSG_LENGTH_ERROR\nwhen\n1. a transmission with unknown message length is detected and\n2. support of unknown message legth is not configured and\n3. development error detection is enabled for the FrTp module.\n⌋\nThe service primitive parameter TxPduId shall be used to select the correct connection.\nThis shall be done by searching for the correct entry within the FrTpConnection\ncontainer (FrTpConnection.FrTpTxSduId). If a valid parameter TxPduId is given,\nthe FrTp module shall search for a free channel resource (FrTpTxChannelState = Idle)\nand allocate them to control the requested Tx data transfer.\n[SWS_FrTp_01038] TX SDU available flag ⌈An ongoing data transfer shall be sig-\nnalled by the flag TX_SDU_AVAILABLE.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01039] Handling of TX SDU available flag ⌈The service primitive shall\nset the flag TX_SDU_AVAILABLE only, if\n• the requested TxPduId is valid\n• a free channel resource is available (FrTpTxChannelState = Idle)\n⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01040] Reject transmission request when TX PDU ID is not valid ⌈If\nthe current parameter TxPduId is not supported the service primitive FrTp_Transmit\n• shall be terminated and the return value shall be set to E_NOT_OK and\n• the FrTp module shall raise an development error FRTP_E_INVALID_PDU_-\nSDU_ID when development error detection for the FrTp module is enabled.\n⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01041] Reject transmission request when no free channel is avail-\nable ⌈If no free channel is available (FrTpTxChannelState != Idle) the service primi-\ntive FrTp_Transmit shall be terminated and the return value shall be set to E_NOT_\nOK11.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01185] Runtime error FRTP_E_NO_CHANNEL ⌈The FrTp module shall\nraise a runtime error FRTP_E_NO_CHANNEL.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01200] Reject transmission request when another transmission for\nthe specified address information is active ⌈If the request for a message trans-\nmission has not been accepted due to another transmission for the specified address\ninformation is active; then FrTp_Transmit shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋\nStep 5 - 10\nIf the TX_SDU_AVAILABLE flag is set, the FrTp module has to evaluate the\nlength of the currently available FrTp N-SDU data by calling the service primitive\nPduR_FrTpCopyTxData()12 a first time. With knowledge of the available data size FrTp\nmodule scans the FrTpTxPduPool and allocates the first free FrTpPdu for that data\ntransfer. Depending on the available FrTp-N-SDU length and the FrTpTxPduPool’s\nfree FrTpPdu length the FrTp module decides whether segmentation is necessary or\nnot for that N-SDU transfer. By calling the service primitive PduR_FrTpCopyTxData\nthe data shall be copied to the corresponding buffer. In a next step the corresponding\nAddress Information and PCI are prepared and the service primitive LSduR_FrTp-\nTransmit is called with the corresponding TxPduId.\n[SWS_FrTp_01042] Start copy TX data when SDU available flag is set ⌈If the\nTX_SDU_AVAILABLE flag is set, the FrTp module shall call the service primitive\nPduR_FrTpCopyTxData to get the currently available FrTp N-SDU Length informa-\ntion.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01045] Allocate first free TX PDU in a pool ⌈The FrTp module shall\nalways allocate the first free FrTpTxPdu while scanning the corresponding FrTpTx-\nPduPool.⌋\n11This scenario could occur on gateways, if communication via more connections is requested than\nchannels resources are configured.\n12The available data length evaluation depends on different scenarios the FrTp is used in.\n– In case of a normal ECU which transfers data with unknown message lengths it is necessary to\nevalueate the length of the currently stored FrTp-N-SDU.\n– In case an ECU transmits data with known message length the Tx data length is given by the parameter\nof the FrTp_Transmit service primitive. An additional evaluation by calling PduR_FrTpCopyTxData(..)\nis possible to have equal evaluation sequences for known and unknown message length transfers but\ncould be skipped by runtime optimizations (implementation dependency).\n– In case of a Gateway which routes N-SDUs of different bus systems it is necessary to get the currently\navailable (received) data length in the gateway buffer.\n[SWS_FrTp_01046] Usage of free TX PDU to continue transmission ⌈If a free\nFrTpTxPdu is identified, the FrTp module shall use this FrTpTxPdu to continue cur-\nrent transmission process.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01047] Postpone processing of transmission in case no free TX PDU\nis available ⌈If no free FrTpTxPdu is identified, the FrTp module shall postpone pro-\ncessing for the corresponding connection till the next main function call.⌋\nNote: FrTp module shall postpone the processing for the corresponding connection\nuntil either free FrTpTxPdu is identified according to [SWS_FrTp_01046] or a timeout\noccurs (see Chapter 7.5.8).\n[SWS_FrTp_01048] Segmentation decision for N-SDU transfer ⌈The FrTp module\nshall decide whether segmentation for the requested N-SDU transfer is required or\nnot depending on the length information of the first allocated FrTpTxPdu from an\nFrTpTxPduPool for the currently processed FrTpConnection.⌋\nNote: Decision of segmentation as specified in [SWS_FrTp_01048] is shown in Figure\n7.7.\nFigure 7.7: Segmentation decision\nNote: The decision whether segmentation is possible or not depends also on the con-\nnection mode (1:1 or 1:n).\n[SWS_FrTp_01123] Call copy TX data with according length ⌈The FrTp module\nshall call the service primitive PduR_FrTpCopyTxData to copy the currently available\nFrTp N-SDU data with a length of FrTpTxPdu length to the corresponding transmit\nbuffer.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01049] Address Information and PCI preparation ⌈The FrTp mod-\nule shall prepare the Address Information and PCI according to the result of\n[SWS_FrTp_01048] as defined in specification [1].⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "7.5.2.2 Transmit Data via ’Decoupled Buffer Access’ Mode\nFigure 7.8 depicts the internal processing for data transmission in principle14 if \"Decou-\npled Buffer Access\" mode is configured15. Below there is a description of the different\nsteps which are necessary to transmit data via FrTp.\n14Figure 7.8 depicts only the overview of data transmission for a single channel without further func-\ntionality (e.g. transmit cancellation) or internal behaviour (e.g. internal control data handling, return\nvalues etc.). Also a schedule for data transfer in concurrent channels is not described here.\n15Buffer access mode is configured for each N-PDU (refer to FrIf) and is referenced via the PDU-Pool.\nPduR\nFrTp\nLSduR\nFrIf\n01. FrTp_Transmit (TxSDU-ID, …)\n02. Evaluate TxSDU-ID\n03. Allocate fee channel and set connection\n04. Set Flag TX_SDU_AVAILABLE (TxSDU-ID)\n05. FrTp_Main\n06. Call routine PduR_FrTpCopyTxData (TxSDU-ID, ..)\n07. Allocate fee TxPDU-ID\n08. Call routine PduR_FrTpCopyTxData (TxSDU-ID, ..)\n09. Prepare Address Information and PCI\n10. Call routine LSduR_FrTpTransmit (TxPDU-ID)\n14. LSduR_FrTpTxConfirmation\n11. Call routine FrIf_Transmit (TxPDU-ID)\n15. Call routine FrTp_TxConfirmation and set TxPduState = „Idle“\n16. FrTp_Main\nIF:\n17. FlowControl reception is expected\nTHEN:\n18. Wait until FlowControl is received\nELSE:\n19. Continue at Step 20\nIF:\n20. All SDU data transmitted\nTHEN:\n21. Free Channel\n22. Reset Flag TX_SDU_AVAILABLE\n23. Call Pdu_TxConfirmation (TxSDU-ID, ..)\nELSE:\n24. Continue at Step 8\nt\nt\nt\nt\n12. LSduR_FrTpTriggerTransmit\n13. Call routine FrTp_TriggerTransmit and copy N-PDU to provided buffer\nFigure 7.8: Transmit data overview in ’Decoupled Buffer Access’ mode\nStep 01 - 10\nStep 01 - 10 in ’decoupled access mode’ are equal to step 01 - 10 in ’immediate access\nmode’. Please refer to Chapter 7.5.2.1.\nFor step 09 it is recommended to set the address information and PCI to a local buffer\nbecause the service primitive FrTp_TriggerTransmit is called in interrupt mode\nand therefore the processing time to copy the complete N-PDU (Address Information,\nPCI and (part of) SDU data) shall be as short as possible.\nStep 11 - 12\n[SWS_FrTp_01059] Trigger transmit call by lower layer ⌈The service primitive\nFrTp_TriggerTransmit shall be called by LSduR, which was originated by the FrIf\nmodule via a call of LSduR_FrIfTriggerTransmit to propagate FrTp N-PDUs to\nthe lower layers e.g. FlexRay Driver).⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01060] Handling of trigger transmit ⌈The service primitive FrTp_-\nTriggerTransmit shall copy the Address Information, PCI and N-SDU data to the\ncorresponding buffer, which is referenced by the service primitive parameter PduIn-\nfoType.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01061] Data length handling for trigger transmit ⌈The service primitive\nFrTp_TriggerTransmit shall set the corresponding data length referenced by the\nservice primitive parameter PduInfoType to the exact data length of the buffer.⌋\nStep 13 - 23\nSteps 13 - 23 in ’decoupled access mode’ are equal to step 10 - 20 in ’immediate\naccess mode’. Please refer to Chapter 7.5.2.1."

      "verbatim_text": "7.5.2.3.1 Segmentation condition for data transfer\n[SWS_FrTp_01068]\nSegmentation\ncondition\nfor\ndata\ntransfer\nwith\nmultiple\nreceivers\n⌈If\nthe\nFrTpConnectionControl\nparameter\nFRTP_MULTIPLE_RECEIVER_CON for the corresponding FrTpConnection is\nset, the communication handler shall not process a segmentation of an N-SDU and\ntake the following actions:\n• shall raise a runtime error FRTP_E_SEG_ERROR and\n• shall abort the transmission of this message and notify the upper layer by calling\nthe callback function PduR_FrTpTxConfirmation with the result E_NOT_OK.\n⌋"

      "verbatim_text": "7.5.2.3 Data Transfer with unknown message length\nISO10681-2 supports the possibility to transmit data with an unknown message length.\n[SWS_FrTp_01062] Configurable transmission with unknown message length\n⌈The functionality to support data transmission with unknown message length shall be\nconfigurable by compiler switch.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01063]\nReject transmissions with unknown length if connection\nis configured for multiple receivers ⌈If a 1:n connection is configured (parameter\nFRTP_MULTIPLE_RECEIVER_CON is set), a Data transfer with unknown message\nlength shall not be processed16 and the service primitive call FrTp_Transmit shall\nbe rejected with the return value E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01187]\nRuntime error FRTP_E_SEG_ERROR handling ⌈The FrTp\nmodule shall raise a runtime error FRTP_E_SEG_ERROR when a 1:n connection is re-\nquested as described in [SWS_FrTp_01063].⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01064] Start of transmission with unknown length ⌈An upper layer’s\ndata transmission with unknown message length shall be initiated by an calling the\nservice primitive FrTp_Transmit with the service primitive parameter PduLength = 0\n(’zero’).⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01065] Length parameter handling for transmissions with unknown\nlength ⌈During an ongoing data transfer with unknown message length the service\nprimitive parameter Length of the service primitive PduR_FrTpCopyTxData shall be\nset to the value of the currently stored Tx-Buffer’s data bytes.⌋\n16Unknown message length data transfer requires segmentation because at least a StartFrame and\na LastFrame have to be transmitted.\n[SWS_FrTp_01066] Finish condition of a transmission with unknown length ⌈An\nongoing upper layer’s data transmission with unknown message length shall be fin-\nished, if the parameter length within the service primitive is set to 0 (’zero’).⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01067] PDU length handling ⌈The FrTp module shall add all PduInfo-\nType.PduLength values to calculate the total message length which is transmitted by\nthe LastFrame (LF).⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "7.5.3.1 Receive with unknown message length\nThe FrTp according to [1] provides a method to receive data with unknown message\nlength.\n[SWS_FrTp_01184] Handling of data reception with unknown message length ⌈If\na data reception with unknown message length shall be established, the FrTp shall call\nthe API PduR_FrTpStartOfReception () with an expected data length of zero (\"0\").⌋\nNote: If the API PduR_FrTpStartOfReception () is called with a data length of zero (\"0\")\nthe upper modul shall provide the maximum buffer size that is currently available.\nECU scenario:\nUpper layer, e.g. DCM, shall provide the currently available maximum buffer size.\nGateway szenario:\nPduR module shall provide the currently available maximum buffer size."
    },

      "verbatim_text": "7.5.3 Receive Data\nThis chapter defines a data reception on FrTp module requested by the lower layer\nFlexRay Interface (FrIf).\n[SWS_FrTp_01206] ⌈During reception, the FrTp shall forward addressing\ninformation received as local address and remote address in the N-PDU to the upper\nlayer\nvia\nthe\nmeta\ndata\nitems\nSOURCE_ADDRESS_16\nand\nTARGET_ADDRESS_16, and shall use the same address information when\ntransmitting flow control N-PDUs.⌋()\n[SWS_FrTp_01207]  ⌈If FrTpLa and/or FrTpRa are not configured for a received N-\nSDU, any received addressing information can be assigned to this N-SDU. N-SDUs\nwith configured FrTpLa and/or FrTpRa shall be preferred during reception over those\nwithout these configuration parameters.⌋()\nNote: The service routine PduR_FrTpStartOfReception() shall be called in either\nFrTp_MainFunction() or FrTp_RxIndication().\nFigure 16 depicts the internal processing for data reception in principle19. Below there\nis a description of the different steps which are necessary to receive data via FrTp."

      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.5.6.1 Transmit Cancellation for unsegmented data transfer\nA Transmit Cancellation request for an unsegmented data transfer could occur on two\ndifferent positions within FrTp module’s processing:\nBefore sending the StartFrame (STF) The Transmit Cancellation Request is effec-\ntive.\nAfter sending the StartFrame (STF) The Transmit Cancellation Request is not effec-\ntive because of the StartFrame was sent.\nFigure 7.13 depicts the transmit cancellation behaviour of an unsegmented data trans-\nfer.\nFigure 7.13: Transmit Cancellation at unsegmented data transfer\nIf a requested but currently not started data transfer shall be cancelled the service\nprimitive FrTp_CancelTransmit is called. FrTp_CancelTransmit shall cancel\nthe requested data transfer. On receiver side no data transfer is recognized."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRTP_SECTION_7_5_6_2_Transmit_Cancellation_for_segmented_data_transfer",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayISOTransportLayer",
      "source_page": 59,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.5.6.2 Transmit Cancellation for segmented data transfer\nA Transmit Cancellation request for a segmented data transfer could occur on three\ndifferent positions within FrTp module’s processing:\nBefore sending the StartFrame (STF) The Transmit Cancellation Request is effec-\ntive.\nWithin an ongoing data transfer The Transmit Cancellation Request is effective.\nAfter sending the LastFrame (LF) The Transmit Cancellation Request is not effec-\ntive because of because after having transmitted the LastFrame (LF) the trans-\nmission is finished\nFigure 7.14 depicts the transmit cancellation behaviour of a segmented data transfer.\nIf a requested but currently not started data transfer shall be cancelled the service\nprimitive FrTp_CancelTransmit is called. On receiver side no data transfer is rec-\nognized.\nFigure 7.14: Transmit Cancellation at segmented data transfer\nIf an ongoing data transfer shall be cancelled, the service primitive FrTp_Cancel-\nTransmit is called. FrTp_CancelTransmit shall cancel the current data transfer\nprocess. On receiver side an initial data reception is recognized and processed (e.g.\ncall of service primitive PduR_FrTpStartOfReception, send FlowControl N-PDU etc.).\nIf the sender cancels data transfer a timeout occurs on receiver side.\nIf no retry is configured, this timeout is used to cancel the current reception by calling\nthe service primitive PduR_FrTpRxIndication with the corresponding notification result\nerror code.\nIf retry is configured, the receiver sends an additional FlowControl26. After a configured\namount of retries the final timeout is used to cancel the current reception by calling\nthe service primitive PduR_FrTpRxIndication with the corresponding notification result\nerror code."
    },

      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRTP_SECTION_7_5_6_Transmit_Cancellation",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayISOTransportLayer",
      "source_page": 58,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.5.6 Transmit Cancellation\nAccording to [1] the FrTp module supports \"Transmit Cancellation\" for an ongoing FrTp\nN-SDU transfer. This functionality could disable by a global compiler switch.\n[SWS_FrTp_01097]\nCancel transmit support depends on configuration pa-\nrameter FrTpTransmitCancellation ⌈The \"Transmit Cancellation\" feature shall be\n(de)activated by static configuration of the FrTp parameter FrTpTransmitCancel-\nlation.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_00384]\nCancel transmit request ⌈A Transmit Cancellation request\nshall be done by the call of the service primitive FrTp_CancelTransmit (see\n[SWS_FrTp_00150]).⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01116]\nCancel Transmit handling when transmission is ongoing\n⌈When a transmission is still in progress, FrTp_CancelTransmit shall stop the\ntransmission and shall return E_OK. When a connection is not active, or when the\nlast N-PDU of a transmission without acknowledgement has already been forwarded\nto the FrIf, FrTp_CancelTransmit shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_00385] Cancel Transmit handling when transmission has not been\nstarted ⌈If the transmit request is pending but the transmission has not started,\nFrTp_CancelTransmit (see [SWS_FrTp_00150]) shall immediately free the con-\nnection.⌋"
    },

The upper byte of the parameter\nis not used.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01115] Decline change parameter requests for ongoing receptions\n⌈A change parameter request during an ongoing reception shall be terminated with\nreturn value of E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01156] Usage of new parameter usage after successful change re-\nquest ⌈The FrTp module shall use the new BandwidthControl parameters for the cor-\nresponding connection if the change was successfully executed.⌋\nNote: Bandwidth Control is part of the runtime parameter set. For details please refer\nto chapter Chapter 7.3.3.3."

    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRTP_SECTION_7_5_Data_Transfer_Processing",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayISOTransportLayer",
      "source_page": 36,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "7.5 Data Transfer Processing\nThis chapter covers all topics of FrTp module data transfer processing if transmission\nof data (Fr N-SDU) is requested by an upper layer (e.g. COM, DCM etc.) via PduR\nmodule or if data (Fr N-PDUs) have been received via FrIf module indicated by LSduR.\nFor a better understanding the different topics are encapsulated in several sub-clauses\nstarting with the basic definition of data transfer and reception.\nBuffer handling is\ndescribed within an additional chapter.\nThe FlexRay protocol stack supports two different buffer access modes for data trans-\nmission:\n• Immediate Buffer Access Mode\n• Decoupled Buffer Access Mode\nDue to this fact there are two different sequences for data transfer processing."
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.3.3.2 FrTp_CancelTransmit\n[SWS_FrTp_00150] Definition of API function FrTp_CancelTransmit ⌈\nService Name\nFrTp_CancelTransmit\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrTp_CancelTransmit (\nPduIdType TxPduId\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x4a\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.\nParameters (in)\nTxPduId\nIdentification of the PDU to be cancelled.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: Cancellation was executed successfully by the destination\nmodule.\nE_NOT_OK: Cancellation was rejected by the destination module.\nDescription\nRequests cancellation of an ongoing transmission of a PDU in a lower layer communication\nmodule.\nAvailable via\nFrTp.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01141] Raise development error when cancel transmit is called with\ninvalid PDU ID ⌈If development error detection for the FrTp_CancelTransmit is\nenabled: the function FrTp_CancelTransmit shall check the parameter TxPduId for\nbeing valid. If the check for TxPduId fails, the function FrTp_CancelTransmit shall\nraise the development error FRTP_E_INVALID_PDU_SDU_ID and return E_NOT_OK.⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.3.3.3 FrTp_ChangeParameter\n[SWS_FrTp_00151] Definition of API function FrTp_ChangeParameter ⌈\nService Name\nFrTp_ChangeParameter\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrTp_ChangeParameter (\nPduIdType id,\nTPParameterType parameter,\nuint16 value\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x4b\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant\nid\nIdentification of the PDU which the parameter change shall affect.\nparameter\nID of the parameter that shall be changed.\nParameters (in)\nvalue\nThe new value of the parameter.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: The parameter was changed successfully.\nE_NOT_OK: The parameter change was rejected.\nDescription\nRequest to change a specific transport protocol parameter (e.g. block size).\nAvailable via\nFrTp.h\n⌋\nNote: The service FrTp_ChangeParameter is used to change the transport protocol\nparameter Bandwidth Control (BC).\n[SWS_FrTp_01143] Raise development error when change parameter is called\nwith invalid parameter ID ⌈If development error detection for the FrTp_ChangePa-\nrameter is enabled: the function FrTp_ChangeParameter shall check the param-\neter Id for being valid. If the check for Id fails, the function FrTp_ChangeParame-\nter shall raise the development error FRTP_E_INVALID_PDU_SDU_ID and return\nE_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01144] Raise development error when change parameter is called\nwith invalid parameter ⌈If development error detection for the FrTp_ChangeParam-\neter is enabled: the function FrTp_ChangeParameter shall check the parameter\nfor being valid. If the check for parameter fails, the function FrTp_ChangeParame-\nter shall raise the development error FRTP_E_INVALID_PARAMETER and return E_\nNOT_OK.⌋"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_CLASSIC_FRTP_SECTION_8_3_3_4_FrTp_CancelReceive",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayISOTransportLayer",
      "source_page": 78,
      "category": null,
      "relevance_score": 0.85,
      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "8.3.3.4 FrTp_CancelReceive\n[SWS_FrTp_01172] Definition of API function FrTp_CancelReceive ⌈\nService Name\nFrTp_CancelReceive\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrTp_CancelReceive (\nPduIdType RxPduId\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x4c\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant\nParameters (in)\nRxPduId\nIdentification of the PDU to be cancelled.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: Cancellation was executed successfully by the destination\nmodule.\nE_NOT_OK: Cancellation was rejected by the destination module.\nDescription\nRequests cancellation of an ongoing reception of a PDU in a lower layer transport protocol\nmodule.\nAvailable via\nFrTp.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01180] Raise development error when cancel receive is called with\ninvalid RX PDU ID ⌈If development error detection is enabled:\nThe function FrTp_CancelReceive shall check the parameter RxPduId for being\nvalid. If the check for RxPduId fails, the function shall raise the development error\nFRTP_E_INVALID_PDU_SDU_ID and return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01181] Abort reception when cancel receive provides a valid RX\nPDU ID ⌈The FrTp shall abort the reception of the current N-PDU if the service FrTp_\nCancelReceive provides a valid RxPduId.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01182] Reject cancel receive for unsgemented reception or when\nprocessing last frame ⌈The FrTp shall reject the request for receive cancellation in\ncase of an\n• unsegmented reception or\n• in case the FrTp is in the process of receiving the LastFrame of the N-SDU\nand shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01183] Return handling for cancel receive after success ⌈If the\nFrTp_CancelReceive service has been successfully Executed, FrTp_CancelRe-\nceive shall return with result E_OK.⌋"
    },

      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "8.4.1 FrTp_TriggerTransmit\n[SWS_FrTp_00154] Definition of callback function FrTp_TriggerTransmit ⌈\nService Name\nFrTp_TriggerTransmit\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrTp_TriggerTransmit (\nPduIdType TxPduId,\nPduInfoType* PduInfoPtr\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x41\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.\nParameters (in)\nTxPduId\nID of the SDU that is requested to be transmitted.\nParameters (inout)\nPduInfoPtr\nContains a pointer to a buffer (SduDataPtr) to where the SDU\ndata shall be copied, and the available buffer size in SduLengh.\nOn return, the service will indicate the length of the copied SDU\ndata in SduLength.\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: SDU has been copied and SduLength indicates the\nnumber of copied bytes.\nE_NOT_OK: No SDU data has been copied. PduInfoPtr must not\nbe used since it may contain a NULL pointer or point to invalid\ndata.\nDescription\nWithin this API, the upper layer module (called module) shall check whether the available data\nfits into the buffer size reported by PduInfoPtr->SduLength. If it fits, it shall copy its data into the\nbuffer provided by PduInfoPtr->SduDataPtr and update the length of the actual copied data in\nPduInfoPtr->SduLength. If not, it returns E_NOT_OK without changing PduInfoPtr.\nAvailable via\nFrTp.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01145] Raise development error when trigger transmit is called with\ninvalid PDU ID ⌈If development error detection for the FrTp_TriggerTransmit is\nenabled: the function FrTp_TriggerTransmit shall check the parameter TxPduId\nfor being valid. If the check for TxPduId fails, the function FrTp_TriggerTransmit\nshall raise the development error FRTP_E_INVALID_PDU_SDU_ID and return E_-\nNOT_OK.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01146] Raise development error when trigger transmit is called with\ninvalid PDU info pointer ⌈If development error detection for the FrTp_Trigger-\nTransmit is enabled: the function FrTp_TriggerTransmit shall check the param-\neter PduInfoPtr for being valid. If the check for PduInfoPtr fails, the function FrTp_\nTriggerTransmit shall raise the development error FRTP_E_PARAM_POINTER and\nreturn E_NOT_OK.⌋"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.5.1 FrTp_MainFunction\n[SWS_FrTp_00203] Main Function schedule ⌈The FrTp_MainFunction shall be\nused to schedule the FrTp module.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_00580] Main function processing ⌈The FrTp_MainFunction shall be\nthe entry point for FrTp processing tasks.⌋\n[SWS_FrTp_01152] Main function call at least required once per FR cycle ⌈The\nFrTp_MainFunction shall be called at least one time per FlexRay cycle1.⌋\nThe FrTp_MainFunction shall follow the service primitive definition as described\nbelow:\n[SWS_FrTp_00162] Definition of scheduled function FrTp_MainFunction ⌈\nService Name\nFrTp_MainFunction\nSyntax\nvoid FrTp_MainFunction (\nvoid\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x10\nDescription\nSchedules the FlexRay TP. (Entry point for scheduling)\nAvailable via\nSchM_FrTp.h\n⌋"

      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "SWS_FlexRayInterface",
      "source_page": 96,

      "disposition": "UNVERIFIED",
      "evidence_status": "unverified_hypothesis",
      "guideline": "⚠️ Zwingend als UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS kennzeichnen mit Warnbox und Inline-Curation-Link",
      "verbatim_text": "8.8.1 Mandatory Interfaces\nThis chapter defines all API services which are required from other BSW modules to\nfulfill the core functionality of the FlexRay Interface.\n[SWS_FrIf_05043] Definition of mandatory interfaces in module FrIf ⌈\nAPI Function\nHeader File\nDescription\nDet_ReportRuntimeError\nDet.h\nService to report runtime errors. If a callout has\nbeen configured then this callout shall be called.\nFr_AbortCommunication\nFr.h\nInvokes the CC CHI command ’FREEZE’.\nFr_AckAbsoluteTimerIRQ\nFr.h\nResets the interrupt condition of an absolute timer.\nFr_AllowColdstart\nFr.h\nInvokes the CC CHI command ’ALLOW_\nCOLDSTART’.\nFr_CancelAbsoluteTimer\nFr.h\nStops an absolute timer.\nFr_CheckTxLPduStatus\nFr.h\nChecks the transmit status of the LSdu.\nFr_ControllerInit\nFr.h\nInitialzes a FlexRay CC.\nFr_DisableAbsoluteTimerIRQ\nFr.h\nDisables the interrupt line of an absolute timer.\nFr_EnableAbsoluteTimerIRQ\nFr.h\nEnables the interrupt line of an absolute timer.\nFr_GetAbsoluteTimerIRQStatus\nFr.h\nGets IRQ status of an absolute timer.\nFr_GetGlobalTime\nFr.h\nGets the current global FlexRay time.\nImportant Note: Fr_GetGlobalTime may be called\nwithin an exclusive area.\nFr_GetPOCStatus\nFr.h\nGets the POC status.\nFr_HaltCommunication\nFr.h\nInvokes the CC CHI command ’DEFERRED_HALT’.\nFr_ReceiveRxLPdu\nFr.h\nReceives data from the FlexRay network.\nFr_SendWUP\nFr.h\nInvokes the CC CHI command ’WAKEUP’.\nFr_SetAbsoluteTimer\nFr.h\nSets the absolute FlexRay timer.\nFr_SetWakeupChannel\nFr.h\nSets a wakeup channel.\nFr_StartCommunication\nFr.h\nStarts communication.\nFr_TransmitTxLPdu\nFr.h\nTransmits data on the FlexRay network.\nFrTrcv_CheckWakeupByTransceiver\nFrTrcv.h\n–\nFrTrcv_ClearTransceiverWakeup\nFrTrcv.h\nThis function clears a pending wake up event.\nFrTrcv_GetTransceiverMode\nFrTrcv.h\nThis function returns the actual state of the\ntransceiver.\nFrTrcv_GetTransceiverWUReason\nFrTrcv.h\nThis function returns the wakeup reason.\nFrTrcv_SetTransceiverMode\nFrTrcv.h\nThis service sets the transceiver mode.\n⌋()"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.8.3 Configurable Interfaces\nThis chapter lists all interfaces where the target API service of any upper layer, which\nrequire one or more of these mentioned interfaces to be called has to be set up by\nstatic configuration of the FlexRay Interface. The target function is usually a call-back\nfunction. The names of these kinds of interfaces are not fixed because they are con-\nfigurable.\nThese call-back services are specified and implemented in the upper layer\nBSW\nmodules,\nwhich\nuse\nthe\nFlexRay\nInterface\naccording\nto\n[5,\nAU-\nTOSAR_EXP_LayeredSoftwareArchitecture].\nThe specific call-back notification is\nspecified in the corresponding AUTOSAR SWS document (see chapter 3).\nIn addition to upper layer AUTOSAR BSW modules, the FrIf can, with the functional-\nity described within this specification, also support other non-AUTOSAR upper layer\nsoftware modules (CDs), provided that these modules interact with the FrIf in the\nsame manner as the upper layer AUTOSAR BSW modules. In particular, those non-\nAUTOSAR modules need to provide APIs as described in this chapter.\n[SWS_FrIf_05729] ⌈Configuration of <UL_RxIndication>: If the parameter FrIfUserRx\nIndicationUL is set to FR_AR_TP, <UL_RxIndication> must be FrArTp_RxIndication.⌋\n()\n[SWS_FrIf_05730] ⌈Configuration of <UL_RxIndication>: If the parameter FrIfUserRx\nIndicationUL is set to FR_NM, <UL_RxIndication> must be FrNm_RxIndication.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05731] ⌈Configuration of <UL_RxIndication>: If the parameter FrIfUserRx\nIndicationUL is set to FR_TP, <UL_RxIndication> must be FrTp_RxIndication.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05732] ⌈Configuration of <UL_RxIndication>: If the parameter FrIfUserRx\nIndicationUL is set to PDUR, <UL_RxIndication> must be PduR_FrIfRxIndication.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05733] ⌈Configuration of <UL_RxIndication>: If the parameter FrIfUserRx\nIndicationUL is set to XCP , <UL_RxIndication> must be Xcp_FrIfRxIndication.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05434] ⌈Configuration of <UL_RxIndication>: If the parameter FrIfUserRx\nIndicationUL is set to FR_TSYN, <UL_RxIndication> must be FrTSyn_RxIndication.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05734] ⌈Configuration of <UL_TxConfirmation>: If the parameter FrIfUser\nTxUL is set to FR_AR_TP, <UL_TxConfirmation> must be FrArTp_TxConfirmation.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05735] ⌈Configuration of <UL_TxConfirmation>: If the parameter FrIfUser\nTxUL is set to FR_NM, <UL_TxConfirmation> must be FrNm_TxConfirmation.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05736] ⌈Configuration of <UL_TxConfirmation>: If the parameter FrIfUser\nTxUL is set to FR_TP, <UL_TxConfirmation> must be FrTp_TxConfirmation.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05737] ⌈Configuration of <UL_TxConfirmation>: If the parameter FrIfUser\nTxUL is set to PDUR, <UL_TxConfirmation> must be PduR_FrIfTxConfirmation.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05738] ⌈Configuration of <UL_TxConfirmation>: If the parameter FrIfUser\nTxUL is set to XCP , <UL_TxConfirmation> must be Xcp_FrIfTxConfirmation.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05739] ⌈Configuration of <UL_TriggerTransmit>: If the parameter FrIfUser\nTxUL is set to FR_AR_TP, <UL_TriggerTransmit> must be FrArTp_TriggerTransmit.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05740] ⌈Configuration of <UL_TriggerTransmit>: If the parameter FrIfUser\nTxUL is set to FR_NM, <UL_TriggerTransmit> must be FrNm_TriggerTransmit.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05741] ⌈Configuration of <UL_TriggerTransmit>: If the parameter FrIfUser\nTxUL is set to FR_TP, <UL_TriggerTransmit> must be FrTp_TriggerTransmit.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05742] ⌈Configuration of <UL_TriggerTransmit>: If the parameter FrIfUser\nTxUL is set to PDUR, <UL_TriggerTransmit> must be PduR_TriggerTransmit.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05743] ⌈Configuration of <UL_TriggerTransmit>: If the parameter FrIfUser\nTxUL is set to XCP, <UL_TriggerTransmit> must be Xcp_TriggerTransmit.⌋()\n[SWS_FrIf_05759] ⌈Configuration of <UL_TriggerTransmit>: If the parameter FrIfUser\nTxUL is set to FR_TSYN, <UL_TriggerTransmit> must be FrTSyn_TriggerTransmit.⌋()\n8.8.3.1\n<UL_RxIndication>\n[SWS_FrIf_05045] Definition of configurable interface <User_RxIndication> ⌈\nService Name\n<User_RxIndication>\nSyntax\nvoid <User_RxIndication> (\nPduIdType RxPduId,\nconst PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr\n)\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.\nRxPduId\nID of the received PDU.\nParameters (in)\nPduInfoPtr\nContains the length (SduLength) of the received PDU, a pointer\nto a buffer (SduDataPtr) containing the PDU, and the MetaData\nrelated to this PDU.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nNone\nDescription\nIndication of a received PDU from a lower layer communication interface module.\nAvailable via\nconfigurable\n⌋() Note:\nDuring the execution of this API service, the upper layer BSW module that is the final\nrecipient of this PDU is expected to retrieve (i.e. copy) the SDU (i.e. the payload of the\nPDU) by means of the pointer PduInfoPtr which contains the received data address\nand received data length.\nCaveats of <UL_RxIndication>: This API service is called during the execution of the\nFlexRay Job List Execution Function.\n8.8.3.2\n<UL_TxConfirmation>\n[SWS_FrIf_05046] Definition of configurable interface <User_TxConfirmation> ⌈\nService Name\n<User_TxConfirmation>\nSyntax\nvoid <User_TxConfirmation> (\nPduIdType TxPduId,\nStd_ReturnType result\n)\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.\nTxPduId\nID of the PDU that has been transmitted.\nParameters (in)\nresult\nE_OK: The PDU was transmitted. E_NOT_OK: Transmission of\nthe PDU failed.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nNone\nDescription\nThe lower layer communication interface module confirms the transmission of a PDU, or the\nfailure to transmit a PDU.\nAvailable via\nconfigurable\n⌋() Caveats of <UL_TxConfirmation>: This API service is called during the execution\nof the FlexRay Job List Execution Function.\n8.8.3.3\n<UL_TriggerTransmit>\n[SWS_FrIf_05047] Definition of configurable interface <User_TriggerTransmit> ⌈\nService Name\n<User_TriggerTransmit>\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType <User_TriggerTransmit> (\nPduIdType TxPduId,\nPduInfoType* PduInfoPtr\n)\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.\nParameters (in)\nTxPduId\nID of the SDU that is requested to be transmitted.\nParameters (inout)\nPduInfoPtr\nContains a pointer to a buffer (SduDataPtr) to where the SDU\ndata shall be copied, and the available buffer size in SduLengh.\nOn return, the service will indicate the length of the copied SDU\ndata in SduLength.\nParameters (out)\nNone\n▽\n△\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: SDU has been copied and SduLength indicates the\nnumber of copied bytes.\nE_NOT_OK: No SDU data has been copied. PduInfoPtr must not\nbe used since it may contain a NULL pointer or point to invalid\ndata.\nDescription\nWithin this API, the upper layer module (called module) shall check whether the available data\nfits into the buffer size reported by PduInfoPtr->SduLength. If it fits, it shall copy its data into the\nbuffer provided by PduInfoPtr->SduDataPtr and update the length of the actual copied data in\nPduInfoPtr->SduLength. If not, it returns E_NOT_OK without changing PduInfoPtr.\nAvailable via\nconfigurable\n⌋() Caveats of <UL_TriggerTransmit>: This API service is called during the execution\nof the FlexRay Job List Execution Function.\n8.8.3.4\n<Free_Op_A>\n[SWS_FrIf_05316] Definition of configurable interface <Free_Op_A> ⌈\nService Name\n<Free_Op_A>\nSyntax\nvoid <Free_Op_A> (\nuint8 FrIf_CtrlIdx,\nuint16 FrIf_LPduIdx\n)\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nReentrant for different FrIf_LPduIdx, non reentrant for same FrIf_LPduIdx\nFrIf_CtrlIdx\nIndex of the FlexRay CC to address.\nParameters (in)\nFrIf_LPduIdx\nThis index is used to uniquely identify a FlexRay frame.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nNone\nDescription\nUser defined communication operation in order to support hardware specific or additional\ncommunication controller features to increase performance.\nAvailable via\nFrIf_Externals.h\n⌋() Caveats of <Free_Op_A>: This API service is called during the execution of the\nFlexRay Job List Execution Function.\n8.8.3.5\n<Free_Op_B>\n[SWS_FrIf_05317] Definition of configurable interface <Free_Op_B> ⌈\nService Name\n<Free_Op_B>\nSyntax\nvoid <Free_Op_B> (\nuint8 FrIf_CtrlIdx,\nuint16 FrIf_LPduIdx\n)\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\n▽"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "8.2.3 FrTrcv_TrcvWUReasonType\n[SWS_FrTrcv_00435] ⌈The type definition FrTrcv_TrcvWUReasonType shall be pro-\ntected by a FR_GENERAL_TYPES define in order:\n• to be shared between different FlexRay Transceiver Drivers\n• to be included into the FrIf\nIf different FlexRay Transceiver Drivers are used, only one instance of this file has to\nbe included in the source tree.⌋\n[SWS_FrTrcv_00074] Definition of datatype FrTrcv_TrcvWUReasonType\nUpstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00375\n⌈\nName\nFrTrcv_TrcvWUReasonType\nKind\nEnumeration\nFRTRCV_WU_NOT_\nSUPPORTED\n–\nThe transceiver does not support any\ninformation for the wake up reason.\nFRTRCV_WU_BY_BUS\n–\nThe transceiver has detected that the bus has\ncaused the wake up of the ECU.\nFRTRCV_WU_BY_PIN\n–\nThe transceiver has detected a wake-up\nevent at one of the transceiver’s pins (not at\nthe FlexRay bus).\nFRTRCV_WU_\nINTERNALLY\n–\nThe transceiver has detected that the bus has\nwoken up by the ECU via FrTrcv_Set\nTransceiverMode() API call\nFRTRCV_WU_RESET\n–\nThe transceiver has detected that the \"wake\nup\" is due to an ECU reset.\nRange\nFRTRCV_WU_POWER_ON\n–\nThe transceiver has detected that the \"wake\nup\" is due to an ECU reset after power on.\nDescription\nThis type to be used to specify the wake up reason detected by the FR transceiver in detail.\nAvailable via\nFr_GeneralTypes.h\n⌋"
    },
    {

      "verbatim_text": "8.3.10 FrTrcv_EnableTransceiverBranch\nThe FlexRay Transceiver Driver shall enable the branches of active stars synchronously\nto the FlexRay bus schedule\n[SWS_FrTrcv_00443] Definition of API function FrTrcv_EnableTransceiverBranch\n⌈\nService Name\nFrTrcv_EnableTransceiverBranch\nSyntax\nStd_ReturnType FrTrcv_EnableTransceiverBranch (\nuint8 FrTrcv_TrcvIdx,\nuint8 FrTrcv_BranchIdx\n)\nService ID [hex]\n0x10\nSync/Async\nSynchronous\nReentrancy\nNon Reentrant\nFrTrcv_TrcvIdx\nThis zero based index identifies the transceiver within the context\nof the transceiver driver to which the API call has to be applied.\nParameters (in)\nFrTrcv_BranchIdx\nThis zero based index identifies the branch of the (active star)\ntransceiver to which the API call has to be applied.\nParameters (inout)\nNone\nParameters (out)\nNone\nReturn value\nStd_ReturnType\nE_OK: will be returned if the transceiver branch has been enabled\nE_NOT_OK: will be returned if the parameter FrTrcv_TrcvIdx or Fr\nTrcv_BranchIdx is out of range. Branch state remains unchanged.\nDescription\nThis function enables the specified branch on the addressed (active star) transceiver.\nAvailable via\nFrTrcv.h\n⌋\n[SWS_FrTrcv_00465] ⌈If development error detection of module FrTrcv is enabled: if\nthe FrTrcv module is not initialized, the function FrTrcv_EnableTransceiverBranch shall\nraise development error FRTRCV_E_UNINIT.⌋\n[SWS_FrTrcv_00466]\n⌈If\ndevelopment\nerror\ndetection\nof\nmodule\nFrTrcv\nis\nenabled:\nif\nthe\nparameter\nFrTrcv_TrcvIdx\nis\nout\nof\nrange,\nthe\nfunc-\ntion\nFrTrcv_EnableTransceiverBranch\nshall\nraise\ndevelopment\nerror\nFRTRCV_E_FR_INVALID_TRCVIDX.⌋\n[SWS_FrTrcv_00467] ⌈If development error detection of module FrTrcv is en-\nabled: if the parameter FrTrcv_BranchIdx is out of range ([ECUC_FrTrcv_00357]),\nthe\nfunction\nFrTrcv_EnableTransceiverBranch\nshall\nraise\ndevelopment\nerror\nFRTRCV_E_FR_INVALID_BRANCHIDX.⌋"
    },
